14170    #[test]
14171    fn host_strictness_is_strict_only_with_cpuid_faulting_and_an_exact_counter() {
14172        let exact = CapabilityVerdict {
14173            present: true,
14174            evidence: "fixture counter".into(),
14175        };
14176        let inexact = CapabilityVerdict {
14177            present: false,
14178            evidence: "SpecLockMap is enabled".into(),
14179        };
14180        let capable = fixture_host_capabilities();
14181        assert_eq!(
14182            host_strictness(&capable, Some(&exact), None).unwrap(),
14183            HostLevel::default()
14184        );
14185        let level = host_strictness(&capable, Some(&inexact), None).unwrap();
14186        assert_eq!(level.level, StrictnessLevel::Relaxed);
14187        assert_eq!(
14188            level.reason.as_deref(),
14189            Some("this host has no exact branch counter (SpecLockMap is enabled)")
14190        );
14191        // No verdict is not a verdict of absence.
14192        assert_eq!(
14193            host_strictness(&capable, None, None).unwrap(),
14194            HostLevel::default()
14195        );
14196        let mut no_faulting = capable.clone();
14197        no_faulting
14198            .get_mut(&HostCapability::CpuidFaulting)
14199            .unwrap()
14200            .present = false;
14201        let level = host_strictness(&no_faulting, Some(&inexact), None).unwrap();
14202        assert_eq!(
14203            level.reason.as_deref(),
14204            Some(
14205                "this host has no CPUID faulting (fixture cpuid probe) and no exact branch \
14206                 counter (SpecLockMap is enabled)"
14207            )
14208        );
14209        // Forcing relaxed works on a capable host; nothing forces strict.
14210        let level = host_strictness(&capable, Some(&exact), Some("relaxed")).unwrap();
14211        assert_eq!(level.level, StrictnessLevel::Relaxed);
14212        assert_eq!(
14213            level.reason.as_deref(),
14214            Some("E2E_STRICTNESS_LEVEL=relaxed")
14215        );
14216        for refused in ["strict", "Relaxed", "both"] {
14217            assert!(host_strictness(&capable, Some(&exact), Some(refused)).is_err());
14218        }
14219    }

14265    /// A test's declared `/proc` level reaches the Hermit command of each of
14266    /// its cells once, right after `--strict`, and records no relaxation; a
14267    /// test that declares none runs at Hermit's default.
14268    #[test]
14269    fn a_declared_proc_level_reaches_every_hermit_cell_and_relaxes_nothing() {
14270        for mut cell in [
14271            verify_cell("ptrace", true, BTreeMap::new(), None),
14272            ptrace_cell("replay"),
14273            ptrace_cell("custom"),
14274        ] {
14275            let mode = cell.id.mode.clone();
14276            let argv = verify_spec_of(cell.clone()).argv;
14277            assert!(
14278                !argv.iter().any(|arg| arg.starts_with("--proc")),
14279                "{mode}: {argv:?}"
14280            );
14281            let relaxations = cell_relaxations(&cell);
14282            cell.test.proc = Some(ProcLevel::Standard);
14283            let argv = verify_spec_of(cell.clone()).argv;
14284            let levels: Vec<usize> = (0..argv.len())
14285                .filter(|&index| argv[index].starts_with("--proc"))
14286                .collect();
14287            assert_eq!(levels.len(), 1, "{mode}: {argv:?}");
14288            assert_eq!(argv[levels[0]], "--proc=standard", "{mode}");
14289            if mode != "custom" {
14290                assert_eq!(argv[levels[0] - 1], "--strict", "{mode}: {argv:?}");
14291            }
14292            assert_eq!(cell_relaxations(&cell), relaxations, "{mode}");
14293        }
14294    }

14296    /// A row is held to its producing host's level: one from a host without
14297    /// CPUID faulting (a Buck RE worker) records the relaxed level's flag,
14298    /// which this strict host's cell does not, and still records its cell, as
14299    /// does one from a producer forced to the relaxed level. The same
14300    /// relaxations from a row whose own verdicts give the strict level, a
14301    /// forced reason without a recorded relaxed level, and a relaxation the
14302    /// manifest does not declare are refused.
14303    #[test]
14304    fn a_row_records_its_cells_relaxations_at_its_producers_level() {
14305        let cell = verify_cell("ptrace", true, BTreeMap::new(), None);
14306        assert_eq!(cell.host_level.level, StrictnessLevel::Strict);
14307        let mut row = cell_result_that_located_nothing();
14308        row.relaxations = cell_relaxations(&cell);
14309        row.strictness = cell.strictness();
14310        assert!(row_records_cell_relaxations(&cell, &row));
14311
14312        let mut remote = row.clone();
14313        remote.host_capabilities.insert(
14314            HostCapability::CpuidFaulting,
14315            HostCapabilityVerdict {
14316                present: false,
14317                evidence: "fixture: no CPUID faulting".into(),
14318            },
14319        );
14320        let mut producer = cell.clone();
14321        producer.host_level = host_strictness(&remote.host_capabilities, None, None).unwrap();
14322        assert_eq!(producer.host_level.level, StrictnessLevel::Relaxed);
14323        remote.relaxations = cell_relaxations(&producer);
14324        remote.strictness = producer.strictness();
14325        assert_ne!(remote.relaxations, cell_relaxations(&cell));
14326        assert!(row_records_cell_relaxations(&cell, &remote));
14327
14328        let mut claimed = remote.clone();
14329        claimed.host_capabilities = row.host_capabilities.clone();
14330        assert!(!row_records_cell_relaxations(&cell, &claimed));
14331
14332        let mut forced_cell = cell.clone();
14333        forced_cell.host_level =
14334            host_strictness(&row.host_capabilities, None, Some("relaxed")).unwrap();
14335        let mut forced = row.clone();
14336        forced.relaxations = cell_relaxations(&forced_cell);
14337        forced.strictness = forced_cell.strictness();
14338        assert!(row_records_cell_relaxations(&cell, &forced));
14339        forced.strictness = cell.strictness();
14340        assert!(!row_records_cell_relaxations(&cell, &forced));
14341
14342        let mut undeclared = remote.clone();
14343        undeclared
14344            .relaxations
14345            .push("--no-rcb-time: fixture reason".into());
14346        assert!(!row_records_cell_relaxations(&cell, &undeclared));
14347    }

14393    fn only_a_pmu_clock_verify_cell_has_a_relaxed_form() {
14394        for backend in ["kvm", "dbt", "sabre", "liteinst", "in-guest-trap"] {
14395            let mut cell = verify_cell(backend, true, BTreeMap::new(), None);
14396            cell.host_level = relaxed_host();
14397            assert_eq!(
14398                cell.strictness_level(),
14399                Some(StrictnessLevel::Strict),
14400                "{backend}"
14401            );
14402            assert!(cell.level_relaxations().is_empty(), "{backend}");
14403        }
14404        for mode in ["chaos", "replay"] {
14405            let mut cell = ptrace_cell(mode);
14406            cell.host_level = relaxed_host();
14407            assert_eq!(cell.strictness_level(), Some(StrictnessLevel::Strict));
14408            // Still refused where the host lacks the counter.
14409            assert!(refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&cell), "{mode}");
14410        }
14411        let mut naked = ptrace_cell("naked");
14412        naked.id.backend = None;
14413        assert_eq!(naked.strictness_level(), None);
14414        assert_eq!(naked.strictness(), None);

14417    /// A verify cell that declares its own numeric `--max-timeslice` keeps it
14418    /// at the relaxed level (the level adds `--max-timeslice=disabled` only
14419    /// where the recipe names no timeslice), so it still arms the counter and
14420    /// is withheld where the counter is inexact. c-programs/sigreturn-preemption
14421    /// needs the preemption timer to finish at all.
14422    #[test]
14423    fn a_relaxed_verify_cell_with_its_own_timeslice_is_refused_on_an_inexact_counter() {
14424        let mut cell = verify_cell(
14425            "ptrace",
14426            true,
14427            BTreeMap::from([("ptrace".into(), vec!["--max-timeslice=100000".into()])]),
14428            None,
14429        );
14430        cell.host_level = relaxed_host();
14431        assert_eq!(cell.strictness_level(), Some(StrictnessLevel::Relaxed));
14432        assert_eq!(
14433            cell.strictness().unwrap().max_timeslice,
14434            MaxTimeslice::Nanoseconds(100_000)
14435        );
14436        assert!(refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&cell));
14437        // Without its own timeslice the relaxed cell is not refused.
14438        let mut plain = verify_cell("ptrace", true, BTreeMap::new(), None);
14439        plain.host_level = relaxed_host();
14440        assert!(!refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&plain));
14441    }

14443    /// A run with `--max-timeslice=disabled` uses no branch count, so
14444    /// Hermit does not refuse it on a host whose counter miscounts, and the
14445    /// harness does not withhold it there
14446    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4291).
14447    #[test]
14448    fn a_strict_custom_cell_without_a_timeslice_is_not_refused_on_an_inexact_counter() {
14449        let mut cell = ptrace_cell("custom");
14450        cell.test.modes.get_mut("custom").unwrap().args = vec!["--strict".into()];
14451        assert!(refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&cell));
14452        cell.test.modes.get_mut("custom").unwrap().args =
14453            vec!["--strict".into(), "--max-timeslice=disabled".into()];
14454        assert!(!refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&cell));
14455        assert_eq!(
14456            cell.strictness().unwrap().max_timeslice,
14457            MaxTimeslice::Disabled
14458        );

14461    /// The backends whose strict run arms the PMU preemption timer, so that

14491    /// A strict KVM verify cell arms KVM's preemption timer, so the hermit
14492    /// binary refuses it on an inexact counter and the harness withholds it
14493    /// there. It has no relaxed form: a relaxed host leaves it strict and
14494    /// adds nothing. A recipe that passes `--max-timeslice=disabled` gives it
14495    /// no timeslice and so no timer, which `hermit run --strict` does not
14496    /// refuse; a numeric one is still refused.
14497    #[test]
14498    fn a_strict_kvm_cell_with_a_timeslice_is_refused_on_an_inexact_counter() {
14499        let mut cell = verify_cell("kvm", true, BTreeMap::new(), None);
14500        assert_eq!(cell.strictness_level(), Some(StrictnessLevel::Strict));
14501        assert_eq!(
14502            cell.strictness().unwrap().max_timeslice,
14503            MaxTimeslice::Nanoseconds(200_000_000)
14504        );
14505        assert!(refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&cell));
14506        cell.host_level = relaxed_host();
14507        assert_eq!(cell.strictness_level(), Some(StrictnessLevel::Strict));
14508        assert!(cell.level_relaxations().is_empty());
14509        assert!(refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&cell));
14510        // A disabled KVM cell under --probe-disabled runs the same command.
14511        assert!(refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&verify_cell(
14512            "kvm",
14513            false,
14514            BTreeMap::new(),
14515            None
14516        )));
14517
14518        let timeslice = |value: &str| {
14519            verify_cell(
14520                "kvm",
14521                true,
14522                BTreeMap::from([("kvm".into(), vec![format!("--max-timeslice={value}")])]),
14523                None,
14524            )
14525        };
14526        let disabled = timeslice("disabled");
14527        assert_eq!(
14528            disabled.strictness().unwrap().max_timeslice,
14529            MaxTimeslice::Disabled
14530        );
14531        assert!(!refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&disabled));
14532        assert!(refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&timeslice("100000")));
14533    }

14535    /// KVM's chaos, replay and custom cells follow ptrace's mode rules: chaos
14536    /// and replay always run strict, with a timeslice, and a custom cell is
14537    /// refused only when its arguments pass `--strict`, neither
14538    /// `--namespace-only` nor `--lite`, and leave it a timeslice. The other
14539    /// backends' cells never are.
14540    #[test]
14541    fn kvm_chaos_replay_and_custom_cells_follow_the_mode_rules() {
14542        let kvm = |mode: &str| {
14543            let mut cell = ptrace_cell(mode);
14544            cell.id.backend = Some("kvm".into());
14545            cell
14546        };
14547        assert!(refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&kvm("chaos")));
14548        assert!(refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&kvm("replay")));
14549        let mut custom = kvm("custom");
14550        for (args, refused) in [
14551            (&[][..], false),
14552            (&["--strict"][..], true),
14553            (&["--strict", "--max-timeslice=100000"][..], true),
14554            (&["--strict", "--max-timeslice=disabled"][..], false),
14555            (&["--strict", "--namespace-only"][..], false),
14556            (&["--strict", "--lite"][..], false),
14557        ] {
14558            custom.test.modes.get_mut("custom").unwrap().args =
14559                args.iter().map(|arg| arg.to_string()).collect();
14560            assert_eq!(
14561                refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&custom),
14562                refused,
14563                "{args:?}"
14564            );
14565        }
14566        let mut naked = kvm("naked");
14567        naked.id.backend = None;
14568        assert!(!refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&naked));
14569        for backend in ["dbt", "sabre", "liteinst", "in-guest-trap"] {
14570            assert!(
14571                !refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&verify_cell(
14572                    backend,
14573                    true,
14574                    BTreeMap::new(),
14575                    None
14576                )),
14577                "{backend}"
14578            );
14579        }
14580    }

14582    /// Every spelling hermit reads as no timer leaves a strict cell unrefused on
14583    /// an inexact counter, on KVM and on ptrace, and the same spelling with a
14584    /// timeslice is refused. hermit takes the maximum timeslice as
14585    /// `--max-timeslice` or its alias `--preemption-timeout`, its value after
14586    /// `=` or as the next argument, and reads `disabled` and 0 (also `00` and
14587    /// `+0`, which `str::parse::<u64>` accepts) as no timer: run against hermit
14588    /// itself, each disabling spelling here gave a summary with no maximum
14589    /// timeslice, and each timed one 100000. A verify recipe may spell it only
14590    /// `--max-timeslice=VALUE`; its cell is decided the same way at either
14591    /// strictness level.
14592    #[test]
14593    fn every_spelling_that_disables_the_timer_is_admitted_and_its_timed_twin_refused() {
14594        let pairs: [(&[&str], &[&str]); 10] = [
14595            (&["--max-timeslice=disabled"], &["--max-timeslice=100000"]),
14596            (&["--max-timeslice=0"], &["--max-timeslice=100000"]),
14597            (
14598                &["--max-timeslice", "disabled"],
14599                &["--max-timeslice", "100000"],
14600            ),
14601            (&["--max-timeslice", "0"], &["--max-timeslice", "100000"]),
14602            (
14603                &["--preemption-timeout=disabled"],
14604                &["--preemption-timeout=100000"],
14605            ),
14606            (
14607                &["--preemption-timeout=0"],
14608                &["--preemption-timeout=100000"],
14609            ),
14610            (
14611                &["--preemption-timeout", "disabled"],
14612                &["--preemption-timeout", "100000"],
14613            ),
14614            (
14615                &["--preemption-timeout", "0"],
14616                &["--preemption-timeout", "100000"],
14617            ),
14618            (&["--max-timeslice=00"], &["--max-timeslice=+100000"]),
14619            (&["--max-timeslice=+0"], &["--max-timeslice=+100000"]),
14620        ];
14621        for backend in ["kvm", "ptrace"] {
14622            let mut custom = ptrace_cell("custom");
14623            custom.id.backend = Some(backend.into());
14624            for (disabled, timed) in pairs {
14625                for (spelling, refused, recorded) in [
14626                    (disabled, false, MaxTimeslice::Disabled),
14627                    (timed, true, MaxTimeslice::Nanoseconds(100_000)),
14628                ] {
14629                    let args = std::iter::once("--strict")
14630                        .chain(spelling.iter().copied())
14631                        .map(str::to_string)
14632                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
14633                    validate_mode_extensions(
14634                        "fixture/test",
14635                        "custom",
14636                        &ModeRecipe {
14637                            args: args.clone(),
14638                            ..ModeRecipe::default()
14639                        },
14640                    )
14641                    .unwrap();
14642                    custom.test.modes.get_mut("custom").unwrap().args = args;
14643                    assert_eq!(
14644                        refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&custom),
14645                        refused,
14646                        "{backend} custom {spelling:?}"
14647                    );
14648                    assert_eq!(
14649                        custom.strictness().unwrap().max_timeslice,
14650                        recorded,
14651                        "{backend} custom {spelling:?}"
14652                    );
14653                }
14654            }
14655            for (value, refused) in [
14656                ("disabled", false),
14657                ("0", false),
14658                ("00", false),
14659                ("+0", false),
14660                ("100000", true),
14661                ("+100000", true),
14662            ] {
14663                let hermit_args = BTreeMap::from([(
14664                    backend.to_string(),
14665                    vec![format!("--max-timeslice={value}")],
14666                )]);
14667                let mut cell = verify_cell(backend, true, hermit_args, None);
14668                for host_level in [HostLevel::default(), relaxed_host()] {
14669                    cell.host_level = host_level;
14670                    assert_eq!(
14671                        refused_on_an_inexact_branch_counter(&cell),
14672                        refused,
14673                        "{backend} verify --max-timeslice={value} at {:?}",
14674                        cell.strictness_level()
14675                    );
14676                }
14677            }
14678        }
14679    }

14681    /// The timeslice flags hermit refuses with a usage error before any guest
14682    /// runs are refused when the manifest loads, in a custom cell's arguments
14683    /// and in a verify recipe: a value below one RCB or neither `disabled`
14684    /// nor a number, a name with no value, and a second occurrence under
14685    /// either name (each measured against hermit itself). A flag after `--`
14686    /// is a guest argument, and a longer name is another option.
14687    #[test]
14688    fn timeslice_flags_resolve_and_are_refused_as_hermit_resolves_and_refuses_them() {
14689        let resolve = |args: &[&str]| {
14690            MaxTimeslice::from_options(&args.iter().map(|arg| arg.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>())
14691        };
14692        assert_eq!(resolve(&[]), Ok(None));
14693        assert_eq!(resolve(&["--strict", "--lite"]), Ok(None));
14694        assert_eq!(
14695            resolve(&["--strict", "--max-timeslice", "disabled", "--lite"]),
14696            Ok(Some(MaxTimeslice::Disabled))
14697        );
14698        assert_eq!(
14699            resolve(&["--preemption-timeout=4000"]),
14700            Ok(Some(MaxTimeslice::Nanoseconds(4_000)))
14701        );
14702        assert_eq!(
14703            resolve(&["--max-timeslice=10"]),
14704            Ok(Some(MaxTimeslice::Nanoseconds(10)))
14705        );
14706        assert_eq!(resolve(&["--strict", "--", "--max-timeslice=0"]), Ok(None));
14707        assert_eq!(resolve(&["--max-timeslices=0"]), Ok(None));
14708        for (refused, needle) in [
14709            (&["--max-timeslice=5"][..], "below one RCB"),
14710            (&["--max-timeslice=abc"], "neither `disabled`"),
14711            (&["--max-timeslice="], "neither `disabled`"),
14712            (&["--max-timeslice=Disabled"], "neither `disabled`"),
14713            (&["--preemption-timeout", "9"], "below one RCB"),
14714            (&["--max-timeslice"], "has no value"),
14715            (&["--max-timeslice", "-5"], "has no value"),
14716            (&["--preemption-timeout", "--", "0"], "has no value"),
14717            (&["--max-timeslice=0", "--max-timeslice=0"], "a second time"),
14718            (
14719                &["--max-timeslice=0", "--preemption-timeout=0"],
14720                "a second time",
14721            ),
14722            (
14723                &["--preemption-timeout", "0", "--max-timeslice=100000"],
14724                "a second time",
14725            ),
14726        ] {
14727            let error = resolve(refused).unwrap_err();
14728            assert!(error.contains(needle), "{refused:?}: {error}");
14729            let custom = ModeRecipe {
14730                args: refused.iter().map(|arg| arg.to_string()).collect(),
14731                ..ModeRecipe::default()
14732            };
14733            let error = validate_mode_extensions("fixture/test", "custom", &custom).unwrap_err();
14734            assert!(error.contains("custom args"), "{refused:?}: {error}");
14735            assert!(error.contains(needle), "{refused:?}: {error}");
14736        }
14737        let verify = |value: &str| {
14738            validate_mode_extensions(
14739                "fixture/test",
14740                "verify",
14741                &ModeRecipe {
14742                    backends_enabled: vec!["kvm".into()],
14743                    hermit_args: BTreeMap::from([(
14744                        "kvm".into(),
14745                        vec![format!("--max-timeslice={value}")],
14746                    )]),
14747                    hermit_args_reason: Some("fixture timeslice".into()),
14748                    ..ModeRecipe::default()
14749                },
14750            )
14751        };
14752        for accepted in ["disabled", "0", "+0", "10", "100000"] {
14753            verify(accepted).unwrap();
14754        }
14755        for (refused, needle) in [
14756            ("5", "below one RCB"),
14757            ("abc", "neither `disabled`"),
14758            ("Disabled", "neither `disabled`"),
14759        ] {
14760            let error = verify(refused).unwrap_err();
14761            assert!(error.contains("hermit_args entry"), "{refused}: {error}");
14762            assert!(error.contains(needle), "{refused}: {error}");
14763        }
14764    }

14766    #[test]
14767    fn max_level_is_validated() {
14768        let check = |mode: &str, edit: &dyn Fn(&mut ModeRecipe)| {
14769            let mut recipe = recipe(true).modes.remove("verify").unwrap();
14770            edit(&mut recipe);
14771            validate_mode_extensions("fixture/test", mode, &recipe)
14772        };
14773        let capped = |recipe: &mut ModeRecipe| {
14774            recipe.max_level = Some(StrictnessLevel::Relaxed);
14775            recipe.max_level_reason = Some("constant output".into());
14776        };
14777        check("verify", &capped).unwrap();
14778        assert!(
14779            check("chaos", &capped)
14780                .unwrap_err()
14781                .contains("which only a verify mode accepts")
14782        );
14783        assert!(
14784            check("verify", &|recipe| {
14785                capped(recipe);
14786                recipe.max_level = Some(StrictnessLevel::Strict);
14787            })
14788            .unwrap_err()
14789            .contains("only `relaxed` caps a cell")
14790        );
14791        assert!(
14792            check("verify", &|recipe| {
14793                capped(recipe);
14794                recipe.max_level_reason = Some(" ".into());
14795            })
14796            .unwrap_err()
14797            .contains("substantive max_level_reason")
14798        );
14799        assert!(
14800            check("verify", &|recipe| recipe.max_level_reason =
14801                Some("why".into()))
14802            .unwrap_err()
14803            .contains("max_level_reason without max_level")
14804        );
14805        assert!(
14806            check("verify", &|recipe| {
14807                capped(recipe);
14808                recipe.backends_enabled = vec!["kvm".into()];
14809            })
14810            .unwrap_err()
14811            .contains("enables neither")

14862    /// A fixture verify cell on `backend`, enabled or not, with these
14863    /// per-backend flags.
14864    fn verify_cell(
14865        backend: &str,
14866        enabled: bool,
14867        hermit_args: BTreeMap<String, Vec<String>>,
14868        comparator: Option<Comparator>,
14869    ) -> SelectedCell {
14870        let mut test = recipe(true);
14871        let mode = test.modes.get_mut("verify").unwrap();
14872        mode.hermit_args = hermit_args;
14873        mode.hermit_args_reason = Some("fixture configuration".into());
14874        mode.env = Some(BTreeMap::from([("TMPDIR".into(), "/tmp".into())]));
14875        mode.comparator = comparator;
14876        mode.comparator_reason = comparator.map(|_| "fixture policy".into());
14877        SelectedCell {
14878            image: None,
14879            category: "fixture".into(),
14880            id: CellId {
14881                test: test.id.clone(),
14882                mode: "verify".into(),
14883                backend: Some(backend.into()),
14884            },
14885            test,
14886            enabled,
14887            timeout_seconds: 15,
14888            cpu_timeout_seconds: 10,
14889            host_level: HostLevel::default(),
14890        }
14891    }

14958    fn verify_spec_and_context_of_with_bindings(
14959        cell: SelectedCell,
14960        command_bindings: BTreeMap<String, crate::executable_binding::HeldExecutable>,
14961    ) -> (CellRunSpec, RunContext) {
14962        let context = RunContext {
14963            command_bindings,
14964            root: PathBuf::from("/repo"),
14965            hermit_bin: PathBuf::from("/repo/hermit"),
14966            result_root: PathBuf::from("/repo/results"),
14967            build_root: PathBuf::from("/repo/build"),
14968            run_id: "fixture".into(),
14969            machine_shortname: "fixture-host".into(),
14970            kernel_version: "7.1.3-fixture".into(),
14971            host_capabilities: fixture_host_capabilities(),
14972            attempt: 1,
14973            run_index: None,
14974            epoch: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z".into(),
14975            source_sha: "0".repeat(40),
14976            binary_build_sha: None,
14977            source_dirty: false,
14978            prebuilt: false,
14979            keep_logs: false,
14980            capture_custom_runs: false,
14981            parity_retained: BTreeSet::new(),
14982            parity_compared: BTreeSet::new(),
14983            run_verify_strict: true,
14984            record_verify_strict: true,
14985            timeout_multipliers: TimeoutMultipliers::default(),
14986            scheduled_worker_capacity: ScheduledWorkerCapacity::new(1),
14987            isolated_workdir: None,
14988            shares_ld_so_cache: false,
14989            exact_branch_counter: None,
14990            v2_retry_oci_dir: None,
14991        };
14992        if let Some(held) = selected_executable(&context, &cell) {
14993            let error = infrastructure_error_result(&context, &cell, "fixture".into());
14994            let unavailable = host_inapplicable_result(&context, &cell, "fixture".into());
14995            assert_eq!(
14996                error.binary_sha256.as_deref(),
14997                Some(held.identity.sha256.as_str())
14998            );
14999            assert_eq!(
15000                unavailable.binary_sha256.as_deref(),
15001                Some(held.identity.sha256.as_str())
15002            );
15003            assert_eq!(
15004                physical_binary_digest(&context, &cell).as_deref(),
15005                Some(held.identity.sha256.as_str())
15006            );
15007            assert_eq!(
15008                error.binary_build_sha.as_deref(),
15009                Some(held.identity.binary_build_sha.as_str())
15010            );
15011            assert!(error.attempts.is_empty() && unavailable.attempts.is_empty());
15012        }
15013        let spec = build_spec(
15014            &context,
15015            &cell,
15016            PathBuf::from("/repo/results/cell"),
15017            vec!["/bin/true".into()],
15018            "1",
15019            None,
15020            cell.timeout_seconds,
15021        )
15022        .unwrap();
15023        (spec, context)
15024    }

15027    fn selected_static_entry_reaches_build_spec_and_the_original_strict_invocation_validator() {
15028        let cell = verify_cell("ptrace", true, BTreeMap::new(), None);
15029        let (old, old_context) =
15030            verify_spec_and_context_of_with_bindings(cell.clone(), BTreeMap::new());
15031        let binding = crate::executable_binding::current_test_binding("ptrace");
15032        let (mut spec, context) = verify_spec_and_context_of_with_bindings(

15037        assert_eq!(spec.timeout_seconds, old.timeout_seconds);
15038        assert_eq!(
15039            cell_timeouts(&context, &cell).unwrap().cpu_seconds,
15040            cell_timeouts(&old_context, &cell).unwrap().cpu_seconds
15041        );
15042        assert_eq!(spec.comparator, old.comparator);
15043        assert!(
15044            spec.argv
15045                .iter()
15046                .any(|v| v == binding.identity.executable.to_str().unwrap())
15047        );
15048        let mut attempt = attempt_with_sabre_evidence("");
15049        attempt.argv = std::mem::take(&mut spec.argv);

15056        let strict = attempt.argv.iter().position(|v| v == "--strict").unwrap();
15057        attempt.argv.remove(strict);

15059            verify_attempt_invocation_error(&attempt, "ptrace", &[], false, Comparator::Strict)
15060                .is_err()
15061        );

15064    /// A probe of a disabled in-guest LiteInst cell runs it with the maximum
15065    /// timeslice disabled, as Hermit requires of that backend; an enabled
15066    /// cell, another backend, or a cell that names its own `--max-timeslice`
15067    /// runs with exactly its declared flags.
15068    #[test]
15069    fn a_probed_in_guest_cell_runs_without_a_preemption_timer() {
15070        let timeslices = |spec: &CellRunSpec| {
15071            let argv = without_mapped_input_holder(&spec.argv);
15072            let separator = argv.iter().position(|a| a == "--").unwrap();
15073            argv[..separator]
15074                .iter()
15075                .filter(|a| a.starts_with("--max-timeslice"))
15076                .cloned()
15077                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
15078        };
15079        for backend in ["liteinst", "in-guest-trap"] {
15080            let probed = verify_spec(backend, false, BTreeMap::new(), None);
15081            assert_eq!(
15082                timeslices(&probed),
15083                ["--max-timeslice=disabled"],
15084                "{backend}"
15085            );
15086            assert_eq!(
15087                cell_relaxations(&verify_cell(backend, false, BTreeMap::new(), None)),
15088                [format!(
15089                    "--max-timeslice=disabled: {PROBE_RELAXATION_REASON}"
15090                )]
15091            );
15092            let verify = probed
15093                .argv
15094                .iter()
15095                .position(|a| a == "--verify-run")
15096                .unwrap();
15097            let flag = probed
15098                .argv
15099                .iter()
15100                .position(|a| a == "--max-timeslice=disabled")
15101                .unwrap();
15102            assert!(flag < verify, "{:?}", probed.argv);
15103            assert!(timeslices(&verify_spec(backend, true, BTreeMap::new(), None)).is_empty());
15104            let declared = BTreeMap::from([(backend.into(), vec!["--max-timeslice=1".into()])]);
15105            assert_eq!(
15106                timeslices(&verify_spec(backend, false, declared, None)),
15107                ["--max-timeslice=1"]
15108            );
15109        }
15110        for backend in ["ptrace", "dbt", "kvm"] {
15111            assert!(
15112                timeslices(&verify_spec(backend, false, BTreeMap::new(), None)).is_empty(),
15113                "{backend}"
15114            );
15115        }
15116        // A SaBRe spec writes its path evidence under the cell directory, so
15117        // that backend is checked on the relaxation alone.
15118        let sabre = verify_cell("sabre", false, BTreeMap::new(), None);
15119        assert_eq!(probe_relaxation(&sabre, "sabre"), None);
15120    }

15122    /// Physical package qualification, deliberately outside ordinary manifest
15123    /// enrollment. The tracked opt-in script supplies the actual successful
15124    /// inline run's CLI, cat, package and complete report, then selects this
15125    /// ignored test exactly. Missing inputs fail instead of skipping.
15126    #[test]
15127    #[ignore = "requires ci/qualify-loader-verification.sh and a genuine qualified private package"]
15128    fn mapped_saved_pair_uses_actual_holder_and_matches_inline_verification() {
15129        use crate::verify_run_record::RecordedStatus;
15130        use crate::verify_run_record::VerifyRunOutcome;
15131        use crate::verify_run_record::VerifyRunRecord;
15132
15133        const INPUT: &[u8] = b"first\0line\nlast-without-newline\xff";
15134        let required_path = |name: &str| {
15135            let value = std::env::var_os(name)
15136                .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
15137                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{name} is required by the package qualification"));
15138            fs::canonicalize(value).unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{name}: {error}"))
15139        };
15140        let record_path = required_path("HERMIT_LOADER_QUALIFICATION_RECORD");
15141        let record: JsonValue = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(record_path).unwrap()).unwrap();
15142        assert_eq!(record["schema"], 1);
15143        assert_eq!(record["stdin_sha256"], hex_digest(INPUT));
15144        let install = required_path("HERMIT_INSTALL_DIR");
15145        assert_eq!(record["install"], install.to_str().unwrap());
15146        let check_inputs = || {
15147            for role in ["hermit", "cat", "image", "descriptor"] {
15148                let path = Path::new(record[role]["path"].as_str().unwrap());
15149                assert!(path.is_file(), "missing actual {role}: {}", path.display());
15150                assert_eq!(
15151                    file_digest(path).as_deref(),
15152                    Some(record[role]["sha256"].as_str().unwrap()),
15153                    "the actual {role} changed between qualification consumers"
15154                );
15155            }
15156            assert_eq!(
15157                fs::canonicalize(install.join("rsrcs/detcore_private_runtime.elf")).unwrap(),
15158                Path::new(record["image"]["path"].as_str().unwrap())
15159            );
15160            assert_eq!(
15161                fs::canonicalize(install.join("rsrcs/detcore_private_runtime.package.json"))
15162                    .unwrap(),
15163                Path::new(record["descriptor"]["path"].as_str().unwrap())
15164            );
15165        };
15166        check_inputs();
15167        let root = required_path("HERMIT_LOADER_QUALIFICATION_OUTPUT").join("saved-pair");
15168        fs::create_dir(&root).expect("new saved-pair output; never reuse a prior attempt");
15169        let directories = verify_run_directories(&root);
15170        let report_path = root.join("report.json");
15171        let manifest_path = root.join("holder-manifest.json");
15172        let mut run: Vec<String> = serde_json::from_value(record["inline_argv"].clone()).unwrap();
15173        assert_eq!(
15174            fs::canonicalize(&run[0]).unwrap(),
15175            Path::new(record["hermit"]["path"].as_str().unwrap())
15176        );
15177        let hermit = run[0].clone();
15178        let guest = run.iter().position(|word| word == "--").unwrap();
15179        for flag in [
15180            "--in-guest-exec-stop",
15181            "--strict",
15182            "--verify",
15183            "--verify-strict",
15184        ] {
15185            assert_eq!(run[..guest].iter().filter(|word| *word == flag).count(), 1);
15186        }
15187        assert_eq!(run[guest + 1..].len(), 1);
15188        assert_eq!(
15189            fs::canonicalize(&run[guest + 1]).unwrap(),
15190            Path::new(record["cat"]["path"].as_str().unwrap())
15191        );
15192        // Change only the public run mode and its output location. Preserve
15193        // the inline invocation's exact epoch, seeds, guest and root flags.
15194        let verify = run[..guest]
15195            .iter()
15196            .position(|word| word == "--verify")
15197            .unwrap();
15198        run.remove(verify);
15199        let output = run.iter().position(|word| word == "--verify-json").unwrap();
15200        run[output] = "--verify-run".into();
15201        run[output + 1] = VERIFY_RUN_DIR_PLACEHOLDER.into();
15202        let comparison = vec![
15203            hermit.clone(),
15204            "log-diff".into(),
15205            "--verify-json".into(),
15206            report_path.to_str().unwrap().into(),
15207            "--verify-allow=success".into(),
15208            directories[0].to_str().unwrap().into(),
15209            directories[1].to_str().unwrap().into(),
15210        ];
15211        // Match the production RunContext: a root without a linker cache
15212        // still uses the mapped holder, but has no cache input to seal.
15213        let shares_ld_so_cache = Path::new(LD_SO_CACHE_PATH)
15214            .try_exists()
15215            .expect("observe the qualification root's linker cache");
15216        let paired = paired_verification_argv(comparison, run);
15217        let mut argv = if shares_ld_so_cache {
15218            shared_inputs_argv(&hermit, paired)
15219        } else {
15220            paired
15221        };
15222        assert_eq!(&argv[1..5], MAPPED_INPUTS_PREFIX);
15223        let program_index = if shares_ld_so_cache {
15224            assert_eq!(&argv[5..7], ["--input", LD_SO_CACHE_INPUT]);
15225            7
15226        } else {
15227            5
15228        };
15229        assert_eq!(
15230            &argv[program_index..program_index + 4],
15231            ["bash", "-c", VERIFY_PAIR_SCRIPT, VERIFY_PAIR_NAME]
15232        );
15233        // Observe the actual holder's wire record, then exec the unchanged
15234        // maintained pair program. This adds no second holder or comparator
15235        // and reopening fd 197 leaves its inherited open-description offset.
15236        argv.splice(
15237            program_index..program_index,
15238            [
15239                "bash".into(),
15240                "-c".into(),
15241                "set -eu; cat /proc/self/fd/197 > \"$1\"; shift; exec \"$@\"".into(),
15242                "loader-package-manifest-observer".into(),
15243                manifest_path.to_str().unwrap().into(),
15244            ],
15245        );
15246        fs::write(
15247            root.join("argv.json"),
15248            serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&argv).unwrap(),
15249        )
15250        .unwrap();
15251        let stdin_path = root.join("stdin");
15252        fs::write(&stdin_path, INPUT).unwrap();
15253        // This test runs only through the official counted Nextest CPU/wall
15254        // owner in the qualification script. It makes one actual pair, with
15255        // no internal retry or alternate execution route.
15256        let output = Command::new(&argv[0])
15257            .args(&argv[1..])
15258            .stdin(File::open(&stdin_path).unwrap())
15259            .env("HERMIT_EPOCH", CANONICAL_TEST_EPOCH)
15260            .output()
15261            .expect("start the actual mapped saved pair");
15262        fs::write(root.join("controller.stdout"), &output.stdout).unwrap();
15263        fs::write(root.join("controller.stderr"), &output.stderr).unwrap();
15264        fs::write(
15265            root.join("controller.status"),
15266            format!("{:?}\n", output.status),
15267        )
15268        .unwrap();
15269        check_inputs();
15270        assert_eq!(
15271            output.status.code(),
15272            Some(0),
15273            "{}",
15274            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
15275        );
15276        assert_eq!(
15277            output.stdout, INPUT,
15278            "the public saved pair must emit the guest output once"
15279        );
15280
15281        let manifest: JsonValue =
15282            serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(manifest_path).unwrap()).unwrap();
15283        assert_eq!(manifest["schema"], 3, "{manifest}");
15284        assert_eq!(manifest["sealed"]["producer"], "hermit-sealed-files");
15285        assert_eq!(
15286            manifest["package"]["image"]["sha256"],
15287            record["image"]["sha256"]
15288        );
15289        assert_eq!(
15290            manifest["package"]["descriptor"]["sha256"],
15291            record["descriptor"]["sha256"]
15292        );
15293        assert_ne!(manifest["image_fd"], manifest["descriptor_fd"]);
15294        let roles = manifest["sealed"]["objects"].as_array().unwrap();
15295        assert_eq!(roles.len(), usize::from(shares_ld_so_cache), "{manifest}");
15296        if shares_ld_so_cache {
15297            assert_eq!(roles[0]["role"], "ld-so-cache");
15298        }
15299        assert_eq!(
15300            Path::new(LD_SO_CACHE_PATH).try_exists().unwrap(),
15301            shares_ld_so_cache,
15302            "the qualification root's cache presence changed during the pair"
15303        );
15304        for directory in &directories {
15305            let actual = VerifyRunRecord::read(directory).unwrap();
15306            assert_eq!(actual.backend, "in-guest-trap");
15307            // The saved record uses DateTime::to_rfc3339(), which spells
15308            // the requested canonical UTC epoch with an explicit offset.
15309            assert_eq!(actual.epoch, "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00");
15310            assert!(
15311                matches!(
15312                    &actual.outcome,
15313                    VerifyRunOutcome::Completed {
15314                        status: RecordedStatus::Exited { code: 0 },
15315                        skid_overshoots: 0,
15316                        ..
15317                    }
15318                ),
15319                "{actual:?}"
15320            );
15321            assert_eq!(fs::read(directory.join("stdout")).unwrap(), INPUT);
15322            assert_eq!(fs::read(directory.join("stderr")).unwrap(), b"");
15323            assert!(!fs::read(directory.join("run.log")).unwrap().is_empty());
15324        }
15325        let bytes = fs::read(&report_path).unwrap();
15326        current_verification_report(&bytes).expect("complete current producer report");
15327        let verdict: JsonValue = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).unwrap();
15328        assert_eq!(
15329            verdict, record["inline_report"],
15330            "saved and inline reports must match in full"
15331        );
15332        assert_eq!(verdict["verdict"], "matched");
15333        assert_eq!(verdict["verified"], true);
15334        assert_eq!(verdict["bitwise_parity"], true);
15335        let policy = &verdict["comparison"];
15336        assert_eq!(policy["strictness"], "canonical");
15337        assert_eq!(policy["record_envelope"], "all_records_v1");
15338        assert_eq!(policy["log_scope"], "info");
15339        for field in [
15340            "compare_logs",
15341            "compare_io_buffers",
15342            "full_trace",
15343            "exact_remainder",
15344        ] {
15345            assert_eq!(policy[field], true, "{field}: {verdict}");
15346        }
15347        for field in ["strip_lines", "ignore_lines", "skip_commit", "skip_detlog"] {
15348            assert_eq!(policy[field], false, "{field}: {verdict}");
15349        }
15350        let compared = &verdict["compared_log_messages"];
15351        assert!(compared["left"].as_u64().is_some_and(|count| count > 0));
15352        assert_eq!(compared["left"], compared["right"]);
15353        for side in ["left", "right"] {
15354            let actual = &verdict["compared_outputs"][side];
15355            assert_eq!(actual["exit_code"], 0);
15356            assert!(actual["signal"].is_null());
15357            assert_eq!(actual["stdout_bytes"], INPUT.len());
15358            assert_eq!(actual["stdout_sha256"], hex_digest(INPUT));
15359            assert_eq!(actual["stderr_bytes"], 0);
15360            assert_eq!(actual["stderr_sha256"], hex_digest(b""));
15361        }
15362
15363        // A changed retained output must be rejected by the SAME production
15364        // log-diff. Preserve the original bytes beside the negative record.
15365        let changed = directories[1].join("stdout");
15366        fs::copy(&changed, root.join("run2.stdout.original")).unwrap();
15367        OpenOptions::new()
15368            .append(true)
15369            .open(&changed)
15370            .unwrap()
15371            .write_all(b"!")
15372            .unwrap();
15373        let refused_path = root.join("changed-output.json");
15374        let refused = Command::new(&hermit)
15375            .args(["log-diff", "--verify-json"])
15376            .arg(&refused_path)
15377            .args(&directories)
15378            .output()
15379            .unwrap();
15380        fs::write(root.join("changed-output.stdout"), &refused.stdout).unwrap();
15381        fs::write(root.join("changed-output.stderr"), &refused.stderr).unwrap();
15382        fs::write(
15383            root.join("changed-output.status"),
15384            format!("{:?}\n", refused.status),
15385        )
15386        .unwrap();
15387        assert!(!refused.status.success());
15388        let refused = current_verification_report(&fs::read(refused_path).unwrap()).unwrap();
15389        assert_eq!(refused.verdict, Verdict::Diverged);
15390        assert!(!refused.verified && !refused.bitwise_parity);
15391        check_inputs();
15392    }
15393    /// [`VERIFY_PAIR_SCRIPT`] follows `run --verify`: run 2 starts only when
15394    /// run 1 left a record with a status `--verify-allow` admits; a run that
15395    /// leaves no record ends the attempt with its own status and output, its
15396    /// stderr first, after the comparison has stamped its report; otherwise
15397    /// the comparison's status, stdout and stderr end it, after each run's
15398    /// stderr.
15399    #[test]
15400    fn the_paired_program_runs_and_compares_as_run_verify_does() {
15401        let root_dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
15402            "hermit-runner-paired-program-{}-{:?}",
15403            std::process::id(),
15404            std::thread::current().id()
15405        ));
15406        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root_dir);
15407        fs::create_dir_all(&root_dir).unwrap();
15408        struct Root(PathBuf);
15409        impl Root {
15410            fn path(&self) -> &Path {
15411                &self.0
15412            }
15413        }
15414        impl Drop for Root {
15415            fn drop(&mut self) {
15416                let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&self.0);
15417            }
15418        }
15419        let root = Root(root_dir);
15420        let hermit = root.path().join("hermit");
15421        // A run's behaviour is `$FAKE_RUN<n>`: `record:<status>` commits a
15422        // record and exits with the status, `refuse` exits 122 with a class
15423        // line and no record. Each call is logged.
15424        crate::exec_safe_fs::write_executable(
15425            &hermit,
15426            r#"#!/bin/sh
15427log="$(dirname "$0")/calls"
15428if [ "$1" = log-diff ]; then
15429  printf 'compare %s\n' "$*" >> "$log"
15430  echo "comparison stdout"
15431  echo "comparison stderr" >&2
15432  exit 9
15433fi
15434while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
15435  [ "$1" = --verify-run ] && directory=$2
15436  shift
15437done
15438n=$(grep -c '^run' "$log" 2>/dev/null)
15439n=$((n + 1))
15440printf 'run%s %s\n' "$n" "$directory" >> "$log"
15441eval "behaviour=\$FAKE_RUN$n"
15442echo "run $n stderr" >&2
15443case $behaviour in
15444  refuse) echo "HERMIT_POLICY_REFUSAL class=policy-refusal" >&2; exit 122 ;;
15445  record:*) mkdir "$directory"; : > "$directory/verify-run.json"; exit "${behaviour#record:}" ;;
15446esac
15447"#,
15448            0o755,
15449        )
15450        .unwrap();
15451        let hermit = hermit.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
15452        let pair = |label: &str, allow: Option<&str>, runs: [&str; 2]| {
15453            let runs_dir = root.path().join(label);
15454            fs::create_dir(&runs_dir).unwrap();
15455            let [first, second] = verify_run_directories(&runs_dir);
15456            let mut argv = vec![
15457                "-c".to_string(),
15458                VERIFY_PAIR_SCRIPT.into(),
15459                VERIFY_PAIR_NAME.into(),
15460                hermit.clone(),
15461                "log-diff".into(),
15462                "--verify-json".into(),
15463                "report.json".into(),
15464            ];
15465            argv.extend(allow.map(str::to_string));
15466            argv.extend([
15467                first.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
15468                second.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
15469                hermit.clone(),
15470                "run".into(),
15471                "--verify-run".into(),
15472                VERIFY_RUN_DIR_PLACEHOLDER.into(),
15473                "--".into(),
15474                "guest".into(),
15475            ]);
15476            let _ = fs::remove_file(root.path().join("calls"));
15477            let output = Command::new("bash")
15478                .args(&argv)
15479                .env("FAKE_RUN1", runs[0])
15480                .env("FAKE_RUN2", runs[1])
15481                .output()
15482                .unwrap();
15483            let calls = fs::read_to_string(root.path().join("calls")).unwrap();
15484            (output, calls, first, second)
15485        };
15486        let text = |bytes: &[u8]| String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes).into_owned();
15487
15488        // Both runs complete: the comparison ends the attempt.
15489        let (output, calls, first, second) = pair("both", None, ["record:0", "record:0"]);
15490        assert_eq!(output.status.code(), Some(9));
15491        assert_eq!(text(&output.stdout), "comparison stdout\n");
15492        assert_eq!(
15493            text(&output.stderr),
15494            "run 1 stderr\nrun 2 stderr\ncomparison stderr\n"
15495        );
15496        // Both runs are given one path, so they are one guest command line,
15497        // and each run's evidence then moves to its own directory.
15498        let staging = first.parent().unwrap().join("run");
15499        let lines: Vec<&str> = calls.lines().collect();
15500        assert_eq!(lines[0], format!("run1 {}", staging.display()));
15501        assert_eq!(lines[1], format!("run2 {}", staging.display()));
15502        assert!(lines[2].ends_with(&format!("{} {}", first.display(), second.display())));
15503        assert_eq!(lines.len(), 3);
15504        assert!(first.join("verify-run.json").exists() && second.join("verify-run.json").exists());
15505        assert!(!staging.exists());
15506
15507        // A status the allowance refuses: no run 2, as `run --verify`.
15508        let (output, calls, ..) = pair("rejected", None, ["record:3", "record:0"]);
15509        assert_eq!(output.status.code(), Some(9));
15510        assert_eq!(
15511            calls.lines().filter(|line| line.starts_with("run")).count(),
15512            1
15513        );
15514        // ... which `--verify-allow=failure` admits, and `both` too.
15515        for allow in ["--verify-allow=failure", "--verify-allow=both"] {
15516            let (_, calls, ..) = pair(allow, Some(allow), ["record:3", "record:3"]);
15517            assert_eq!(
15518                calls.lines().filter(|line| line.starts_with("run")).count(),
15519                2
15520            );
15521        }
15522
15523        // A refused run 1: its status and stderr, first line first, and the
15524        // comparison still stamps its report but says nothing.
15525        let (output, calls, ..) = pair("refused", None, ["refuse", "record:0"]);
15526        assert_eq!(output.status.code(), Some(122));
15527        assert_eq!(
15528            text(&output.stderr),
15529            "run 1 stderr\nHERMIT_POLICY_REFUSAL class=policy-refusal\n"
15530        );
15531        assert_eq!(text(&output.stdout), "");
15532        let lines: Vec<&str> = calls.lines().collect();
15533        assert_eq!(lines.len(), 2);
15534        assert!(lines[1].starts_with("compare "));
15535
15536        // A run 2 that leaves no record ends the attempt likewise.
15537        let (output, ..) = pair("refused-second", None, ["record:0", "refuse"]);
15538        assert_eq!(output.status.code(), Some(122));
15539    }

15541    #[test]
15542    fn a_verify_cell_carries_its_hermit_args_env_and_comparator() {
15543        let strict = extended_verify_spec(None);
15544        let at = |argv: &[String], arg: &str| argv.iter().position(|a| a == arg);
15545        let separator = at(&strict.argv, "--").unwrap();
15546        let flag = at(&strict.argv, "--no-virtualize-cpuid").unwrap();
15547        assert!(
15548            at(&strict.argv, "--strict").unwrap() < flag
15549                && flag < at(&strict.argv, "--verify-run").unwrap()
15550        );
15551        let env = strict
15552            .argv
15553            .windows(2)
15554            .position(|w| w == ["--env", "TMPDIR=/tmp"])
15555            .unwrap();
15556        let home = strict
15557            .argv
15558            .iter()
15559            .position(|a| a.starts_with("HOME="))
15560            .unwrap();
15561        assert!(home < env && env < separator, "{:?}", strict.argv);
15562        assert!(at(&strict.argv, "--verify-strict").is_some());
15563        assert_eq!(strict.comparator, Comparator::Strict);
15564
15565        let stripped = extended_verify_spec(Some(Comparator::Stripped));
15566        assert!(
15567            at(&stripped.argv, "--verify-strict").is_none(),
15568            "{:?}",
15569            stripped.argv
15570        );
15571        assert!(at(&stripped.argv, "--verify-run").is_some());
15572        assert_eq!(stripped.comparator, Comparator::Stripped);
15573    }

15605    /// The strict compatibility corpus ran each program as its own validation
15606    /// node with `hermit run --strict --verify --base-env=minimal
15607    /// --no-virtualize-cpuid --max-timeslice=disabled
15608    /// --mount=type=tmpfs,target=/test --workdir=/test --env TMPDIR=/tmp --
15609    /// <argv> </dev/null`. Fold 1 of
15610    /// https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/3448 moved it into
15611    /// compat.yaml; the shipped row, built the way the runner builds it under
15612    /// e2e.manifest_compat's HERMIT_E2E_EMPTY_WORKDIR=/test, still carries
15613    /// every one of those flags on a host at the relaxed strictness level,
15614    /// now with the strict comparator (--verify-strict, since 2026-10-07),
15615    /// and the guest argv with its run-owned fixture path. On a host at the
15616    /// strict level it carries neither relaxation: since 2026-10-13 the
15617    /// level, not the row, owns them
15618    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4276).
15619    /// manifest_corpus spells the default run type itself, for the
15620    /// rust-scripts that include it without this module.
15621    #[test]
15622    fn the_corpus_full_run_type_is_the_default_run_type() {
15623        assert_eq!(crate::manifest_corpus::FULL_RUN_TYPE, DEFAULT_RUN_TYPE);
15624    }

15627    fn a_shipped_compat_row_runs_at_the_hosts_strictness_level() {
15628        let root = crate::compiled_manifest_dir!().join("../..");
15629        let cells = ManifestSet::load(&root)
15630            .unwrap()
15631            .select(&Selection {
15632                test: Some("compat/cat".into()),
15633                // The lane's cell; the row's in-guest cells (the corpus's
15634                // `additional` backends) carry their own flags, and its replay
15635                // cell none of the verify settings.
15636                mode: Some("verify".into()),
15637                backend: Some("ptrace".into()),
15638                population: Some(Population::Required),
15639                ..Selection::default()
15640            })
15641            .unwrap();
15642        let [cell] = cells.as_slice() else {
15643            panic!("compat/cat must have exactly one ptrace CI cell: {cells:?}");
15644        };
15645        assert_eq!(
15646            (cell.id.mode.as_str(), cell.id.backend.as_deref()),
15647            ("verify", Some("ptrace"))
15648        );
15649        let DirectCommand::Argv(argv) = cell.test.direct.as_ref().unwrap() else {
15650            panic!("compat/cat must be a direct argv");
15651        };
15652        let guest = crate::manifest_corpus::resolve_direct_placeholders(
15653            &cell.test.id,
15654            argv,
15655            &root,
15656            Some(std::ffi::OsStr::new("/run-state")),
15657            None,
15658        )
15659        .unwrap();
15660        assert_eq!(
15661            guest,
15662            [
15663                "/bin/cat",
15664                "/run-state/strict-compat/real-compat-fixtures/README.md"
15665            ]
15666        );
15667        let context = RunContext {
15668            command_bindings: BTreeMap::new(),
15669            root: root.clone(),
15670            hermit_bin: PathBuf::from("/repo/hermit"),
15671            result_root: PathBuf::from("/repo/results"),
15672            build_root: PathBuf::from("/repo/build"),
15673            run_id: "fixture".into(),
15674            machine_shortname: "fixture-host".into(),
15675            kernel_version: "7.1.3-fixture".into(),
15676            host_capabilities: fixture_host_capabilities(),
15677            attempt: 1,
15678            run_index: None,
15679            epoch: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z".into(),
15680            source_sha: "0".repeat(40),
15681            binary_build_sha: None,
15682            source_dirty: false,
15683            prebuilt: true,
15684            keep_logs: false,
15685            capture_custom_runs: false,
15686            parity_retained: BTreeSet::new(),
15687            parity_compared: BTreeSet::new(),
15688            run_verify_strict: true,
15689            record_verify_strict: true,
15690            timeout_multipliers: TimeoutMultipliers::default(),
15691            scheduled_worker_capacity: ScheduledWorkerCapacity::new(1),
15692            isolated_workdir: Some(PathBuf::from("/test")),
15693            shares_ld_so_cache: false,
15694            exact_branch_counter: None,
15695            v2_retry_oci_dir: None,
15696        };
15697        let spec_on = |cell: &SelectedCell| {
15698            build_spec(
15699                &context,
15700                cell,
15701                PathBuf::from("/repo/results/cell"),
15702                guest.clone(),
15703                "1",
15704                None,
15705                cell.timeout_seconds,
15706            )
15707            .unwrap()
15708        };
15709        let strict_spec = spec_on(cell);
15710        for flag in RELAXED_LEVEL_ARGS {
15711            assert!(
15712                !strict_spec.argv.iter().any(|arg| arg == flag),
15713                "{flag} in {:?}",
15714                strict_spec.argv
15715            );
15716        }
15717        let mut relaxed_cell = cell.clone();
15718        relaxed_cell.host_level = HostLevel {
15719            level: StrictnessLevel::Relaxed,
15720            reason: Some("this host has no CPUID faulting (fixture)".into()),
15721        };
15722        let spec = spec_on(&relaxed_cell);
15723        let argv = &spec.argv;
15724        let at = |want: &[&str]| {
15725            argv.windows(want.len())
15726                .position(|window| window == want)
15727                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{want:?} missing from {argv:?}"))

15729        let separator = at(&["--"]);
15730        let ordered = [

15732            at(&["--base-env=minimal"]),
15733            at(&["--strict"]),
15734            at(&["--verify-strict"]),
15735            at(&["--no-virtualize-cpuid"]),
15736            at(&["--max-timeslice=disabled"]),
15737            at(&["--verify-run", VERIFY_RUN_DIR_PLACEHOLDER]),
15738            at(&["--mount=type=tmpfs,target=/test"]),

15744        assert_eq!(argv[separator + 1..], guest[..]);
15745        // The corpus is strict (2026-10-07), so a compat row is an L2
15746        // reference for the parity post-pass.
15747        assert_eq!(spec.comparator, Comparator::Strict);
15748        assert_eq!((cell.timeout_seconds, cell.cpu_timeout_seconds), (60, 59));
15749        // One attempt, as the generated node had; an ordinary cell retries.
15750        assert!(!retries_product_failures(cell));
15751        let ordinary = ManifestSet::load(&root)
15752            .unwrap()

15757                population: Some(Population::Required),

15764    /// The parity golden's profile follows the plan
15765    /// (`names_parity_golden_profile`): a test's ptrace verify run names
15766    /// x86-64-v2 exactly while the run plans it beside at least one candidate,
15767    /// so a test gains the flag with its first planned candidate and loses it
15768    /// with its last. Built as test-harness builds it, on the shipped
15769    /// manifests: the planned verify cells, `parity::planned_comparisons`,
15770    /// `RunContext::with_parity_compared`, beside the post-pass's retention
15771    /// closure, which does not enter it.
15772    #[test]
15773    fn a_ptrace_verify_names_x86_64_v2_exactly_while_the_plan_has_a_parity_candidate() {
15774        use crate::parity::ParityBackend;
15775        use crate::parity::ParityCellId;
15776        use crate::parity::ParityMatrix;
15777        use crate::parity::SideStatus;
15778        let root = crate::compiled_manifest_dir!().join("../..");
15779        let manifests = ManifestSet::load(&root).unwrap();
15780        let matrix = ParityMatrix::derive(&manifests).unwrap();
15781        // A population test whose kvm and liteinst candidates full validation
15782        // both runs, and which has a ptrace replay cell.
15783        let selected = |test: &str, backend| {
15784            matrix.candidate(&ParityCellId {
15785                test_id: test.into(),
15786                backend,
15787            }) == Some(&SideStatus::Selected)
15788        };
15789        let cells = |test: &str, mode: &str, backend: &str| {
15790            manifests
15791                .select(&Selection {
15792                    test: Some(test.into()),
15793                    mode: Some(mode.into()),
15794                    backend: Some(backend.into()),
15795                    ..Selection::default()
15796                })
15797                .unwrap()
15798        };
15799        let test = matrix
15800            .population()
15801            .into_iter()
15802            .map(|cell| cell.test_id)
15803            .find(|test| {
15804                selected(test, ParityBackend::Kvm)
15805                    && selected(test, ParityBackend::Liteinst)
15806                    && cells(test, "replay", "ptrace").len() == 1
15807            })
15808            .expect("a population test with selected kvm and liteinst candidates and a replay");
15809        let cell = |mode: &str, backend: &str| {
15810            let found = cells(&test, mode, backend);
15811            let [cell] = found.as_slice() else {
15812                panic!("{test}/{mode}@{backend} is not exactly one cell: {found:?}");
15813            };
15814            cell.clone()
15815        };
15816        let scratch = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
15817            "hermit-parity-golden-profile-{}-{:?}",
15818            std::process::id(),
15819            std::thread::current().id()
15820        ));
15821        let plan = |backends: &[&str]| {
15822            backends
15823                .iter()
15824                .map(|backend| (test.clone(), backend.to_string()))
15825                .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>()
15826        };
15827        // The context test-harness builds for a plan.
15828        let context_for = |planned: &BTreeSet<(String, String)>| {
15829            let scope = crate::parity::resolve_scope(&manifests, None, planned).unwrap();
15830            run_context(&scratch)
15831                .with_parity_retained(crate::parity::retention_closure(&scope.cells, planned))
15832                .with_parity_compared(crate::parity::planned_comparisons(planned))
15833        };
15834        // Whether the cell's argv names the golden's profile; where it does,
15835        // once, right after the manifest flag.
15836        let names = |context: &RunContext, cell: &SelectedCell| {
15837            let argv = build_spec(
15838                context,
15839                cell,
15840                scratch.join("cell"),
15841                vec!["/bin/true".into()],
15842                "1",
15843                None,
15844                3,
15845            )
15846            .unwrap()
15847            .argv;
15848            let named = argv
15849                .iter()
15850                .filter(|arg| *arg == PARITY_GOLDEN_PROFILE_ARG)
15851                .count();
15852            assert!(named <= 1, "{argv:?}");
15853            if named == 1 {
15854                assert!(
15855                    argv.windows(2).any(|pair| pair[0]
15856                        == crate::cpu_profile_record::MANIFEST_ALWAYS_ARG
15857                        && pair[1] == PARITY_GOLDEN_PROFILE_ARG),
15858                    "{argv:?}"
15859                );
15860            }
15861            named == 1
15862        };
15863        let ptrace = cell("verify", "ptrace");
15864        let pins = |backends: &[&str]| names(&context_for(&plan(backends)), &ptrace);
15865
15866        // Only the reference planned: nothing to compare it with, so auto.
15867        assert!(!pins(&["ptrace"]), "{test}");
15868        // It gains the pin with a candidate, kvm or liteinst alike...
15869        assert!(pins(&["ptrace", "kvm"]), "{test}");
15870        assert!(pins(&["ptrace", "liteinst"]), "{test}");
15871        assert!(pins(&["ptrace", "kvm", "liteinst"]), "{test}");
15872        // ...and loses it with its last candidate.
15873        assert!(!pins(&["ptrace"]), "{test}");
15874        // Its candidates, which keep auto's x86-64-v2 and its reason, and a
15875        // candidate planned without its reference, name nothing.
15876        let compared = context_for(&plan(&["ptrace", "kvm"]));
15877        assert!(!names(&compared, &cell("verify", "kvm")), "{test}");
15878        assert!(!names(
15879            &context_for(&plan(&["kvm"])),
15880            &cell("verify", "kvm")
15881        ));
15882        // Its replay is not compared across backends.
15883        assert!(!names(&compared, &cell("replay", "ptrace")), "{test}");
15884        // With the post-pass off nothing is retained, and the run is the same:
15885        // the profile follows the plan, never a switch that changes only the
15886        // report (test-harness's
15887        // the_parity_post_pass_changes_no_determinism_output_and_runs_no_guest).
15888        let off = run_context(&scratch).with_parity_compared(crate::parity::planned_comparisons(
15889            &plan(&["ptrace", "kvm"]),
15890        ));
15891        assert!(off.parity_retained.is_empty());
15892        assert!(names(&off, &ptrace), "{test}");
15893        // No plan, no flag.
15894        assert!(!names(&run_context(&scratch), &ptrace), "{test}");
15895        // At the relaxed level the run presents the host's CPUID: no profile.
15896        let mut relaxed = ptrace.clone();
15897        relaxed.host_level = relaxed_host();
15898        assert!(!names(&compared, &relaxed), "{test}");
15899    }

15901    /// A replay cell's product failure is a divergence between a recording
15902    /// and its replay, or a recording that did not complete; a fresh
15903    /// recording on a retry does not answer for the first, so the cell gets
15904    /// one attempt, as the retired rr lane gave each program. The same test's
15905    /// verify cell keeps its retry.
15906    #[test]
15907    fn a_replay_cell_is_not_retried_after_a_product_failure() {
15908        let root = crate::compiled_manifest_dir!().join("../..");
15909        let manifests = ManifestSet::load(&root).unwrap();
15910        let cell = |mode: &str| {
15911            let mut cells = manifests
15912                .select(&Selection {
15913                    test: Some("c-programs/random-readv-stream".into()),
15914                    mode: Some(mode.into()),
15915                    backend: Some("ptrace".into()),
15916                    population: Some(Population::Required),
15917                    ..Selection::default()
15918                })
15919                .unwrap();
15920            assert_eq!(cells.len(), 1, "{mode}: {cells:?}");
15921            cells.remove(0)
15922        };
15923        let replay = cell("replay");
15924        assert_eq!(replay.id.mode, "replay");
15925        // The replay cell declares no no_retry_reason (a replay mode may not),
15926        // so only its mode makes it final.
15927        assert!(replay.test.modes["replay"].no_retry_reason.is_none());
15928        assert!(!retries_product_failures(&replay));
15929        assert!(retries_product_failures(&cell("verify")));
15930    }

15932    use super::PRODUCER_STRIPPED_REPORT;
15933
15934    /// A ptrace dispatch record that satisfies [`dispatch_record_error`].
15935    fn ptrace_dispatch_record() -> detcore_model::summary::DispatchStats {
15936        serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({
15937            "schema_version": 1,
15938            "backend": "ptrace",
15939            "counters": {
15940                "signal_traps": 0,
15941                "patched_direct_calls": 0,
15942                "ptrace_seccomp_stops": 40,
15943                "ptrace_sigtrap_stops": 0,
15944                "sigill_marker_hits": 0,
15945                "ptrace_syscall_entry_stops": 0,
15946                "ptrace_syscall_exit_stops": 0,
15947                "refusals": 0
15948            },
15949            "sites": {"candidates": 0, "patched": 0, "fell_back": 0}
15950        }))
15951        .unwrap()
15952    }
15953
15954    /// The producer report above predates the dispatch record; a current
15955    /// ptrace run carries one in each run's runtime.
15956    fn with_ptrace_dispatch(mut report: VerificationReport) -> VerificationReport {
15957        let runtime = report.runtime.as_mut().unwrap();
15958        for stats in [runtime.run1.as_mut(), runtime.run2.as_mut()] {
15959            stats.unwrap().dispatch = Some(ptrace_dispatch_record());
15960        }
15961        report
15962    }
15963
15964    #[test]
15965    fn a_passing_patching_backend_report_must_carry_a_consistent_dispatch_record() {
15966        let current = with_ptrace_dispatch(serde_json::from_str(PRODUCER_STRIPPED_REPORT).unwrap());
15967        let pass = attempt_with_report(None, Comparator::Stripped, current.clone(), "exit 0", 5);
15968        assert_eq!(pass.outcome, "PASS", "{:?}", pass.reason);
15969        assert_eq!(
15970            pass.runtime
15971                .as_ref()
15972                .unwrap()
15973                .run2
15974                .as_ref()
15975                .unwrap()
15976                .dispatch,
15977            Some(ptrace_dispatch_record())
15978        );
15979
15980        let refused = |report: VerificationReport, expected: &str| {
15981            let result = attempt_with_report(None, Comparator::Stripped, report, "exit 0", 5);
15982            assert_eq!(result.outcome, "ERROR", "{:?}", result.reason);
15983            assert_eq!(
15984                result.error_kind.as_deref(),
15985                Some("incomplete-verification-evidence")
15986            );
15987            assert!(
15988                result
15989                    .reason
15990                    .as_deref()
15991                    .is_some_and(|reason| reason.contains(expected)),
15992                "{:?}",
15993                result.reason
15994            );
15995        };
15996        let mut missing = current.clone();
15997        missing
15998            .runtime
15999            .as_mut()
16000            .unwrap()
16001            .run2
16002            .as_mut()
16003            .unwrap()
16004            .dispatch = None;
16005        refused(missing, "runtime.run2 carries no ptrace dispatch record");
16006        let mut relabeled = current.clone();
16007        relabeled
16008            .runtime
16009            .as_mut()
16010            .unwrap()
16011            .run1
16012            .as_mut()
16013            .unwrap()
16014            .dispatch
16015            .as_mut()
16016            .unwrap()
16017            .backend = "liteinst".into();
16018        refused(relabeled, "names backend liteinst, expected ptrace");
16019        let mut impossible = current.clone();
16020        impossible
16021            .runtime
16022            .as_mut()
16023            .unwrap()
16024            .run1
16025            .as_mut()
16026            .unwrap()
16027            .dispatch
16028            .as_mut()
16029            .unwrap()
16030            .sites
16031            .patched = Some(1);
16032        refused(impossible, "exceeds candidates 0");
16033
16034        // A failing comparison keeps its own classification.
16035        let mut diverged = current;
16036        diverged.verified = false;
16037        diverged.verdict = Verdict::Diverged;
16038        diverged
16039            .runtime
16040            .as_mut()
16041            .unwrap()
16042            .run1
16043            .as_mut()
16044            .unwrap()
16045            .dispatch = None;
16046        let fail = attempt_with_report(None, Comparator::Stripped, diverged, "exit 1", 5);
16047        assert_eq!(fail.outcome, "FAIL", "{:?}", fail.reason);
16048
16049        // Backends without a record are not held to one.
16050        let historical: VerificationReport =
16051            serde_json::from_str(PRODUCER_STRIPPED_REPORT).unwrap();
16052        assert_eq!(
16053            dispatch_record_error("kvm", historical.runtime.as_ref()),
16054            None
16055        );
16056        assert_eq!(
16057            dispatch_record_error("dbt", historical.runtime.as_ref()),
16058            None
16059        );
16060        assert_eq!(dispatch_record_error("ptrace", None), None);
16061        assert!(dispatch_record_error("sabre", historical.runtime.as_ref()).is_some());
16062    }
