16064    /// An in-guest-trap run must patch no syscall site: a passing report whose
16065    /// dispatch record names in-guest-trap and reports a patched site is
16066    /// refused, and the same record under liteinst, which patches by design,
16067    /// is not.
16068    #[test]
16069    fn an_in_guest_trap_dispatch_record_must_report_no_patched_site() {
16070        let record = |backend: &str, patched: u64| {
16071            let mut record = ptrace_dispatch_record();
16072            record.backend = backend.into();
16073            record.counters.ptrace_seccomp_stops = Some(0);
16074            record.counters.signal_traps = Some(40);
16075            record.sites.candidates = Some(patched);
16076            record.sites.patched = Some(patched);
16077            record
16078        };
16079        let report = |backend: &str, run2_patched: u64| {
16080            let mut report: VerificationReport =
16081                serde_json::from_str(PRODUCER_STRIPPED_REPORT).unwrap();
16082            let runtime = report.runtime.as_mut().unwrap();
16083            runtime.run1.as_mut().unwrap().dispatch = Some(record(backend, 0));
16084            runtime.run2.as_mut().unwrap().dispatch = Some(record(backend, run2_patched));
16085            report
16086        };
16087        assert_eq!(
16088            dispatch_record_error("in-guest-trap", report("in-guest-trap", 0).runtime.as_ref()),
16089            None
16090        );
16091        let error =
16092            dispatch_record_error("in-guest-trap", report("in-guest-trap", 3).runtime.as_ref())
16093                .expect("a patched site under in-guest-trap is refused");
16094        assert!(
16095            error.contains("runtime.run2 in-guest-trap dispatch record reports 3 patched"),
16096            "{error}"
16097        );
16098        // Missing or partial evidence cannot show zero patched sites.
16099        assert!(
16100            dispatch_record_error("in-guest-trap", None)
16101                .is_some_and(|error| error.contains("carries no runtime"))
16102        );
16103        for missing in ["run1", "run2"] {
16104            let mut partial = report("in-guest-trap", 0);
16105            let runtime = partial.runtime.as_mut().unwrap();
16106            if missing == "run1" {
16107                runtime.run1 = None;
16108            } else {
16109                runtime.run2 = None;
16110            }
16111            let error = dispatch_record_error("in-guest-trap", partial.runtime.as_ref())
16112                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("a report without {missing} was accepted"));
16113            assert!(
16114                error.contains(&format!("runtime.{missing} is missing")),
16115                "{error}"
16116            );
16117            let mut no_record = report("in-guest-trap", 0);
16118            let runtime = no_record.runtime.as_mut().unwrap();
16119            let stats = if missing == "run1" {
16120                runtime.run1.as_mut()
16121            } else {
16122                runtime.run2.as_mut()
16123            };
16124            stats.unwrap().dispatch = None;
16125            let error = dispatch_record_error("in-guest-trap", no_record.runtime.as_ref())
16126                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("a {missing} without a dispatch record was accepted"));
16127            assert!(
16128                error.contains(&format!(
16129                    "runtime.{missing} carries no in-guest-trap dispatch record"
16130                )),
16131                "{error}"
16132            );
16133        }
16134        // A candidate without a patch is evidence of patching too.
16135        let mut candidate = report("in-guest-trap", 0);
16136        let record = candidate
16137            .runtime
16138            .as_mut()
16139            .unwrap()
16140            .run1
16141            .as_mut()
16142            .unwrap()
16143            .dispatch
16144            .as_mut()
16145            .unwrap();
16146        record.sites.candidates = Some(1);
16147        record.sites.fell_back = Some(1);
16148        assert!(
16149            dispatch_record_error("in-guest-trap", candidate.runtime.as_ref())
16150                .is_some_and(|error| error.contains("0 patched and 1 candidate"))
16151        );
16152        // An empty record, as from guests whose statistics were suppressed,
16153        // measured nothing.
16154        let mut empty = report("in-guest-trap", 0);
16155        empty
16156            .runtime
16157            .as_mut()
16158            .unwrap()
16159            .run2
16160            .as_mut()
16161            .unwrap()
16162            .dispatch
16163            .as_mut()
16164            .unwrap()
16165            .counters
16166            .signal_traps = Some(0);
16167        assert!(
16168            dispatch_record_error("in-guest-trap", empty.runtime.as_ref()).is_some_and(|error| {
16169                error.contains(
16170                    "runtime.run2 in-guest-trap dispatch record \
16171                     counts 0 signal traps",
16172                )
16173            })
16174        );
16175        // The other backends keep their leniency for absent evidence.
16176        assert_eq!(dispatch_record_error("liteinst", None), None);
16177        let mut liteinst_partial = report("liteinst", 0);
16178        liteinst_partial.runtime.as_mut().unwrap().run2 = None;
16179        assert_eq!(
16180            dispatch_record_error("liteinst", liteinst_partial.runtime.as_ref()),
16181            None
16182        );
16183        // A liteinst record under the in-guest-trap name is refused by name.
16184        assert!(
16185            dispatch_record_error("in-guest-trap", report("liteinst", 0).runtime.as_ref())
16186                .is_some_and(|error| error.contains("names backend liteinst"))
16187        );
16188        assert_eq!(
16189            dispatch_record_error("liteinst", report("liteinst", 3).runtime.as_ref()),
16190            None
16191        );
16192    }

16194    #[test]
16195    fn a_stripped_cell_passes_only_a_matched_report_and_a_strict_one_still_needs_canonical() {
16196        let matched = with_ptrace_dispatch(serde_json::from_str(PRODUCER_STRIPPED_REPORT).unwrap());
16197        assert_eq!(
16198            matched.comparison.as_ref().unwrap().strictness,
16199            crate::canonical_verdict::LogCompareStrictness::Stripped
16200        );
16201        let pass = attempt_with_report(None, Comparator::Stripped, matched.clone(), "exit 0", 5);
16202        assert_eq!(pass.outcome, "PASS", "{:?}", pass.reason);
16203        // The same below-L2 report never passes a strict cell.
16204        let strict = attempt_with_report(None, Comparator::Strict, matched.clone(), "exit 0", 5);
16205        assert_ne!(strict.outcome, "PASS", "{:?}", strict.reason);
16206
16207        // A report without the declared, non-empty stripped comparison is
16208        // incomplete evidence, not a pass.
16209        for vacuous in [
16210            {
16211                let mut report = matched.clone();
16212                report.compared_log_messages.as_mut().unwrap().left = 0;
16213                report
16214            },
16215            {
16216                let mut report = matched.clone();
16217                report.comparison.as_mut().unwrap().compare_logs = false;
16218                report
16219            },
16220            {
16221                let mut report = matched.clone();
16222                report.comparison.as_mut().unwrap().strictness =
16223                    crate::canonical_verdict::LogCompareStrictness::Canonical;
16224                report
16225            },
16226            {
16227                let mut report = matched.clone();
16228                report.compared_log_messages.as_mut().unwrap().right = 0;
16229                report
16230            },
16231            // Without virtual time it is not the comparison a verify cell runs.
16232            {
16233                let mut report = matched.clone();
16234                report.comparison.as_mut().unwrap().virtualize_time = Some(false);
16235                report
16236            },
16237        ] {
16238            let result = attempt_with_report(None, Comparator::Stripped, vacuous, "exit 0", 5);
16239            assert_eq!(result.outcome, "ERROR", "{:?}", result.reason);
16240            assert!(
16241                result
16242                    .reason
16243                    .as_deref()
16244                    .is_some_and(|reason| reason.contains("non-vacuous stripped evidence")),
16245                "{:?}",
16246                result.reason
16247            );
16248        }
16249
16250        let mut uncompared = matched.clone();
16251        uncompared.comparison = None;
16252        let result = attempt_with_report(None, Comparator::Stripped, uncompared, "exit 0", 5);
16253        assert_eq!(result.outcome, "ERROR", "{:?}", result.reason);
16254
16255        // Matched logs with different outputs is not a pass either: the
16256        // report reader already refuses such a report as unreadable evidence.
16257        let mut outputs_differ = matched.clone();
16258        outputs_differ
16259            .compared_outputs
16260            .as_mut()
16261            .unwrap()
16262            .right
16263            .stdout_bytes += 1;
16264        let result = attempt_with_report(None, Comparator::Stripped, outputs_differ, "exit 0", 5);
16265        assert_eq!(result.outcome, "ERROR", "{:?}", result.reason);
16266        assert!(
16267            result
16268                .reason
16269                .as_deref()
16270                .is_some_and(|reason| reason.contains("operands differ")),
16271            "{:?}",
16272            result.reason
16273        );
16274
16275        let mut diverged = matched;
16276        diverged.verified = false;
16277        diverged.verdict = Verdict::Diverged;
16278        let fail = attempt_with_report(None, Comparator::Stripped, diverged, "exit 1", 5);
16279        assert_eq!(fail.outcome, "FAIL");
16280        assert_eq!(
16281            fail.reason.as_deref(),
16282            Some("stripped verification did not match: verified=false verdict=diverged")
16283        );
16284    }

16286    /// ⚠️ "NO CELLS" AND "NO SUCH TEST" ARE DIFFERENT ANSWERS, AND `select` GIVES
16287    /// THE SAME EMPTY VECTOR FOR BOTH. Measured 2026-08-26 before this existed:
16288    /// `test-harness plan --lane portable --test no-such-test-xyz` printed nothing and
16289    /// exited 0 -- and so did the same command with a REAL id, so the exit code
16290    /// carried no information either way and anything bisecting off `plan` read a typo
16291    /// as "nothing failed here".
16292    ///
16293    /// The fix could NOT be `cells.is_empty()`, which is why this predicate exists:
16294    /// `print_plan` also serves `audit-gaps`, where empty legitimately means NO GAPS.
16295    /// Measured on the same head, a real id filtered to a lane it has no cells in
16296    /// (`--lane privileged --test applications/c-toolchain-workflow`) prints `[]` and
16297    /// exits 0 -- a correct, well-formed query that an emptiness guard would refuse.
16298    #[test]
16299    fn knows_test_separates_an_absent_id_from_an_empty_population() {
16300        let test = recipe(false);
16301        let id = test.id.clone();
16302        let set = ManifestSet {
16303            documents: Vec::new(),
16304            tests: BTreeMap::from([(
16305                id.clone(),
16306                ("fixture".into(), 15, DEFAULT_TEST_CPU_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, test),
16307            )]),
16308        };
16309        assert!(set.knows_test(&id), "a declared test must be known");
16310        assert!(
16311            !set.knows_test("no-such-test-xyz"),
16312            "an id in no manifest must NOT be known -- this is the typo a bisect would \
16313             otherwise read as a pass"
16314        );
16315        // The control that makes the pair meaningful: the KNOWN id still selects zero
16316        // cells in the Required population, so emptiness and unknown-ness genuinely
16317        // come apart here rather than only in principle.
16318        assert!(
16319            set.select(&Selection {
16320                population: Some(Population::Required),
16321                ..Selection::default()
16322            })
16323            .unwrap()
16324            .is_empty(),
16325            "fixture must be empty in Required, or this test proves nothing"
16326        );
16327    }

16357    /// The guest of an equalized verify cell names only guest paths, and each
16358    /// of the cell's input directories is bound at the path it names.
16359    fn assert_equalized_guest_env(argv: &[String], dir: &str, tmp: &str, jobs: &str) {
16360        let argv = without_mapped_input_holder(argv);
16361        assert_minimal_base_env(argv);
16362        assert_eq!(
16363            guest_env_args(argv),
16364            vec![
16365                "LC_ALL=C".to_string(),
16366                "TZ=UTC".to_string(),
16367                "HOME=/tmp/e2e/home".to_string(),
16368                "XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/e2e/xdg-config".to_string(),
16369                format!("E2E_TMPDIR={tmp}"),
16370                "E2E_FIXTURE_DIR=/tmp/e2e/fixtures".to_string(),
16371                format!("HERMIT_E2E_SCHEDULED_JOBS={jobs}"),
16372            ],
16373            "the guest environment is an exact allowlist; an added, removed, or inherited name is a regression"
16374        );
16375        let separator = argv.iter().position(|arg| arg == "--").unwrap();
16376        let binds = argv[..separator]
16377            .iter()
16378            .filter(|arg| arg.starts_with("--bind=") && arg.contains(EQUALIZED_INPUT_ROOT))
16379            .cloned()
16380            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
16381        assert_eq!(
16382            binds,
16383            [
16384                format!("--bind={dir}/home:/tmp/e2e/home"),
16385                format!("--bind={dir}/xdg-config:/tmp/e2e/xdg-config"),
16386                format!("--bind={dir}/fixtures:/tmp/e2e/fixtures"),
16387            ],
16388            "{argv:?}"
16389        );
16390        assert!(
16391            !argv[..separator]
16392                .iter()
16393                .any(|arg| arg.contains(&format!("={dir}/")) && !arg.starts_with("--bind=")),
16394            "no guest environment value names a host cell path: {argv:?}"
16395        );
16396    }

16398    fn assert_minimal_base_env(argv: &[String]) {
16399        let mut base_env = Vec::new();
16400        let mut index = 0;
16401        while index < argv.len() {
16402            if let Some(value) = argv[index].strip_prefix("--base-env=") {
16403                base_env.push(value.to_string());
16404            } else if argv[index] == "--base-env" {
16405                index += 1;
16406                base_env.push(argv[index].clone());
16407            }
16408            index += 1;
16409        }
16410        assert_eq!(
16411            base_env,
16412            ["minimal"],
16413            "every hermetic Hermit cell must select the minimal base environment exactly once: {argv:?}"
16414        );
16415    }

16551    #[test]
16552    fn retained_custom_runs_adopt_guest_output_without_extra_invocations() {
16553        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
16554            "hermit-runner-custom-capture-{}-{:?}",
16555            std::process::id(),
16556            std::thread::current().id()
16557        ));
16558        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
16559        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
16560        // This is the producer's schema1 wire representation, including a
16561        // completed status. The uncaptured route is valid too: the RED must
16562        // be the missing capture, not a failed fixture invocation.
16563        fs::write(
16564            root.join("record.json"),
16565            r#"{"schema":1,"backend":"ptrace","comparison":{"strictness":"canonical","diagnostic_full_trace":false,"compare_io_buffers":true,"virtualize_time":true},"passthru_opt":false,"epoch":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","outcome":{"kind":"completed","status":{"kind":"exited","code":0},"skid_overshoots":0}}"#,
16566        )
16567        .unwrap();
16568        crate::exec_safe_fs::write_executable(
16569            root.join("hermit"),
16570            r#"#!/bin/sh
16571set -eu
16572stage=
16573while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
16574  case "$1" in
16575    --verify-run) stage=$2; shift 2 ;;
16576    *) shift ;;
16577  esac
16578done
16579printf '%s\n' "${stage:-ordinary}" >> "$PWD/invocations"
16580printf 'launcher output\n'
16581if [ -n "$stage" ]; then
16582  mkdir "$stage"
16583  printf 'guest output\n' > "$stage/stdout"
16584  : > "$stage/stderr"
16585  printf 'INFO detcore: fixture\n' > "$stage/run.log"
16586  cp "$PWD/record.json" "$stage/verify-run.json"
16587fi
16588"#,
16589            0o755,
16590        )
16591        .unwrap();
16592        let mut context = run_context(&root);
16593        context.capture_custom_runs = true;
16594        let mut cell = ptrace_cell("custom");
16595        cell.test.id = "fixture/custom-capture".into();
16596        cell.id.test = cell.test.id.clone();
16597        cell.timeout_seconds = 57;
16598        cell.test.observation.stderr = false;
16599        let mode = cell.test.modes.get_mut("custom").unwrap();
16600        mode.args = vec!["--strict".into(), "--max-timeslice=disabled".into()];
16601        mode.assert = Some(Assertions {
16602            runs: Some(3),
16603            repeat_identical: Some(true),
16604            ..Assertions::default()
16605        });
16606
16607        let result = run_cell(&context, &cell).unwrap();
16608        assert_eq!(result.outcome, "PASS", "{result:?}");
16609        assert_eq!(result.attempts.len(), 3);
16610        let capture = Path::new(&result.artifact_dir).join("custom-capture");
16611        for index in 1..=3 {
16612            let retained = capture.join("retained").join(index.to_string());
16613            assert!(
16614                retained.join("verify-run.json").is_file(),
16615                "custom repetition {index} did not retain its completed producer capture"
16616            );
16617            assert_eq!(
16618                fs::read(retained.join("stdout")).unwrap(),
16619                b"guest output\n"
16620            );
16621            assert_eq!(result.attempts[index - 1].stdout, "guest output\n");
16622            assert_eq!(
16623                fs::read(
16624                    Path::new(&result.artifact_dir).join(format!("captures/custom-{index}.stdout"))
16625                )
16626                .unwrap(),
16627                b"launcher output\n"
16628            );
16629        }
16630        assert!(!capture.join("run").exists());
16631        let invocations = fs::read_to_string(root.join("invocations")).unwrap();
16632        let paths = invocations.lines().collect::<Vec<_>>();
16633        assert_eq!(paths.len(), 3);
16634        assert_eq!(paths[0], capture.join("run").to_str().unwrap());
16635        assert!(paths.iter().all(|path| *path == paths[0]));
16636        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
16637    }

16639    fn custom_capture_control_fixture(
16640        label: &str,
16641        scenario: &str,
16642    ) -> (PathBuf, RunContext, SelectedCell) {
16643        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
16644            "hermit-custom-capture-control-{label}-{}-{:?}",
16645            std::process::id(),
16646            std::thread::current().id()
16647        ));
16648        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
16649        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
16650        fs::write(root.join("scenario"), scenario).unwrap();
16651        fs::write(
16652            root.join("record.json"),
16653            r#"{"schema":1,"backend":"ptrace","comparison":{"strictness":"canonical","diagnostic_full_trace":false,"compare_io_buffers":true,"virtualize_time":true},"passthru_opt":false,"epoch":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","outcome":{"kind":"completed","status":{"kind":"exited","code":0},"skid_overshoots":0}}"#,
16654        )
16655        .unwrap();
16656        crate::exec_safe_fs::write_executable(
16657            root.join("hermit"),
16658            r#"#!/bin/sh
16659    set -eu
16660    stage=
16661    while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
16662      case "$1" in
16663        --verify-run) stage=$2; shift 2 ;;
16664        *) shift ;;
16665      esac
16666    done
16667    count=0
16668    if [ -f "$PWD/count" ]; then count=$(cat "$PWD/count"); fi
16669    count=$((count + 1))
16670    printf '%s\n' "$count" > "$PWD/count"
16671    printf '%s\n' "${stage:-ordinary}" >> "$PWD/invocations"
16672    # A closed /dev/null stdin is part of the unchanged invocation contract.
16673    if IFS= read -r unexpected; then
16674      printf 'unexpected input on stdin\n' >&2
16675      exit 92
16676    fi
16677    scenario=$(cat "$PWD/scenario")
16678    if [ "$scenario" = ordinary-error ]; then
16679      printf 'ordinary outcome %s\n' "$count"
16680      printf 'HERMIT_INTERNAL_FAILURE class=cli-error\n' >&2
16681      exit 7
16682    fi
16683    printf 'launcher output\n'
16684    if [ "$scenario" = classified-stderr ]; then
16685      printf 'HERMIT_INTERNAL_FAILURE class=cli-error\n' >&2
16686    else
16687      printf 'launcher diagnostics\n' >&2
16688    fi
16689    if [ -z "$stage" ]; then exit 0; fi
16690    mkdir "$stage"
16691    printf 'guest output\n' > "$stage/stdout"
16692    : > "$stage/stderr"
16693    printf 'INFO detcore: fixture\n' > "$stage/run.log"
16694    cp "$PWD/record.json" "$stage/verify-run.json"
16695    case "$scenario" in
16696      stdout-same|stdout-different|stderr-same|stderr-different)
16697        stream=${scenario%%-*}
16698        if [ "${scenario#*-}" = different ] && [ "$count" -eq 2 ]; then
16699          printf '\376\n' > "$stage/$stream"
16700        else
16701          printf '\377\n' > "$stage/$stream"
16702        fi
16703        ;;
16704      malformed-record) printf '{' > "$stage/verify-run.json" ;;
16705      missing-record) rm "$stage/verify-run.json" ;;
16706      missing-stdout) rm "$stage/stdout" ;;
16707      missing-stderr) rm "$stage/stderr" ;;
16708      missing-log) rm "$stage/run.log" ;;
16709      classified-stderr)
16710        printf 'HERMIT_INTERNAL_FAILURE class=backend-unavailable backend=dbt\n' > "$stage/stderr"
16711        exit 7 ;;
16712      controller-failure) exit 7 ;;
16713      good) ;;
16714      *) printf 'unknown fixture scenario\n' >&2; exit 93 ;;
16715    esac
16716    "#,
16717            0o755,
16718        )
16719        .unwrap();
16720        let context = run_context(&root);
16721        let mut cell = ptrace_cell("custom");
16722        cell.test.id = format!("fixture/custom-capture-{label}");
16723        cell.id.test = cell.test.id.clone();
16724        cell.timeout_seconds = 57;
16725        cell.test.observation.status = true;
16726        cell.test.observation.stdout = true;
16727        cell.test.observation.stderr = false;
16728        let mode = cell.test.modes.get_mut("custom").unwrap();
16729        mode.args = vec!["--strict".into(), "--max-timeslice=disabled".into()];
16730        mode.assert = Some(Assertions {
16731            runs: Some(3),
16732            repeat_identical: Some(true),
16733            ..Assertions::default()
16734        });
16735        (root, context, cell)
16736    }

16738    #[test]
16739    fn custom_capture_ordinary_and_keep_logs_only_keep_the_original_route() {
16740        for keep_logs in [false, true] {
16741            let label = if keep_logs {
16742                "keep-logs-only"
16743            } else {
16744                "ordinary"
16745            };
16746            let (root, mut context, cell) = custom_capture_control_fixture(label, "good");
16747            context.keep_logs = keep_logs;
16748            assert!(!context.capture_custom_runs);

16750                &context,
16751                &cell,
16752                root.join("spec"),

16755                None,
16756                57,
16757            )
16758            .unwrap();
16759            context.keep_logs = !keep_logs;
16760            let other_spec = build_spec(
16761                &context,
16762                &cell,
16763                root.join("spec"),
16764                vec!["/bin/true".into()],
16765                "1",
16766                None,
16767                57,
16768            )
16769            .unwrap();

16771            assert_eq!(spec.env, other_spec.env);
16772            assert_eq!(spec.cwd, other_spec.cwd);
16773            assert!(!spec.argv.iter().any(|arg| arg == "--verify-run"));
16774            context.keep_logs = keep_logs;

16803                    && attempt.status == Some(7)
16804                    && !attempt.capture_custom_runs
16805            }));
16806            // Preserve the pre-capture custom repeat assertion, including its
16807            // classification of distinct ordinary ERROR observations as FAIL.

16811                Some("custom observed 3 distinct outcomes")

16814                fs::read_to_string(root.join("invocations")).unwrap(),
16815                "ordinary\nordinary\nordinary\n"

16817            assert!(

16820                    .exists()

16826    #[test]
16827    fn custom_capture_raw_non_utf8_observations_are_not_display_strings() {
16828        for stream in ["stdout", "stderr"] {
16829            for different in [false, true] {
16830                let scenario = format!("{stream}-{}", if different { "different" } else { "same" });
16831                let (root, mut context, mut cell) =
16832                    custom_capture_control_fixture(&scenario, &scenario);
16833                context.capture_custom_runs = true;
16834                // Cover each original observation switch separately. The other
16835                // stream remains constant and cannot explain the differing hash.
16836                cell.test.observation.stdout = stream == "stdout";
16837                cell.test.observation.stderr = stream == "stderr";
16838                let result = run_cell(&context, &cell).unwrap();
16839                assert_eq!(result.attempts.len(), 3);
16840                assert_eq!(
16841                    result.outcome,
16842                    if different { "FAIL" } else { "PASS" },
16843                    "{result:?}"
16844                );
16845                let hashes = result
16846                    .attempts
16847                    .iter()
16848                    .map(|attempt| attempt.observation_sha256.as_ref().unwrap())
16849                    .collect::<Vec<_>>();
16850                assert_eq!(hashes[0], hashes[2]);
16851                if different {
16852                    assert_ne!(
16853                        hashes[0], hashes[1],
16854                        "invalid bytes must not collapse to lossy UTF-8"
16855                    );
16856                    assert!(
16857                        result
16858                            .reason
16859                            .as_deref()
16860                            .unwrap()
16861                            .contains("custom observed 2 distinct outcomes")
16862                    );
16863                } else {
16864                    assert_eq!(
16865                        hashes[0], hashes[1],
16866                        "binary output is not itself a refusal"
16867                    );
16868                }
16869                let capture = Path::new(&result.artifact_dir).join("custom-capture");
16870                for index in 1..=3 {
16871                    let expected = [if different && index == 2 { 0xfe } else { 0xff }, b'\n'];
16872                    assert_eq!(
16873                        fs::read(
16874                            capture
16875                                .join("retained")
16876                                .join(index.to_string())
16877                                .join(stream)
16878                        )
16879                        .unwrap(),
16880                        expected
16881                    );
16882                    assert_eq!(
16883                        fs::read(
16884                            Path::new(&result.artifact_dir)
16885                                .join(format!("captures/custom-{index}.stdout"))
16886                        )
16887                        .unwrap(),
16888                        b"launcher output\n"
16889                    );
16890                }
16891                let invocations = fs::read_to_string(root.join("invocations")).unwrap();
16892                let paths = invocations.lines().collect::<Vec<_>>();
16893                assert_eq!(paths.len(), 3);
16894                assert!(
16895                    paths
16896                        .iter()
16897                        .all(|path| *path == capture.join("run").to_str().unwrap())
16898                );
16899                assert!(!capture.join("run").exists());
16900                fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
16901            }
16902        }
16903    }

16905    #[test]
16906    fn custom_capture_refuses_malformed_and_incomplete_producer_evidence() {
16907        for scenario in [
16908            "malformed-record",
16909            "missing-record",
16910            "missing-stdout",
16911            "missing-stderr",
16912            "missing-log",
16913        ] {
16914            let (root, mut context, cell) = custom_capture_control_fixture(scenario, scenario);
16915            context.capture_custom_runs = true;
16916            let result = run_cell(&context, &cell)
16917                .expect("a started malformed producer must retain a non-PASS cell receipt");
16918            assert_eq!(result.outcome, "ERROR", "{scenario}: {result:?}");
16919            assert!(!result.attempts.is_empty());
16920            assert!(result.attempts.len() <= 3);
16921            assert_eq!(result.attempts[0].outcome, "ERROR");
16922            assert!(
16923                result.attempts[0]
16924                    .reason
16925                    .as_ref()
16926                    .is_some_and(|reason| !reason.is_empty())
16927            );
16928            let capture = Path::new(&result.artifact_dir).join("custom-capture");
16929            let retained = capture.join("retained/1");
16930            assert!(retained.is_dir(), "invalid evidence must not disappear");
16931            let affected = match scenario {
16932                "missing-record" | "malformed-record" => "verify-run.json",
16933                "missing-stdout" => "stdout",
16934                "missing-stderr" => "stderr",
16935                "missing-log" => "run.log",
16936                _ => unreachable!(),
16937            };
16938            if scenario == "malformed-record" {
16939                assert_eq!(fs::read(retained.join(affected)).unwrap(), b"{");
16940            } else {
16941                assert!(!retained.join(affected).exists());
16942            }
16943            let invocations = fs::read_to_string(root.join("invocations")).unwrap();
16944            assert_eq!(invocations.lines().count(), result.attempts.len());
16945            assert!(
16946                invocations
16947                    .lines()
16948                    .all(|path| path == capture.join("run").to_str().unwrap())
16949            );
16950            assert!(!capture.join("run").exists());
16951            fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
16952        }
16953    }

17033    thread_local! {
17034        static CAPTURE_BUDGET_FAULT: std::cell::Cell<Option<(usize, ProcessTimeout)>> =
17035            const { std::cell::Cell::new(None) };
17036        static CAPTURE_CPU_MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: std::cell::Cell<bool> =
17037            const { std::cell::Cell::new(false) };
17038    }
17039
17040    // Inject only the post-adoption measurement; use the production finalizer,
17041    // original repetition loop and cell result/CPU-evidence aggregation.
17042    pub(super) fn capture_budget_test_measurement(
17043        attempt: &AttemptResult,
17044        budget: &ExecutionBudget,
17045        charge: Result<u64, String>,
17046        finished: Instant,
17047    ) -> (Result<u64, String>, Instant) {
17048        if CAPTURE_CPU_MEASUREMENT_FAILURE.get() {
17049            return (Err("capture thread measurement failed".into()), finished);
17050        }
17051        match CAPTURE_BUDGET_FAULT
17052            .get()
17053            .filter(|(index, _)| attempt.index == index.to_string())
17054        {
17055            Some((_, ProcessTimeout::Wall)) => (charge, budget.deadline),
17056            Some((_, ProcessTimeout::Cpu)) => (
17057                Ok(budget
17058                    .remaining_cpu_usec
17059                    .unwrap()
17060                    .checked_sub(attempt.cpu_usage_usec.unwrap())
17061                    .unwrap()),
17062                finished,
17063            ),
17064            None => (charge, finished),
17065        }
17066    }

17068    #[test]
17069    fn custom_capture_final_adoption_respects_both_aggregate_bounds() {
17070        struct Reset;
17071        impl Drop for Reset {
17072            fn drop(&mut self) {
17073                CAPTURE_BUDGET_FAULT.set(None);
17074            }
17075        }
17076        for index in [2, 3] {
17077            for timeout in [ProcessTimeout::Wall, ProcessTimeout::Cpu] {
17078                let label = format!("budget-{index}-{timeout:?}");
17079                let (root, mut context, cell) = custom_capture_control_fixture(&label, "good");
17080                context.capture_custom_runs = true;
17081                CAPTURE_BUDGET_FAULT.set(Some((index, timeout)));
17082                let reset = Reset;
17083                let result = run_cell(&context, &cell).unwrap();
17084                drop(reset);
17085                assert_eq!(result.outcome, "FAIL", "{result:?}");
17086                assert_eq!(result.result, Some(ObservedResult::Timeout));
17087                assert_eq!(result.failure_class, Some(FailureClass::NoResult));
17088                assert_eq!(result.attempts.len(), index);
17089                assert_eq!(
17090                    fs::read_to_string(root.join("invocations"))
17091                        .unwrap()
17092                        .lines()
17093                        .count(),
17094                    index
17095                );
17096                let last = result.attempts.last().unwrap();
17097                assert_eq!(
17098                    last.capture_adoption_timeout.as_deref(),
17099                    Some(if timeout == ProcessTimeout::Wall {
17100                        "wall"
17101                    } else {
17102                        "cpu"
17103                    })
17104                );
17105                assert!(
17106                    !last.timed_out,
17107                    "child completion must not become a timeout"
17108                );
17109                assert_eq!(last.status, Some(0));
17110                assert_eq!(
17111                    last.observation_sha256,
17112                    result.attempts[0].observation_sha256
17113                );
17114                assert!(
17115                    Path::new(last.single_run_capture.as_ref().unwrap())
17116                        .join("verify-run.json")
17117                        .is_file()
17118                );
17119                assert!(
17120                    last.reason
17121                        .as_deref()
17122                        .unwrap()
17123                        .contains("after custom capture adoption")
17124                );
17125                result.require_cpu_observations().unwrap();
17126                assert_eq!(
17127                    result.capture_adoption_cpu_usage_usec,
17128                    Some(
17129                        result
17130                            .attempts
17131                            .iter()
17132                            .map(|a| a.capture_adoption_cpu_usage_usec.unwrap())
17133                            .sum()
17134                    )
17135                );
17136                fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
17137            }
17138        }
17139        for timeout in [ProcessTimeout::Wall, ProcessTimeout::Cpu] {
17140            let (root, mut context, cell) =
17141                custom_capture_control_fixture("distinct-before-timeout", "stdout-different");
17142            context.capture_custom_runs = true;
17143            CAPTURE_BUDGET_FAULT.set(Some((2, timeout)));
17144            let reset = Reset;
17145            let result = run_cell(&context, &cell).unwrap();
17146            drop(reset);
17147            assert_eq!(result.outcome, "FAIL");
17148            assert_eq!(result.result, Some(ObservedResult::CrashError));
17149            assert_eq!(result.failure_class, Some(FailureClass::ProductFailure));
17150            assert_eq!(result.attempts.len(), 2);
17151            assert_eq!(
17152                result.reason.as_deref(),
17153                Some("custom observed 2 distinct outcomes")
17154            );
17155            assert_ne!(
17156                result.attempts[0].observation_sha256,
17157                result.attempts[1].observation_sha256
17158            );
17159            let last = &result.attempts[1];
17160            assert_eq!(last.status, Some(0));
17161            assert!(!last.timed_out);
17162            assert_eq!(
17163                last.capture_adoption_timeout.as_deref(),
17164                Some(if timeout == ProcessTimeout::Wall {
17165                    "wall"
17166                } else {
17167                    "cpu"
17168                })
17169            );
17170            result.require_cpu_observations().unwrap();
17171            fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
17172        }
17173        let (root, mut context, cell) =
17174            custom_capture_control_fixture("failed-child-before-timeout", "good");
17175        context.capture_custom_runs = true;
17176        let path = root.join("record.json");
17177        let mut record: JsonValue = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&path).unwrap()).unwrap();
17178        record["outcome"]["status"]["code"] = serde_json::json!(7);
17179        fs::write(path, serde_json::to_vec(&record).unwrap()).unwrap();
17180        let script = root.join("hermit");
17181        fs::write(
17182            &script,
17183            format!("{}\nexit 7\n", fs::read_to_string(&script).unwrap()),
17184        )
17185        .unwrap();
17186        CAPTURE_BUDGET_FAULT.set(Some((1, ProcessTimeout::Cpu)));
17187        let reset = Reset;
17188        let result = run_cell(&context, &cell).unwrap();
17189        drop(reset);
17190        assert_eq!(result.outcome, "FAIL");
17191        assert_eq!(result.result, Some(ObservedResult::CrashError));
17192        assert_eq!(result.failure_class, Some(FailureClass::ProductFailure));
17193        assert_eq!(result.attempts.len(), 1);
17194        assert_eq!(result.attempts[0].status, Some(7));
17195        assert!(!result.attempts[0].timed_out);
17196        assert_eq!(
17197            result.attempts[0].capture_adoption_timeout.as_deref(),
17198            Some("cpu")
17199        );
17200        result.require_cpu_observations().unwrap();
17201        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
17202    }

17204    #[test]
17205    fn custom_capture_accounting_refuses_missing_and_overflowing_measurements() {
17206        let mut attempt = attempt_with_sabre_evidence("");
17207        attempt.capture_custom_runs = true;
17208        attempt.outcome = "PASS".into();
17209        attempt.cpu_usage_usec = Some(40);
17210        let budget = ExecutionBudget {
17211            deadline: Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(60),
17212            cpu_timeout_seconds: 22,
17213            wall_timeout_seconds: 57,
17214            remaining_cpu_usec: Some(100),
17215        };
17216        finish_capture_budget(&mut attempt, &budget, Ok(59), Instant::now());
17217        assert_eq!(attempt.outcome, "PASS");
17218        assert_eq!(attempt.cpu_usage_usec, Some(40));
17219        assert_eq!(effective_execution_cpu(&attempt).unwrap(), 99);
17220        for child in [None, Some(u64::MAX)] {
17221            let mut failed = attempt.clone();
17222            failed.cpu_usage_usec = child;
17223            finish_capture_budget(&mut failed, &budget, Ok(1), Instant::now());
17224            assert_eq!(failed.outcome, "ERROR", "{failed:?}");
17225            assert!(!failed.timed_out);
17226        }
17227        let mut failed = attempt.clone();
17228        finish_capture_budget(
17229            &mut failed,
17230            &budget,
17231            Err("thread measurement failed".into()),
17232            Instant::now(),
17233        );
17234        assert_eq!(failed.outcome, "ERROR");
17235        assert!(failed.capture_adoption_cpu_usage_usec.is_none());
17236        assert!(effective_execution_cpu(&failed).is_err());
17237        assert!(failed.reason.unwrap().contains("thread measurement failed"));
17238        let mut prior = attempt;
17239        prior.outcome = "ERROR".into();
17240        prior.error_kind = Some("incomplete-verification-evidence".into());
17241        prior.reason = Some("original controller error".into());
17242        finish_capture_budget(&mut prior, &budget, Ok(60), Instant::now());
17243        assert_eq!(prior.outcome, "ERROR");
17244        assert!(
17245            prior
17246                .reason
17247                .as_deref()
17248                .unwrap()
17249                .starts_with("original controller error")
17250        );
17251        assert_eq!(prior.capture_adoption_timeout.as_deref(), Some("cpu"));
17252        assert_eq!(
17253            observed_result_from_typed_evidence(
17254                "custom",
17255                "ERROR",
17256                std::slice::from_ref(&prior),
17257                prior.error_kind.as_deref()
17258            ),
17259            None,
17260            "a later adoption timeout cannot replace a controller evidence error"
17261        );
17262
17263        struct Reset;
17264        impl Drop for Reset {
17265            fn drop(&mut self) {
17266                CAPTURE_CPU_MEASUREMENT_FAILURE.set(false);
17267            }
17268        }
17269        let (root, mut context, cell) =
17270            custom_capture_control_fixture("failed-child-accounting", "good");
17271        context.capture_custom_runs = true;
17272        let path = root.join("record.json");
17273        let mut record: JsonValue = serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&path).unwrap()).unwrap();
17274        record["outcome"]["status"]["code"] = serde_json::json!(7);
17275        fs::write(path, serde_json::to_vec(&record).unwrap()).unwrap();
17276        let script = root.join("hermit");
17277        fs::write(
17278            &script,
17279            format!("{}\nexit 7\n", fs::read_to_string(&script).unwrap()),
17280        )
17281        .unwrap();
17282        CAPTURE_CPU_MEASUREMENT_FAILURE.set(true);
17283        let reset = Reset;
17284        let result = run_cell(&context, &cell).unwrap();
17285        drop(reset);
17286        assert_eq!(result.outcome, "FAIL", "{result:?}");
17287        assert_eq!(result.attempts.len(), 1, "unknown CPU forbids a successor");
17288        assert_eq!(
17289            fs::read_to_string(root.join("invocations"))
17290                .unwrap()
17291                .lines()
17292                .count(),
17293            1
17294        );
17295        let attempt = &result.attempts[0];
17296        assert_eq!(attempt.status, Some(7));
17297        assert_eq!(attempt.outcome, "FAIL");
17298        assert!(!attempt.timed_out);
17299        assert_eq!(attempt.stderr, "launcher diagnostics\n");
17300        assert!(attempt.cpu_usage_usec.is_some());
17301        assert!(attempt.capture_adoption_cpu_usage_usec.is_none());
17302        assert!(result.capture_adoption_cpu_usage_usec.is_none());
17303        assert!(
17304            attempt
17305                .reason
17306                .as_deref()
17307                .unwrap()
17308                .contains("capture thread measurement failed")
17309        );
17310        assert!(attempt.observation_sha256.is_some());
17311        assert!(effective_execution_cpu(attempt).is_err());
17312        result.require_cpu_observations().unwrap();
17313        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
17314    }

17356    #[test]
17357    fn custom_capture_preserves_exact_epoch_precedence_and_completed_status_policy() {
17358        use crate::verify_run_record::RecordedStatus;
17359        use crate::verify_run_record::VerifyRunOutcome;
17360        use crate::verify_run_record::VerifyRunRecord;
17361        for (label, epoch, args, status, process_code) in [
17362            (
17363                "spelling",
17364                "2026-01-01T01:00:00+01:00",
17365                vec![],
17366                RecordedStatus::Exited { code: 0 },
17367                0,
17368            ),
17369            (
17370                "explicit",
17371                "2027-02-03T04:05:06.123456789+00:00",
17372                vec!["--epoch=2027-02-03T04:05:06.123456789Z"],
17373                RecordedStatus::Exited { code: 0 },
17374                0,
17375            ),
17376            (
17377                "nonzero",
17378                "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
17379                vec![],
17380                RecordedStatus::Exited { code: 7 },
17381                7,
17382            ),
17383            (
17384                "signal",
17385                "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
17386                vec![],
17387                RecordedStatus::Signaled {
17388                    signal: 11,
17389                    core_dumped: false,
17390                },
17391                139,
17392            ),
17393        ] {
17394            let (root, mut context, mut cell) = custom_capture_control_fixture(label, "good");
17395            context.capture_custom_runs = true;
17396            cell.test
17397                .modes
17398                .get_mut("custom")
17399                .unwrap()
17400                .args
17401                .extend(args.into_iter().map(str::to_owned));
17402            let mut record: VerifyRunRecord =
17403                serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(root.join("record.json")).unwrap()).unwrap();
17404            record.epoch = epoch.into();
17405            record.outcome = VerifyRunOutcome::Completed {
17406                status,
17407                skid_overshoots: 0,
17408                forwarded_syscalls: None,
17409                guest_deadlock: false,
17410                virtual_timeout_ns: None,
17411            };
17412            fs::write(
17413                root.join("record.json"),
17414                serde_json::to_vec(&record).unwrap(),
17415            )
17416            .unwrap();
17417            let script = fs::read_to_string(root.join("hermit")).unwrap();
17418            fs::write(
17419                root.join("hermit"),
17420                format!("{script}\nexit {process_code}\n"),
17421            )
17422            .unwrap();
17423            let result = run_cell(&context, &cell).unwrap();
17424            assert_eq!(
17425                result.outcome,
17426                if process_code == 0 { "PASS" } else { "FAIL" },
17427                "{label}: {result:?}"
17428            );
17429            assert_eq!(result.attempts.len(), 3);
17430            for attempt in &result.attempts {
17431                assert_eq!(attempt.status, Some(process_code));
17432                assert!(attempt.single_run_capture.is_some());
17433                assert!(attempt.observation_sha256.is_some());
17434                assert!(attempt.reason.is_none(), "{attempt:?}");
17435            }
17436            fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
17437        }
17438    }

17482    /// Every Hermit run of a cell writes its manifest into one stage
17483    /// directory, named by the same `HERMIT_DATA_DIR` for every attempt: a
17484    /// custom cell outside the hermetic lane hands Hermit's environment to its
17485    /// guest (no `--base-env=minimal`), and the attempts its assertions compare
17486    /// must see byte-identical values. The manifest policy is a flag, so no
17487    /// `HERMIT_MANIFEST` reaches any guest; a replay's `record start` writes no
17488    /// manifest and gets no flag, and a naked cell gets neither.
17489    #[test]
17490    fn every_attempt_of_a_cell_names_the_same_hermit_data_directory() {
17491        use crate::cpu_profile_record::DATA_DIR_ENV;
17492        use crate::cpu_profile_record::MANIFEST_ALWAYS_ARG;
17493        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
17494            "hermit-runner-data-stage-env-{}",
17495            std::process::id()
17496        ));
17497        let context = run_context(&root);
17498        assert!(context.isolated_workdir.is_none());
17499        let spec = |cell: &SelectedCell, dir: &str, attempt: &str, seed: Option<i64>| {
17500            build_spec(
17501                &context,
17502                cell,
17503                root.join(dir),
17504                vec!["/bin/true".into()],
17505                attempt,
17506                seed,
17507                15,
17508            )
17509            .unwrap()
17510        };
17511        let flags = |spec: &CellRunSpec| {
17512            spec.argv
17513                .iter()
17514                .filter(|arg| *arg == MANIFEST_ALWAYS_ARG)
17515                .count()
17516        };
17517        let stage = |dir: &str| {
17518            crate::cpu_profile_record::stage_dir(&root.join(dir))
17519                .to_string_lossy()
17520                .into_owned()
17521        };
17522
17523        let custom = ptrace_cell("custom");
17524        let runs = ["1", "2", "3"].map(|attempt| spec(&custom, "custom", attempt, None));
17525        assert!(!runs[0].argv.iter().any(|arg| arg.starts_with("--base-env")));
17526        for run in &runs {
17527            assert_eq!(run.env.get(DATA_DIR_ENV), Some(&stage("custom")));
17528            assert!(!run.env.contains_key("HERMIT_MANIFEST"));
17529            assert_eq!(flags(run), 1);
17530            assert_eq!(run.env, runs[0].env);
17531        }
17532        assert_ne!(runs[0].attempt, runs[1].attempt);
17533
17534        let chaos = ptrace_cell("chaos");
17535        let seeds = [1, 2].map(|seed| spec(&chaos, "chaos", &format!("seed-{seed}"), Some(seed)));
17536        assert_eq!(seeds[0].env, seeds[1].env);
17537        assert_eq!(seeds[0].env.get(DATA_DIR_ENV), Some(&stage("chaos")));
17538        assert_eq!(flags(&seeds[0]), 1);
17539
17540        let verify = spec(&ptrace_cell("verify"), "verify", "1", None);
17541        assert_eq!(verify.env.get(DATA_DIR_ENV), Some(&stage("verify")));
17542        assert!(!verify.env.contains_key("HERMIT_MANIFEST"));
17543        assert_eq!(flags(&verify), 1);
17544        let replay = spec(&ptrace_cell("replay"), "replay", "1", None);
17545        assert!(
17546            replay
17547                .argv
17548                .windows(2)
17549                .any(|pair| pair == ["record", "start"])
17550        );
17551        assert_eq!(flags(&replay), 0);
17552        assert!(!replay.env.contains_key("HERMIT_MANIFEST"));
17553        let naked = spec(&ptrace_cell("naked"), "naked", "1", None);
17554        assert!(!naked.env.contains_key(DATA_DIR_ENV));
17555        assert_eq!(flags(&naked), 0);
17556    }

17558    /// A custom-mode spec of the cell at `root` whose command is `script`,
17559    /// run by `/bin/sh` with the cell's Hermit data stage in its environment,
17560    /// as `build_spec` gives every Hermit cell.
17561    fn data_stage_spec(root: &Path, attempt: &str, script: &str) -> CellRunSpec {
17562        CellRunSpec {
17563            command_binding: None,
17564            id: CellId {
17565                test: "fixture/data-stage".into(),
17566                mode: "custom".into(),
17567                backend: Some("ptrace".into()),
17568            },
17569            lane: "portable".into(),
17570            category: "fixture".into(),
17571            cwd: root.to_path_buf(),
17572            env: BTreeMap::from([(
17573                crate::cpu_profile_record::DATA_DIR_ENV.to_owned(),
17574                crate::cpu_profile_record::stage_dir(root)
17575                    .to_string_lossy()
17576                    .into_owned(),
17577            )]),
17578            argv: vec!["/bin/sh".into(), "-c".into(), script.into()],
17579            guest_argv: vec!["fixture".into()],
17580            timeout_seconds: 15,
17581            verdict_path: None,
17582            verification_log_dir: None,
17583            verify_runs: None,
17584            single_run_capture: None,
17585            sabre_path_evidence: None,
17586            cell_dir: root.to_path_buf(),
17587            expected_guest_exit: None,
17588            expected_stdout: None,
17589            expected_stdout_contains: None,
17590            expected_stderr: None,
17591            comparator: Comparator::Strict,
17592            attempt: attempt.into(),
17593            fixed_workdir_source: root.join(format!("workdir/{attempt}")),
17594        }
17595    }

17597    fn run_data_stage_spec(spec: &CellRunSpec) -> AttemptResult {

17601            10,
17602            10,
17603            None,
17604            &mut Vec::new(),
17605        )
17606        .unwrap()
17607    }

17609    /// A script that writes a manifest recording `profile`, admitted by the
17610    /// host, as Hermit run `id` would, into the directory Hermit is given.
17611    fn write_manifest_script(id: &str, profile: &str) -> String {
17612        format!(
17613            "mkdir -p \"$HERMIT_DATA_DIR/{id}\" && printf '%s' \
17614             '{{\"cpu_profile\":{{\"profile\":\"{profile}\",\"reason\":\"admitted\"}}}}' \
17615             > \"$HERMIT_DATA_DIR/{id}/manifest.json\""
17616        )
17617    }

17619    /// However an attempt's process ends, what it wrote into the cell's stage
17620    /// becomes the attempt's own data directory, and the next attempt starts
17621    /// with no stage: a stage an interrupted attempt left, and an attempt's
17622    /// directory from an earlier run into the same result root, are reset
17623    /// first. An attempt that wrote nothing leaves no directory.
17624    #[test]
17625    fn an_attempts_hermit_data_moves_from_the_cell_stage_to_its_own_directory() {
17626        use crate::cpu_profile_record::data_dir;
17627        use crate::cpu_profile_record::stage_dir;
17628        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
17629            "hermit-runner-data-stage-move-{}",
17630            std::process::id()
17631        ));
17632        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
17633        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
17634        let stage = stage_dir(&root);
17635        // Leftovers: a stage from an interrupted attempt and attempt 1's
17636        // directory from an earlier run.
17637        fs::create_dir_all(stage.join("stale")).unwrap();
17638        fs::create_dir_all(data_dir(&root, "1").join("old")).unwrap();
17639        let first = run_data_stage_spec(&data_stage_spec(
17640            &root,
17641            "1",
17642            &write_manifest_script("a", "x86-64-v3"),
17643        ));
17644        assert_eq!(first.outcome, "PASS");
17645        let listing = |dir: &Path| {
17646            let mut names = fs::read_dir(dir)
17647                .map(|entries| {
17648                    entries
17649                        .map(|entry| entry.unwrap().file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
17650                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
17651                })
17652                .unwrap_or_default();
17653            names.sort();
17654            names
17655        };
17656        assert_eq!(listing(&data_dir(&root, "1")), ["a"]);
17657        assert!(!stage.exists());
17658        // A failing attempt keeps what it wrote too.
17659        let second = run_data_stage_spec(&data_stage_spec(
17660            &root,
17661            "2",
17662            &format!("{} && exit 3", write_manifest_script("b", "x86-64-v3")),
17663        ));
17664        assert_eq!(second.outcome, "FAIL");
17665        assert_eq!(listing(&data_dir(&root, "2")), ["b"]);
17666        assert!(!stage.exists());
17667        // An attempt that wrote nothing (a run refused before it started).
17668        let third = run_data_stage_spec(&data_stage_spec(&root, "3", "exit 122"));
17669        assert_eq!(third.status, Some(122));
17670        assert!(!data_dir(&root, "3").exists());
17671        assert!(!stage.exists());
17672        assert_eq!(listing(&data_dir(&root, "1")), ["a"]);
17673        fs::remove_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
17674    }
17675
17676    /// A row's record reads every attempt the row ran, not only the first,
17677    /// whose environment is the row's own copy: three attempts that each left
17678    /// a manifest in their own directory give a record naming all three, an
17679    /// attempt that disagrees leaves the row unresolved, and a row whose
17680    /// attempts name no data directory (a naked cell) has no record.
17681    #[test]
17682    fn a_rows_record_reads_every_attempt_of_the_row() {
17683        use crate::cpu_profile_record::DATA_DIR_ENV;
17684        use crate::cpu_profile_record::record_result_row;
17685        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
17686            "hermit-runner-data-stage-row-{}",
17687            std::process::id()
17688        ));
17689        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
17690        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
17691        let attempts: Vec<AttemptResult> = ["1", "2", "3"]
17692            .iter()
17693            .map(|attempt| {
17694                run_data_stage_spec(&data_stage_spec(
17695                    &root,
17696                    attempt,
17697                    &write_manifest_script(&format!("m{attempt}"), "x86-64-v3"),
17698                ))
17699            })
17700            .collect();
17701        // A row of the fixture's shape carrying these attempts as the runner
17702        // leaves them (the fixture rewrites its own attempts' commands).
17703        let mut row = verify_row_from_attempts(attempts.clone());
17704        row.attempts = attempts;
17705        row.mode = "custom".into();
17706        let record = record_result_row(&row).unwrap();
17707        assert!(record.resolved, "{record:?}");
17708        assert_eq!(record.profile.as_deref(), Some("x86-64-v3"));
17709        assert_eq!(
17710            record.manifests.keys().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
17711            [
17712                "1/m1/manifest.json",
17713                "2/m2/manifest.json",
17714                "3/m3/manifest.json"
17715            ]
17716        );
17717        // A fourth attempt on another profile: the row is unresolved.
17718        let mut split = row.clone();
17719        split.attempts.push(run_data_stage_spec(&data_stage_spec(
17720            &root,
17721            "4",
17722            &write_manifest_script("m4", "x86-64-v2"),
17723        )));
17724        assert_eq!(
17725            record_result_row(&split).unwrap().unresolved.as_deref(),
17726            Some("the runs' manifests record different CPU profiles")
17727        );
17728        let mut naked = row.clone();
17729        for attempt in &mut naked.attempts {
17730            attempt.env.remove(DATA_DIR_ENV);
17731        }
17732        assert_eq!(record_result_row(&naked), None);
17733        fs::remove_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
17734    }

17744    fn comparison_epoch_is_retained_across_operands_repeats_and_outer_retries() {
17745        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
17746            "hermit-comparison-epoch-{}-{}",
17747            std::process::id(),
17748            SystemTime::now()
17749                .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
17750                .unwrap()
17751                .as_nanos(),
17752        ));
17753        let mut context = run_context(&root);
17754        context.epoch =
17755            resolve_run_epoch(Some("2000-12-31T23:59:59.123456789+00:00".into())).unwrap();
17756        for outer_attempt in [1, 2] {
17757            let context = context.with_attempt(outer_attempt);
17758            for backend in ["sabre", "ptrace"] {
17759                let mut cell = ptrace_cell("verify");
17760                cell.id.backend = Some(backend.into());
17761                for attempt in ["1", "parity-reference"] {
17762                    let spec = build_spec(
17763                        &context,
17764                        &cell,
17765                        root.join(backend),
17766                        vec!["/bin/date".into(), "+%s%N".into()],
17767                        attempt,
17768                        None,
17769                        15,
17770                    )
17771                    .unwrap();
17772                    assert_eq!(spec.env.get("HERMIT_EPOCH"), Some(&context.epoch));
17773                    assert!(!spec.argv.iter().any(|arg| arg.contains("HERMIT_EPOCH")));
17774                    assert!(!spec.argv.iter().any(|arg| arg.starts_with("--epoch")));
17775                }
17776            }
17777        }
17778        let mut custom = ptrace_cell("custom");
17779        custom.test.modes.get_mut("custom").unwrap().args =
17780            vec!["--epoch=2026-01-01T00:00:00.987654321Z".into()];
17781        let spec = build_spec(
17782            &context,
17783            &custom,
17784            root.join("custom"),
17785            vec!["/bin/true".into()],
17786            "1",
17787            None,
17788            15,
17789        )
17790        .unwrap();
17791        assert_eq!(spec.env.get("HERMIT_EPOCH"), Some(&context.epoch));
17792        assert_eq!(
17793            spec.argv
17794                .iter()
17795                .filter(|arg| arg.starts_with("--epoch"))
17796                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
17797            [&"--epoch=2026-01-01T00:00:00.987654321Z".to_owned()]
17798        );
17799        let naked = build_spec(
17800            &context,
17801            &ptrace_cell("naked"),
17802            root.join("naked"),
17803            vec!["/bin/true".into()],
17804            "1",
17805            None,
17806            15,
17807        )
17808        .unwrap();
17809        assert!(!naked.env.contains_key("HERMIT_EPOCH"));
17810        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
17811    }

17813    /// An image cell's runs never seal the host's dynamic-linker cache (issue
17814    /// 5476). Inside an image, a bucket image or the v2 retry rootfs, the
17815    /// loader reads the image's own /etc/ld.so.cache, or none: Hermit's image
17816    /// container binds no host file there. The same cell rooted on the host
17817    /// keeps the one sealed copy both of its runs bind. The v2 retry runs in
17818    /// the rootfs on ptrace as on KVM, verify and chaos alike, and only the
17819    /// KVM retry binds the host's /sys/module.
17820    #[test]
17821    fn image_cells_seal_no_host_linker_cache() {
17822        let root = PathBuf::from("/tmp/hermit-image-linker-cache-fixture");
17823        let mut context = run_context(&root);
17824        context.shares_ld_so_cache = true;
17825        let mut cell = ptrace_cell("verify");
17826        cell.id.backend = Some("kvm".into());
17827        let argv = |context: &RunContext, cell: &SelectedCell| {
17828            build_spec(
17829                context,
17830                cell,
17831                root.join("cell"),
17832                vec![
17833                    root.join("build/c-programs/fixture/program")
17834                        .display()
17835                        .to_string(),
17836                ],
17837                "1",
17838                None,
17839                15,
17840            )
17841            .unwrap()
17842            .argv
17843        };
17844        let seals = |argv: &[String]| {
17845            argv.iter().any(|arg| arg == SHARED_INPUTS_FLAG)
17846                || argv
17847                    .windows(2)
17848                    .any(|pair| pair[0] == "--input" && pair[1] == LD_SO_CACHE_INPUT)
17849        };
17850        let image_flag = |argv: &[String], image: &str| {
17851            let want = ["--image".to_string(), image.to_string()];
17852            argv.windows(2).any(|pair| pair == want)
17853        };
17854
17855        let host = argv(&context, &cell);
17856        assert!(
17857            seals(&host),
17858            "the host-rooted cell seals the cache: {host:?}"
17859        );
17860        assert!(!host.iter().any(|arg| arg == "--image"), "{host:?}");
17861
17862        let rootfs = root.join("bundle/v2-rootfs");
17863        let retry = argv(&context.clone().with_v2_retry(rootfs.clone()), &cell);
17864        assert!(
17865            image_flag(&retry, &format!("oci-dir:{}", rootfs.display())),
17866            "{retry:?}"
17867        );
17868        assert!(
17869            !seals(&retry),
17870            "the v2 retry runs in its rootfs and seals no host cache: {retry:?}"
17871        );
17872        // Only the retry binds the host's /sys/module, read-only, for strict
17873        // KVM binder admission inside the rootfs.
17874        let binds_sys_module = |argv: &[String]| {
17875            argv.iter()
17876                .any(|arg| arg == "--bind=/sys/module:/sys/module:ro")
17877        };
17878        assert!(binds_sys_module(&retry), "{retry:?}");
17879        assert!(!binds_sys_module(&host), "{host:?}");
17880
17881        let mut imaged = cell.clone();
17882        imaged.image = Some("oci-dir:/images/bucket".into());
17883        let bucket = argv(&context, &imaged);
17884        assert!(image_flag(&bucket, "oci-dir:/images/bucket"), "{bucket:?}");
17885        assert!(
17886            !seals(&bucket),
17887            "a bucket-image cell seals no host cache: {bucket:?}"
17888        );
17889        assert!(!binds_sys_module(&bucket), "{bucket:?}");
17890
17891        // The ptrace retry, of a verify or a chaos cell, runs in the same
17892        // rootfs and seals no host cache, but binds no host sysfs: only KVM's
17893        // binder admission reads /sys/module.
17894        let retry_context = context.clone().with_v2_retry(rootfs.clone());
17895        let ptrace_verify = ptrace_cell("verify");
17896        let ptrace_chaos = ptrace_cell("chaos");
17897        let chaos_argv = |context: &RunContext| {
17898            build_spec(
17899                context,
17900                &ptrace_chaos,
17901                root.join("cell"),
17902                vec![
17903                    root.join("build/c-programs/fixture/program")
17904                        .display()
17905                        .to_string(),
17906                ],
17907                "1",
17908                Some(7),
17909                15,
17910            )
17911            .unwrap()
17912            .argv
17913        };
17914        for (label, host, retry) in [
17915            (
17916                "ptrace verify",
17917                argv(&context, &ptrace_verify),
17918                argv(&retry_context, &ptrace_verify),
17919            ),
17920            (
17921                "ptrace chaos",
17922                chaos_argv(&context),
17923                chaos_argv(&retry_context),
17924            ),
17925        ] {
17926            assert!(seals(&host), "{label}: {host:?}");
17927            assert!(
17928                !host.iter().any(|arg| arg == "--image"),
17929                "{label}: {host:?}"
17930            );
17931            assert!(
17932                image_flag(&retry, &format!("oci-dir:{}", rootfs.display())),
17933                "{label}: {retry:?}"
17934            );
17935            assert!(!seals(&retry), "{label}: {retry:?}");
17936            assert!(!binds_sys_module(&retry), "{label}: {retry:?}");
17937            assert!(!binds_sys_module(&host), "{label}: {host:?}");
17938        }
17939    }

17941    /// A v2 retry consults the rootfs's fixture verdict before it launches
17942    /// (issue 5476). A cell whose fixture files the verdict clears gets the
17943    /// retry context. One whose files lack a symbol version or a library
17944    /// gets a typed refusal that names each item. A verdict that is absent,
17945    /// malformed, or written by a check that did not run refuses as
17946    /// unchecked. Only lines under the cell's own prebuilt directory count,
17947    /// and either refusal ends the cell's retries.
17948    #[test]
17949    fn v2_retry_reads_the_rootfs_fixture_verdict() {
17950        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
17951            "hermit-v2-rootfs-verdict-{}-{:?}",
17952            std::process::id(),
17953            std::thread::current().id()
17954        ));
17955        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
17956        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
17957        let context = run_context(&root);
17958        let mut cell = ptrace_cell("verify");
17959        cell.id.backend = Some("kvm".into());
17960        let verdict = |text: &str| fs::write(root.join(V2_ROOTFS_VERDICT_FILE), text).unwrap();
17961        // RunContext has no Debug, so a refusal is taken apart by hand.
17962        let refusal = || match v2_retry_context(&context, &cell, &root) {
17963            Ok(_) => panic!("the v2 retry was not refused"),
17964            Err(row) => *row,
17965        };
17966
17967        // recipe() names the test fixture/test, so its prebuilt directory is
17968        // fixture-test/; fixture-tests/ is another test's.
17969        verdict(
17970            "schema\t1\nstatus\tchecked\n\
17971             missing\tfixture-tests/fixtures/program\tlibgomp.so.1 (library)\n\
17972             missing\tother-test/fixtures/program\t__isoc23_strtol@GLIBC_2.38\n",
17973        );
17974        let cleared = v2_retry_context(&context, &cell, &root).unwrap();
17975        assert_eq!(cleared.v2_retry_oci_dir.as_deref(), Some(root.as_path()));
17976
17977        verdict(
17978            "schema\t1\nstatus\tchecked\n\
17979             missing\tfixture-test/fixtures/program\tlibgomp.so.1 (library)\n\
17980             missing\tfixture-test/fixtures/program\tGOMP_parallel@GOMP_4.0\n",
17981        );
17982        let refused = refusal();
17983        assert_eq!(refused.outcome, "ERROR");
17984        assert_eq!(refused.error_kind.as_deref(), Some(ROOTFS_MISSING_SYMBOL));
17985        assert_eq!(
17986            refused.failure_class,
17987            Some(FailureClass::UnderstoodPrerequisiteFailure)
17988        );
17989        assert_eq!(
17990            failure_class(
17991                &refused.outcome,
17992                refused.result,
17993                refused.error_kind.as_deref()
17994            ),
17995            refused.failure_class,
17996            "the class the row carries is the one its error kind derives"
17997        );
17998        refused.require_current_classification().unwrap();
17999        let reason = refused.reason.as_deref().unwrap();
18000        assert!(
18001            reason.contains("fixture-test/fixtures/program needs libgomp.so.1 (library)")
18002                && reason.contains("fixture-test/fixtures/program needs GOMP_parallel@GOMP_4.0"),
18003            "{reason}"
18004        );
18005        assert!(
18006            refused.argv.is_empty() && refused.attempts.is_empty(),
18007            "a refused retry launches nothing"
18008        );
18009        assert!(is_v2_retry_refusal(&refused));
18010
18011        for (text, want) in [
18012            (
18013                "schema\t1\nstatus\tunchecked\tno objdump on PATH\n",
18014                "the fixture check did not run: no objdump on PATH",
18015            ),
18016            (
18017                "schema\t2\nstatus\tchecked\n",
18018                "does not start with schema 1",
18019            ),
18020            ("schema\t1\n", "has no status line"),
18021            (
18022                "schema\t1\nstatus\tchecked\nmissing\tfixture-test/fixtures/program\n",
18023                "has a malformed line",
18024            ),
18025        ] {
18026            verdict(text);
18027            let refused = refusal();
18028            assert_eq!(
18029                refused.error_kind.as_deref(),
18030                Some(ROOTFS_UNCHECKED),
18031                "{text:?}"
18032            );
18033            refused.require_current_classification().unwrap();
18034            let reason = refused.reason.as_deref().unwrap();
18035            assert!(reason.contains(want), "{text:?}: {reason}");
18036            assert!(is_v2_retry_refusal(&refused));
18037        }
18038        fs::remove_file(root.join(V2_ROOTFS_VERDICT_FILE)).unwrap();
18039        let absent = refusal();
18040        assert_eq!(absent.error_kind.as_deref(), Some(ROOTFS_UNCHECKED));
18041        let reason = absent.reason.as_deref().unwrap();
18042        assert!(reason.contains("cannot read"), "{reason}");
18043
18044        // An ordinary infrastructure row is no v2 refusal.
18045        assert!(!is_v2_retry_refusal(&infrastructure_error_result(
18046            &context,
18047            &cell,
18048            "spawn failed".into()
18049        )));
18050        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
18051    }

18213    #[test]
18214    fn a_parity_probe_runs_a_disabled_verify_cell_on_ptraces_inputs() {
18215        let mut test = recipe(true);
18216        let mode = test.modes.get_mut("verify").unwrap();
18217        mode.guest_args
18218            .insert("ptrace".into(), vec!["53".into(), "5".into()]);
18219        mode.guest_args.insert("kvm".into(), vec!["kvm-own".into()]);
18220        mode.timeout_seconds.insert("ptrace".into(), 91);
18221        mode.cpu_timeout_seconds.insert("ptrace".into(), 32);
18222        mode.slow_reason
18223            .insert("ptrace".into(), "the ptrace workload is slow".into());
18224        validate_mode("fixture/test", "verify", mode, 60).unwrap();
18225        let set = ManifestSet {
18226            documents: Vec::new(),
18227            tests: BTreeMap::from([(
18228                test.id.clone(),
18229                ("fixture".into(), 60, DEFAULT_TEST_CPU_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, test),
18230            )]),
18231        };
18232        let probe = |backend: &str, parity_inputs: bool| {
18233            let cells = set
18234                .select(&Selection {
18235                    population: Some(Population::Disabled),
18236                    test: Some("fixture/test".into()),
18237                    mode: Some("verify".into()),
18238                    backend: Some(backend.into()),
18239                    parity_inputs,
18240                    ..Selection::default()
18241                })
18242                .unwrap();
18243            assert_eq!(cells.len(), 1);
18244            cells.into_iter().next().unwrap()
18245        };
18246        let liteinst = probe("liteinst", true);
18247        assert!(!liteinst.enabled);
18248        assert_eq!(cell_guest_args(&liteinst, "liteinst"), ["53", "5"]);
18249        // The probe keeps its own budget, the one the pressure test sizes its
18250        // enclosing allowance from, not ptrace's.
18251        assert_eq!(
18252            (liteinst.timeout_seconds, liteinst.cpu_timeout_seconds),
18253            (60, DEFAULT_TEST_CPU_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
18254        );
18255        let verify = &liteinst.test.modes["verify"];
18256        assert_eq!(
18257            cell_hermit_args(verify, "liteinst"),
18258            ["--max-timeslice=disabled"]
18259        );
18260        assert_eq!(
18261            verify
18262                .hermit_args_reason
18263                .as_ref()
18264                .and_then(|reason| reason.for_backend("liteinst")),
18265            Some(PARITY_PROBE_HERMIT_ARGS_REASON)
18266        );
18267        validate_mode("fixture/test", "verify", verify, 60).unwrap();
18268        // A backend's own declared arguments are kept, and only the in-guest
18269        // backends get the timeslice flag.
18270        let kvm = probe("kvm", true);
18271        assert_eq!(cell_guest_args(&kvm, "kvm"), ["kvm-own"]);
18272        assert!(cell_hermit_args(&kvm.test.modes["verify"], "kvm").is_empty());
18273        // Without --parity-inputs a probe is exactly the manifest's.
18274        let plain = probe("liteinst", false);
18275        assert!(cell_guest_args(&plain, "liteinst").is_empty());
18276        assert!(cell_hermit_args(&plain.test.modes["verify"], "liteinst").is_empty());
18277        assert_eq!(plain.timeout_seconds, 60);
18278    }

18280    #[test]
18281    fn a_parity_probe_does_not_borrow_another_backends_shared_flag_reason() {
18282        // c-programs/sigreturn-preemption's shape: ptrace carries a flag with a
18283        // shared reason written for it alone.
18284        let mut test = recipe(true);
18285        let mode = test.modes.get_mut("verify").unwrap();
18286        mode.hermit_args
18287            .insert("ptrace".into(), vec!["--no-virtualize-cpuid".into()]);
18288        mode.hermit_args_reason = Some(HermitArgsReason::Shared(
18289            "ptrace reads the host CPUID for this probe of the signal path".into(),
18290        ));
18291        validate_mode("fixture/test", "verify", mode, 60).unwrap();
18292        let probed = with_parity_inputs(&test, "in-guest-trap");
18293        let verify = &probed.modes["verify"];
18294        let reason = verify.hermit_args_reason.as_ref().unwrap();
18295        assert_eq!(
18296            reason.for_backend("in-guest-trap"),
18297            Some(PARITY_PROBE_HERMIT_ARGS_REASON)
18298        );
18299        assert_eq!(
18300            reason.for_backend("ptrace"),
18301            Some("ptrace reads the host CPUID for this probe of the signal path")
18302        );
18303        validate_mode("fixture/test", "verify", verify, 60).unwrap();
18304        // An enabled backend is never probed: its recipe is untouched.
18305        let untouched = with_parity_inputs(&test, "ptrace");
18306        assert!(matches!(
18307            untouched.modes["verify"].hermit_args_reason,
18308            Some(HermitArgsReason::Shared(_))
18309        ));
18310    }
