22289    #[test]
22290    fn the_cgroup_membership_check_refuses_every_process_it_sees_outside_the_cgroup() {
22291        let invocation = "/runner/hermit-e2e-invocation-1";
22292        let check = |leader_unreaped: bool,
22293                     members: Result<Vec<u32>, String>,
22294                     cgroups: &[(u32, Result<Option<&str>, &str>)]| {
22295            check_cgroup_membership(
22296                7,
22297                leader_unreaped,
22298                invocation,
22299                |pgid| {
22300                    assert_eq!(pgid, 7, "the leader's PID names its process group");
22301                    members
22302                },
22303                |pid| match cgroups.iter().find(|(member, _)| *member == pid) {
22304                    Some((_, Ok(cgroup))) => Ok(cgroup.map(str::to_owned)),
22305                    Some((_, Err(error))) => Err((*error).to_owned()),
22306                    None => panic!("process {pid} was not expected to be checked"),
22307                },
22308            )
22309        };
22310        let inside = Ok(Some(invocation));
22311        let nested = Ok(Some("/runner/hermit-e2e-invocation-1/nested"));
22312        let parent = Ok(Some("/runner"));
22313        // Shares the invocation's name as a prefix but is a sibling cgroup.
22314        let sibling = Ok(Some("/runner/hermit-e2e-invocation-10"));
22315        let gone = Ok(None);
22316
22317        assert_eq!(
22318            check(
22319                true,
22320                Ok(vec![7, 8, 9]),
22321                &[(7, inside), (8, nested), (9, inside)]
22322            ),
22323            Ok(())
22324        );
22325        // A member that exited between the scan and its cgroup read is gone,
22326        // not outside.
22327        assert_eq!(
22328            check(true, Ok(vec![7, 8]), &[(7, inside), (8, gone)]),
22329            Ok(())
22330        );
22331        // A reaped leader is not checked; only its group's members remain.
22332        assert_eq!(check(false, Ok(vec![8]), &[(8, nested)]), Ok(()));
22333
22334        for (label, leader_unreaped, members, cgroups, offender) in [
22335            (
22336                "member in the parent",
22337                true,
22338                vec![7, 8],
22339                vec![(7, inside), (8, parent)],
22340                "process 8 (a member",
22341            ),
22342            (
22343                "member in a sibling",
22344                true,
22345                vec![7, 8],
22346                vec![(7, inside), (8, sibling)],
22347                "process 8 (a member",
22348            ),
22349            (
22350                "member after the leader exited",
22351                false,
22352                vec![8],
22353                vec![(8, parent)],
22354                "process 8 (a member",
22355            ),
22356            // The leader left its process group as well as its cgroup; the
22357            // pidfd-named leader is still checked.
22358            (
22359                "leader in another group",
22360                true,
22361                vec![],
22362                vec![(7, parent)],
22363                "process 7 (the leader)",
22364            ),
22365            (
22366                "leader in its group",
22367                true,
22368                vec![7],
22369                vec![(7, sibling)],
22370                "process 7 (the leader)",
22371            ),
22372        ] {
22373            let refusal = check(leader_unreaped, Ok(members), &cgroups)
22374                .expect_err(&format!("{label}: a process outside must be refused"));
22375            assert!(refusal.contains(offender), "{label}: {refusal}");
22376            assert!(
22377                refusal.contains("outside its invocation cgroup /runner/hermit-e2e-invocation-1"),
22378                "{label}: {refusal}"
22379            );
22380        }
22381
22382        // A check that cannot be made refuses rather than passes.
22383        let unreadable = check(true, Ok(vec![7, 8]), &[(7, inside), (8, Err("EACCES"))])
22384            .expect_err("an unreadable member must be refused");
22385        assert!(
22386            unreadable.contains("cannot check") && unreadable.contains("EACCES"),
22387            "{unreadable}"
22388        );
22389        let unscanned = check(true, Err("/proc: EMFILE".into()), &[])
22390            .expect_err("a failed process-group scan must be refused");
22391        assert!(
22392            unscanned.contains("cannot check") && unscanned.contains("EMFILE"),
22393            "{unscanned}"
22394        );
22395
22396        assert!(within_cgroup(invocation, invocation));
22397        assert!(within_cgroup(
22398            "/runner/hermit-e2e-invocation-1/a/b",
22399            invocation
22400        ));
22401        assert!(!within_cgroup(
22402            "/runner/hermit-e2e-invocation-10",
22403            invocation
22404        ));
22405        assert!(!within_cgroup("/runner", invocation));
22406        assert!(!within_cgroup("/", invocation));
22407    }

22409    #[test]
22410    fn the_real_membership_readers_find_this_process_and_its_group() {
22411        // The production readers, on this test process: it is in its own
22412        // process group's member list and in the cgroup its `0::` line names.
22413        let pid = std::process::id();
22414        let pgid = unsafe { libc::getpgid(0) } as u32;
22415        let members = process_group_members(pgid).unwrap();
22416        assert!(members.contains(&pid), "{pid} not among {members:?}");
22417        let own = fs::read_to_string("/proc/self/cgroup").unwrap();
22418        let expected = own
22419            .lines()
22420            .find_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("0::"))
22421            .expect("a cgroup v2 line");
22422        assert_eq!(process_cgroup(pid).unwrap().as_deref(), Some(expected));
22423        // Other processes share this test's process group, and other tests
22424        // move their children between cgroups, so only this process is fed
22425        // to the check, through the real cgroup reader.
22426        assert_eq!(
22427            check_cgroup_membership(pid, true, expected, |_| Ok(vec![pid]), process_cgroup),
22428            Ok(())
22429        );
22430        let elsewhere = check_cgroup_membership(
22431            pid,
22432            true,
22433            "/not-this-cgroup",
22434            |_| Ok(vec![pid]),
22435            process_cgroup,
22436        )
22437        .expect_err("this process is not in /not-this-cgroup");
22438        assert!(
22439            elsewhere.contains(&format!("is in cgroup {expected},")),
22440            "{elsewhere}"
22441        );
22442        // A reaped process reads as gone, not as an error.
22443        let mut child = std::process::Command::new("/bin/true").spawn().unwrap();
22444        let reaped = child.id();
22445        child.wait().unwrap();
22446        assert_eq!(process_cgroup(reaped), Ok(None));

22449    #[test]
22450    fn the_process_group_is_read_after_the_last_parenthesis_of_any_command_name() {
22451        // A command name holds up to 15 bytes of anything: parentheses,
22452        // spaces and bytes that are not UTF-8.
22453        assert_eq!(
22454            stat_process_group(b"4124033 (a\xff) (\xfe b) S 1 4124001 4124001 0 -1"),
22455            Some(4124001)
22456        );
22457        assert_eq!(stat_process_group(b"7 (sleep) S 1 7 7 0 -1"), Some(7));
22458        for malformed in [
22459            &b"7 sleep S 1 7 7 0 -1"[..],
22460            b"7 (sleep) S 1",
22461            b"7 (sleep) S 1 x 7",
22462            b"7 (sleep) S 1 \xff 7",
22463            b"",
22464        ] {
22465            assert_eq!(
22466                stat_process_group(malformed),
22467                None,
22468                "{}",
22469                String::from_utf8_lossy(malformed)
22470            );
22471        }
22472    }

22474    fn reads(
22475        script: Vec<Result<StatRead, String>>,
22476    ) -> (
22477        std::rc::Rc<std::cell::Cell<usize>>,
22478        impl FnMut(u32) -> Result<StatRead, String>,
22479    ) {
22480        let count = std::rc::Rc::new(std::cell::Cell::new(0));
22481        let seen = count.clone();
22482        let mut script = script.into_iter();
22483        let read = move |pid: u32| {
22484            assert_eq!(pid, 7);
22485            seen.set(seen.get() + 1);
22486            script.next().expect("no more reads were expected")
22487        };
22488        (count, read)
22489    }

22571    #[test]
22572    fn a_process_named_with_bytes_that_are_not_utf8_does_not_fail_the_scan() {
22573        use std::os::unix::ffi::OsStrExt;
22574
22575        // Exec names a process after the last component of the path it ran,
22576        // so a child run through this symlink is named with bytes that are
22577        // not UTF-8. The scan reads every process's stat, whichever group it
22578        // looks for, so such a name anywhere on the host reaches it.
22579        let base = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("runner-non-utf8-{}", std::process::id()));
22580        fs::create_dir_all(&base).unwrap();
22581        let name = b"scan\xff) (\xfe";
22582        let link = base.join(OsStr::from_bytes(name));
22583        std::os::unix::fs::symlink("/bin/sleep", &link).unwrap();
22584        let mut child = Command::new(&link)
22585            .arg("30")
22586            .process_group(0)
22587            .spawn()
22588            .unwrap();
22589        let pid = child.id();
22590        // Exec renames the process after the spawn has returned, so wait for
22591        // the name before scanning.
22592        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(10);
22593        let renamed = loop {
22594            let comm = fs::read(format!("/proc/{pid}/comm")).unwrap_or_default();
22595            if comm.strip_suffix(b"\n") == Some(&name[..]) {
22596                break true;
22597            }
22598            if Instant::now() >= deadline {
22599                break false;
22600            }
22601            thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
22602        };
22603        let members = process_group_members(pid);
22604        let _ = child.kill();
22605        let _ = child.wait();
22606        fs::remove_dir_all(&base).unwrap();
22607        assert!(renamed, "the child never took the symlink's name");
22608        assert_eq!(members, Ok(vec![pid]));
22609    }

22611    #[test]
22612    fn a_membership_refusal_stops_the_invocation_and_charges_nothing() {
22613        use std::cell::Cell;
22614
22615        // Each place the monitor checks membership must turn a refusal into a
22616        // stopped, reaped, uncharged invocation: at a live poll, before a wall
22617        // stop, and after the leader returned.
22618        for (case, script, poll, wall) in [
22619            ("poll", "exec sleep 30", Duration::from_millis(50), 20),
22620            ("wall", "exec sleep 30", Duration::from_secs(600), 1),
22621            ("return", "exit 0", Duration::from_secs(600), 20),
22622        ] {
22623            let root = cpu_reader_test_root(&format!("membership-refusal-{case}"));
22624            let (child, started, mut observation) = spawn_fixture_with_source(
22625                &root,
22626                case,
22627                script,
22628                Some(LiveCpuSource::CgroupV2InvocationCpuStatV1),
22629            );
22630            let pid = child.id();
22631            let checks = Cell::new(Vec::new());
22632            let result = monitor_live_cpu_in(
22633                child,
22634                ProcessLimits {
22635                    deadline: started + Duration::from_secs(wall),
22636                    cpu_budget_usec: Some(60_000_000),
22637                    cpu_poll_interval: poll,
22638                },
22639                started,
22640                &mut observation,
22641                None,
22642                |checked, leader_unreaped| {
22643                    let mut seen = checks.take();
22644                    seen.push((checked, leader_unreaped));
22645                    let refuse = case != "poll" || seen.len() >= 2;
22646                    checks.set(seen);
22647                    if refuse {
22648                        Err("process 1 (fixture) is outside its invocation cgroup".into())
22649                    } else {
22650                        Ok(())
22651                    }
22652                },
22653                |_| Ok(()),
22654                |_, _| Ok(10),
22655            );
22656            let error = result.map(|_| ()).expect_err(&format!(
22657                "{case}: a membership refusal must fail the invocation"
22658            ));
22659            assert!(
22660                error.contains("outside its invocation cgroup"),
22661                "{case}: {error}"
22662            );
22663            assert_eq!(
22664                observation.termination,
22665                TerminationPath::CgroupMembershipStop,
22666                "{case}"
22667            );
22668            assert_eq!(
22669                observation.returned_cpu_charge,
22670                ReturnedCpuCharge::Unavailable,
22671                "{case}"
22672            );
22673            assert!(owned_child_is_reaped(pid), "{case}");
22674            let seen = checks.take();
22675            assert!(
22676                seen.iter().all(|(checked, _)| *checked == pid),
22677                "{case}: {seen:?}"
22678            );
22679            let live = enabled_cpu(&observation);
22680            match case {
22681                // The refused poll took no sample, so no trigger can be
22682                // recorded beside the refusal.
22683                "poll" => {
22684                    assert_eq!(seen, vec![(pid, true), (pid, true)]);
22685                    assert_eq!(live.polls, 1);
22686                }
22687                "wall" => {
22688                    assert_eq!(seen, vec![(pid, true)]);
22689                    assert_eq!(live.polls, 0);
22690                }
22691                _ => {
22692                    assert_eq!(seen, vec![(pid, false)]);
22693                    assert!(matches!(
22694                        observation.final_wait,
22695                        FinalWaitObservation::Reaped { raw_status: 0, .. }
22696                    ));
22697                }
22698            }
22699            validate_native_observation(&observation);
22700            fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
22701        }
22702    }

22704    /// A process moves itself out of its invocation cgroup into the runner's
22705    /// own cgroup above it, keeping the command's process group. The cgroup
22706    /// counter no longer sees its CPU, which the process-group scan the
22707    /// cgroup replaced would have charged, so the invocation must be stopped
22708    /// and refused rather than charged or passed. The four cases put the
22709    /// escape where each check must catch it: at a live poll (the leader
22710    /// itself, and a member found by the process-group scan), after the
22711    /// leader exits with status 0, and before a wall stop, the last two with
22712    /// no live poll at all.
22713    #[test]
22714    fn a_process_that_moves_out_of_its_invocation_cgroup_is_stopped_and_refused() {
22715        const CHILD: &str = "HERMIT_TEST_CGROUP_MOVE_REFUSAL_CHILD";
22716        const CASE: &str = "runner::tests::a_process_that_moves_out_of_its_invocation_cgroup_is_stopped_and_refused";
22717        if std::env::var_os(CHILD).is_none() {
22718            // Each case below must be refused inside a few seconds of wall
22719            // budget. In the parallel libtest process the escaping process
22720            // and the monitor that must catch it can sit unscheduled behind
22721            // every other test's children until the budget is spent, so the
22722            // measurement is made in an isolated child process, as the
22723            // descriptor-reserve test isolates its process-wide rlimit.
22724            let output = Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())
22725                .args(["--exact", CASE, "--nocapture"])
22726                .env(CHILD, "1")
22727                .output()
22728                .unwrap();
22729            assert!(
22730                output.status.success(),
22731                "{}\n{}",
22732                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
22733                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
22734            );
22735            print!("{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout));
22736            return;
22737        }
22738        use crate::invocation_cgroup::tests::KillPidFile;
22739        use crate::invocation_cgroup::tests::OWN_CGROUP_SH;
22740        use crate::invocation_cgroup::tests::RemoveLeftoverCgroup;
22741        let test = "a_process_that_moves_out_of_its_invocation_cgroup_is_stopped_and_refused";
22742        let Some(probe) = crate::invocation_cgroup::tests::real_cgroup_or_declared_absent(test)
22743        else {
22744            return;
22745        };
22746        drop(probe);
22747        let _plan = LiveCpuPlanOverride::set(Ok(false), None);
22748        let mut failures = Vec::new();
22749        // (case, CPU poll interval, wall budget, latest acceptable refusal)
22750        for (case, poll, wall, refused_within) in [
22751            ("leader", CELL_CPU_POLL_INTERVAL, 8, 6),
22752            ("member", CELL_CPU_POLL_INTERVAL, 8, 6),
22753            ("member-then-leader-exits", Duration::from_secs(600), 8, 6),
22754            ("member-until-wall", Duration::from_secs(600), 2, 6),
22755        ] {
22756            let root = cpu_reader_test_root(&format!("cgroup-escape-{case}"));
22757            let saved = root.join("leader.cgroup");
22758            let pid_file = root.join("escaped.pid");
22759            let _leftovers = RemoveLeftoverCgroup(saved.clone());
22760            let _escaped = KillPidFile(pid_file.clone());
22761            // `$cg` is the invocation cgroup; `${cg%/*}` is the runner's own
22762            // cgroup above it. A background job of a noninteractive shell
22763            // stays in the leader's process group.
22764            let member = format!(
22765                r#"/bin/sh -c 'echo $$ > "$1/cgroup.procs" && echo $$ > "$2.tmp" && mv "$2.tmp" "$2" && exec sleep 30' sh "${{cg%/*}}" '{pid}' & while [ ! -s '{pid}' ]; do sleep 0.05; done; "#,
22766                pid = pid_file.display()
22767            );
22768            let body = match case {
22769                "leader" => format!(
22770                    r#"echo $$ > "${{cg%/*}}/cgroup.procs" && echo $$ > '{pid}' && exec sleep 30"#,
22771                    pid = pid_file.display()
22772                ),
22773                "member-then-leader-exits" => format!("{member}exit 0"),
22774                _ => format!("{member}exec sleep 30"),
22775            };
22776            let script = format!(
22777                "cat /proc/self/cgroup > '{saved}'; {OWN_CGROUP_SH}{body}",
22778                saved = saved.display()
22779            );
22780            let request = ProcessRequest::new(
22781                InvocationRole::Execution {
22782                    attempt_index: "1".into(),
22783                    backend: RequiredNullable::Null,
22784                },
22785                &root,
22786                "/bin/sh",
22787                &["-c".into(), script],
22788                &BTreeMap::new(),
22789                &root.join("leader.stdout"),
22790                &root.join("leader.stderr"),
22791            );
22792            let mut observations = Vec::new();
22793            let started = Instant::now();
22794            let result = execute_process_with_cpu_poll_interval(
22795                request,
22796                ProcessLimits {
22797                    deadline: started + Duration::from_secs(wall),
22798                    cpu_budget_usec: Some(60_000_000),
22799                    cpu_poll_interval: poll,
22800                },
22801                &mut observations,
22802            );
22803            let elapsed = started.elapsed();
22804            let shown = match &result {
22805                Ok(output) => format!(
22806                    "Ok(status {:?}, timeout {:?}, cpu {} usec)",
22807                    output.status, output.timeout, output.cpu_usage_usec
22808                ),
22809                Err(reason) => format!("Err({reason})"),
22810            };
22811            let observation = &observations[0];
22812            let termination = serde_json::to_value(&observation.termination).unwrap();
22813            let mut problems = Vec::new();
22814            match &result {
22815                Err(reason) if reason.contains("outside its invocation cgroup") => {}
22816                _ => problems.push("the result is not a cgroup refusal".to_string()),
22817            }
22818            if termination != serde_json::json!("cgroup_membership_stop") {
22819                problems.push(format!("termination {termination}"));
22820            }
22821            if observation.returned_cpu_charge != ReturnedCpuCharge::Unavailable {
22822                problems.push(format!("charge {:?}", observation.returned_cpu_charge));
22823            }
22824            if enabled_cpu(observation).source != LiveCpuSource::CgroupV2InvocationCpuStatV1 {
22825                problems.push("not the cgroup source".into());
22826            }
22827            if elapsed >= Duration::from_secs(refused_within) {
22828                problems.push(format!("refused only after {elapsed:?}"));
22829            }
22830            if case == "member-then-leader-exits"
22831                && !matches!(
22832                    observation.final_wait,
22833                    FinalWaitObservation::Reaped { raw_status: 0, .. }
22834                )
22835            {
22836                problems.push(format!("final wait {:?}", observation.final_wait));
22837            }
22838            let directory = saved_cgroup_directory(&saved);
22839            if directory.exists() {
22840                problems.push(format!("{} is left behind", directory.display()));
22841            }
22842            // The escaped process kept the leader's process group, so the
22843            // stop's group signals reach it outside the cgroup.
22844            let LaunchObservation::Spawned { pid: leader, .. } = observation.launch else {
22845                panic!("{case}: not launched: {observation:?}");
22846            };
22847            let escaped = fs::read_to_string(&pid_file).unwrap_or_default();
22848            let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(2);
22849            loop {
22850                let state = fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{}/stat", escaped.trim()))
22851                    .ok()
22852                    .and_then(|stat| {
22853                        let rest = stat.rsplit_once(") ")?.1.to_owned();
22854                        let mut fields = rest.split_whitespace();
22855                        Some((fields.next()?.to_owned(), fields.nth(1)?.to_owned()))
22856                    });
22857                match state {
22858                    Some((state, group)) if state != "Z" && group == leader.to_string() => {
22859                        if Instant::now() >= deadline {
22860                            problems.push(format!("escaped process {} survived", escaped.trim()));
22861                            break;
22862                        }
22863                        thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
22864                    }
22865                    _ => break,
22866                }
22867            }
22868            if problems.is_empty() {
22869                validate_native_observation(observation);
22870            } else {
22871                failures.push(format!("{case}: {problems:?} after {elapsed:?}: {shown}"));
22872            }
22873            fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
22874        }
22875        assert!(failures.is_empty(), "{failures:#?}");
22876    }

22878    #[test]
22879    fn failed_later_launch_retains_prior_attempt_and_cpu_observations() {
22880        const CHILD: &str = "HERMIT_TEST_PRIOR_WORK_BEFORE_SPAWN_FAILURE_CHILD";
22881        const CASE: &str =
22882            "runner::tests::failed_later_launch_retains_prior_attempt_and_cpu_observations";
22883        if std::env::var_os(CHILD).is_none() {
22884            // The first attempt must finish well inside the cell's wall
22885            // backstop so the second attempt reaches its spawn and fails
22886            // there. In the parallel libtest process a trivial first command
22887            // can sit unscheduled for seconds behind every other test's
22888            // children, and the second attempt then reports the backstop
22889            // instead of the spawn failure, so the cell runs in an isolated
22890            // child process, as the descriptor-reserve test isolates its
22891            // process-wide rlimit.
22892            let output = Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())
22893                .args(["--exact", CASE, "--nocapture"])
22894                .env(CHILD, "1")
22895                .output()
22896                .unwrap();
22897            assert!(
22898                output.status.success(),
22899                "{}\n{}",
22900                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
22901                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
22902            );
22903            print!("{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout));
22904            return;
22905        }
22906        let root = cpu_reader_test_root("prior-work-before-spawn-failure");
22907        let context = run_context(&root);
22908        let program = root.join("remove-self");

22910            &program,
22911            "#!/bin/sh\nrm -- \"$0\"\nprintf measured\n",
22912            0o755,
22913        )
22914        .unwrap();
22915        let mut cell = native_cpu_cell("unused", 2);
22916        cell.test.direct = Some(DirectCommand::Argv(vec![program.display().to_string()]));
22917        let failure = run_cell(&context, &cell).expect_err("second launch must fail after unlink");
22918        let row = failure.into_result(&context, &cell);
22919        assert_eq!(row.outcome, "ERROR");
22920        assert_eq!(row.cpu_usage_usec, None);
22921        assert_eq!(row.attempts.len(), 1, "{row:?}");
22922        assert_eq!(row.attempts[0].stdout, "measured");
22923        let invocations = &row.cpu_observations.as_ref().unwrap().invocations;
22924        assert_eq!(invocations.len(), 2);
22925        assert_eq!(invocations[0].termination, TerminationPath::CompletedWait4);
22926        assert_eq!(
22927            row.attempts[0].cpu_usage_usec,
22928            Some(measured_final_cpu(&invocations[0]))
22929        );
22930        assert_eq!(invocations[1].ordinal, 2);
22931        assert!(matches!(
22932            invocations[1].launch,
22933            LaunchObservation::SpawnFailed {
22934                stage: SpawnStage::Spawn,
22935                ..
22936            }
22937        ));
22938        assert_eq!(
22939            invocations[1].final_wait,
22940            FinalWaitObservation::NotApplicable
22941        );
22942        assert_eq!(
22943            invocations[1].returned_cpu_charge,
22944            ReturnedCpuCharge::Unavailable
22945        );
22946        row.require_cpu_observations().unwrap();
22947        assert_cpu_source_roundtrip(&row);
22948        append_result(&root.join("results.jsonl"), &row).unwrap();
22949        println!(
22950            "CPU_PARTIAL_WORK_ROW {}",
22951            serde_json::to_string(&row).unwrap()
22952        );
22953        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
22954    }

22956    #[test]
22957    fn native_zombie_then_reaped_child_has_no_double_cpu_charge() {
22958        const CHILD: &str = "HERMIT_TEST_ZOMBIE_REAP_CPU_CHILD";
22959        const CASE: &str =
22960            "runner::tests::native_zombie_then_reaped_child_has_no_double_cpu_charge";
22961        if std::env::var_os(CHILD).is_none() {
22962            // The phase handshake below advances on the monitor's poll
22963            // samples inside a five-second deadline. In the parallel libtest
22964            // process those samples queue on the same process-global CPU
22965            // registry as every other test's monitor, and a delayed sample
22966            // lets the deadline stop the fixture mid-handshake, so the
22967            // measurement is made in an isolated child process, as the
22968            // descriptor-reserve test isolates its process-wide rlimit.
22969            let output = Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())
22970                .args(["--exact", CASE, "--nocapture"])
22971                .env(CHILD, "1")
22972                .output()
22973                .unwrap();
22974            assert!(
22975                output.status.success(),
22976                "{}\n{}",
22977                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
22978                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
22979            );
22980            print!("{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout));
22981            return;
22982        }
22983        use std::io::Read;
22984        use std::os::unix::net::UnixListener;
22985
22986        let root = cpu_reader_test_root("zombie-reap-cpu");
22987        let source = root.join("work.c");
22988        let program = root.join("work");
22989        // The parent holds the real zombie until the monitor releases it,
22990        // then holds the reaped state until a second real source sample.
22991        fs::write(&source, r#"
22992#define _GNU_SOURCE
22993#include <assert.h>
22994#include <stdint.h>
22995#include <stdio.h>
22996#include <stdlib.h>
22997#include <string.h>
22998#include <sys/resource.h>
22999#include <sys/socket.h>
23000#include <sys/un.h>
23001#include <sys/wait.h>
23002#include <time.h>
23003#include <unistd.h>
23004static uint64_t cpu_ns(void) {
23005    struct timespec t;
23006    assert(clock_gettime(CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID, &t) == 0);
23007    return (uint64_t)t.tv_sec * 1000000000 + t.tv_nsec;
23008}
23009static void phase(int fd, char mark) {
23010    assert(write(fd, &mark, 1) == 1);
23011    char ack;
23012    assert(read(fd, &ack, 1) == 1 && ack == mark);
23013}
23014int main(int argc, char **argv) {
23015    assert(argc == 2);
23016    int fd = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
23017    assert(fd >= 0);
23018    struct sockaddr_un address = { .sun_family = AF_UNIX };
23019    assert(strlen(argv[1]) < sizeof(address.sun_path));
23020    strcpy(address.sun_path, argv[1]);
23021    assert(connect(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&address, sizeof(address)) == 0);
23022    int child_clock[2];
23023    assert(pipe(child_clock) == 0);
23024    pid_t child = fork();
23025    assert(child >= 0);
23026    if (child == 0) {
23027        close(child_clock[0]);
23028        uint64_t started = cpu_ns();
23029        while (cpu_ns() - started < 250000000) {}
23030        uint64_t used = cpu_ns();
23031        assert(write(child_clock[1], &used, sizeof(used)) == sizeof(used));
23032        _exit(0);
23033    }
23034    close(child_clock[1]);
23035    uint64_t child_ns;
23036    assert(read(child_clock[0], &child_ns, sizeof(child_ns)) == sizeof(child_ns));
23037    siginfo_t info;
23038    assert(waitid(P_PID, child, &info, WEXITED | WNOWAIT) == 0);
23039    assert(info.si_pid == child && info.si_code == CLD_EXITED && info.si_status == 0);
23040    phase(fd, 'Z');
23041    int status;
23042    struct rusage used;
23043    assert(wait4(child, &status, 0, &used) == child);
23044    assert(WIFEXITED(status) && WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0);
23045    phase(fd, 'R');
23046    printf("{\"child_clock_ns\":%llu,\"child_user_usec\":%llu,\"child_system_usec\":%llu,\"parent_clock_ns\":%llu}\n",
23047        (unsigned long long)child_ns,
23048        (unsigned long long)used.ru_utime.tv_sec * 1000000 + used.ru_utime.tv_usec,
23049        (unsigned long long)used.ru_stime.tv_sec * 1000000 + used.ru_stime.tv_usec,
23050        (unsigned long long)cpu_ns());
23051    return 0;
23052}
23053"#).unwrap();
23054        assert!(
23055            Command::new("cc")
23056                .args(["-O2", "-Wall", "-Werror"])
23057                .arg(&source)
23058                .arg("-o")
23059                .arg(&program)
23060                .status()
23061                .unwrap()
23062                .success()
23063        );
23064        // Bind a short pathname inside this isolated test child. The C
23065        // fixture also runs in root; restore cwd before checking the bind.
23066        let previous_cwd = std::env::current_dir().unwrap();
23067        std::env::set_current_dir(&root).unwrap();
23068        let socket = Path::new("phase.sock");
23069        let listener = UnixListener::bind(socket);
23070        std::env::set_current_dir(previous_cwd).unwrap();
23071        let listener = listener.unwrap();
23072        listener.set_nonblocking(true).unwrap();
23073        let request = ProcessRequest::new(
23074            InvocationRole::Execution {
23075                attempt_index: "1".into(),
23076                backend: RequiredNullable::Null,
23077            },
23078            &root,
23079            program.to_str().unwrap(),
23080            &[socket.display().to_string()],
23081            &BTreeMap::new(),
23082            &root.join("work.stdout"),
23083            &root.join("work.stderr"),
23084        );
23085        let started = Instant::now();
23086        let mut observation = InvocationCpuObservation::pending(
23087            1,
23088            request.role,
23089            request.command,
23090            Some(LiveCpuSource::AgentUtilsPairedPidfdStatV1),
23091        );
23092        let child = spawn_process(
23093            &request.cwd,
23094            &request.stdout,
23095            &request.stderr,
23096            None,
23097            &mut observation,
23098        )
23099        .unwrap();
23100        let mut connection = None;
23101        let mut phase = None;
23102        let mut phase_samples = Vec::new();
23103        let output = monitor_process(
23104            child,
23105            ProcessLimits {
23106                deadline: started + Duration::from_secs(5),
23107                cpu_budget_usec: Some(2_000_000),
23108                cpu_poll_interval: CELL_CPU_POLL_INTERVAL,
23109            },
23110            started,
23111            &mut observation,
23112            |pid| dagrun::proccpu::ProcessGroupCpu::new(pid).map_err(|error| error.to_string()),
23113            |reader| {
23114                // Always call the actual generation-bound source first. The
23115                // handshake never substitutes a measured value or adds polls.
23116                let seconds = reader.seconds().map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
23117                if connection.is_none() {
23118                    match listener.accept() {
23119                        Ok((stream, _)) => {
23120                            stream.set_nonblocking(true).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
23121                            connection = Some(stream);
23122                        }
23123                        Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {}
23124                        Err(error) => return Err(error.to_string()),
23125                    }
23126                }
23127                if let Some(stream) = &mut connection {
23128                    if phase.is_none() {
23129                        let mut mark = [0];
23130                        match stream.read(&mut mark) {
23131                            Ok(1) => phase = Some((mark[0], Instant::now())),
23132                            Ok(_) => return Err("native phase peer closed early".into()),
23133                            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {}
23134                            Err(error) => return Err(error.to_string()),
23135                        }
23136                    }
23137                    // AU's existing shared snapshot TTL is 500ms. Hold each
23138                    // state longer so its accepted sample cannot predate it.
23139                    if let Some((mark, _)) = phase.filter(|(_, since): &(u8, Instant)| {
23140                        since.elapsed() >= Duration::from_millis(600)
23141                    }) {
23142                        phase_samples.push((mark, live_cpu_usage_usec(0, seconds)?));
23143                        stream.write_all(&[mark]).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
23144                        phase = None;
23145                    }
23146                }
23147                Ok(seconds)
23148            },
23149        )
23150        .unwrap();
23151        assert!(
23152            output.status.success(),
23153            "{}",
23154            fs::read_to_string(&request.stderr).unwrap()
23155        );
23156        assert_eq!(output.timeout, None);
23157        assert_process_observation(&observation, &output);
23158        assert_eq!(
23159            phase_samples
23160                .iter()
23161                .map(|(mark, _)| *mark)
23162                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
23163            b"ZR"
23164        );
23165        let clocks: JsonValue =
23166            serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(&request.stdout).unwrap()).unwrap();
23167        assert!(clocks["child_clock_ns"].as_u64().unwrap() >= 250_000_000);
23168        let ticks = unsafe { libc::sysconf(libc::_SC_CLK_TCK) };
23169        assert!(ticks > 0);
23170        // Two processes, each with at most user/system tick quantization;
23171        // wait4's two microsecond components contribute at most 2us rounding.
23172        // This bound derives from the measurement units, not observed runs.
23173        let quantization_usec = 4 * 1_000_000u64.div_ceil(ticks as u64) + 2;
23174        let final_cpu = measured_final_cpu(&observation);
23175        let child_cpu = clocks["child_user_usec"].as_u64().unwrap()
23176            + clocks["child_system_usec"].as_u64().unwrap();
23177        assert!(child_cpu > quantization_usec * 2);
23178        assert!(final_cpu >= child_cpu);
23179        let RequiredNullable::Value(high) = &enabled_cpu(&observation).high_water else {
23180            panic!("native control must retain real live CPU samples");
23181        };
23182        assert!(
23183            high.cpu_usec <= final_cpu + quantization_usec,
23184            "live high-water duplicated waited CPU: {observation:?}"
23185        );
23186        for (_, sample) in &phase_samples {
23187            assert!(
23188                *sample + quantization_usec >= child_cpu,
23189                "child CPU disappeared across reap"
23190            );
23191        }
23192        println!(
23193            "CPU_NATIVE_ZOMBIE_REAP {}",
23194            serde_json::json!({
23195                "observation": observation, "clocks": clocks,
23196                "phase_samples": phase_samples, "clock_ticks_per_second": ticks,
23197                "quantization_bound_usec": quantization_usec,
23198            })
23199        );
23200        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
23201    }

23203    #[test]
23204    fn cpu_burner_is_stopped_by_the_cpu_budget() {
23205        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
23206            "hermit-runner-live-cpu-budget-{}",
23207            std::process::id()
23208        ));
23209        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
23210        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
23211        let spec = bounded_spec(&root, "burner", "while :; do :; done");
23212        let mut observations = Vec::new();
23213        let attempt = execute_spec_until(
23214            &spec,
23215            Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(5),
23216            1,
23217            5,

23219            &mut observations,

23368    #[test]
23369    fn live_cpu_budget_counts_descendant_work() {
23370        const CHILD: &str = "HERMIT_TEST_DESCENDANT_CPU_BUDGET_CHILD";
23371        const CASE: &str = "runner::tests::live_cpu_budget_counts_descendant_work";
23372        if std::env::var_os(CHILD).is_none() {
23373            // The descendant burner must accumulate its CPU budget well
23374            // inside the wall backstop. In the parallel libtest process it
23375            // can sit unscheduled behind every other test's children until
23376            // the backstop fires first, so the measurement is made in an
23377            // isolated child process, as the descriptor-reserve test
23378            // isolates its process-wide rlimit.
23379            let output = Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())
23380                .args(["--exact", CASE, "--nocapture"])
23381                .env(CHILD, "1")
23382                .output()
23383                .unwrap();
23384            assert!(
23385                output.status.success(),
23386                "{}\n{}",
23387                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
23388                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
23389            );
23390            print!("{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout));
23391            return;
23392        }
23393        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
23394            "hermit-runner-descendant-cpu-budget-{}",
23395            std::process::id()
23396        ));
23397        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
23398        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
23399        let output = bounded_process(
23400            &root,
23401            "descendant",
23402            "sh -c 'while :; do :; done' & wait",
23403            Duration::from_secs(5),
23404            100_000,
23405        );
23406        assert_eq!(output.timeout, Some(ProcessTimeout::Cpu));
23407        assert!(output.cpu_usage_usec >= 100_000);
23408        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
23409    }

23411    #[test]
23412    fn repeated_processes_share_one_aggregate_cpu_budget() {
23413        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
23414            "hermit-runner-aggregate-cpu-budget-{}",
23415            std::process::id()
23416        ));
23417        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
23418        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
23419        let limit = 300_000u64;
23420        // The wall here is a hang guard only (dh-ravrz): the CPU budget is
23421        // the limit under test, and on a loaded host a 5 s wall could fire
23422        // before the busy second process burned its small remaining CPU
23423        // budget, reporting Wall where the test asserts Cpu.
23424        let first = bounded_process(
23425            &root,
23426            "first",
23427            "head -c 8388608 /dev/zero | sha256sum >/dev/null",
23428            Duration::from_secs(30),
23429            limit,
23430        );
23431        assert!(first.status.success());
23432        assert_eq!(first.timeout, None);
23433        assert!(first.cpu_usage_usec < limit);
23434        let second = bounded_process(
23435            &root,
23436            "second",
23437            "while :; do :; done",
23438            Duration::from_secs(30),
23439            limit - first.cpu_usage_usec,
23440        );
23441        assert_eq!(second.timeout, Some(ProcessTimeout::Cpu));
23442        assert!(
23443            first.cpu_usage_usec.saturating_add(second.cpu_usage_usec) >= limit,
23444            "second process did not consume the remainder of the shared CPU budget"
23445        );
23446        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
23447    }

23457    #[test]
23458    fn sleeping_repeated_invocations_do_not_consume_the_cpu_budget() {
23459        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
23460            "hermit-runner-cell-deadline-{}",
23461            std::process::id()
23462        ));
23463        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
23464        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
23465
23466        let mut test = recipe(true);
23467        let counter = root.join("counter");
23468        test.direct = Some(DirectCommand::Argv(vec![
23469            "/bin/sh".into(),
23470            "-c".into(),
23471            format!(
23472                "count=$(cat '{}' 2>/dev/null || printf 0); count=$((count + 1)); printf '%s' \"$count\" > '{}'; sleep 0.7; printf '%s\\n' \"$count\"",
23473                counter.display(),
23474                counter.display()
23475            ),
23476        ]));
23477        let mut mode = test.modes.remove("verify").unwrap();
23478        mode.runs = Some(3);
23479        test.modes.insert("naked".into(), mode);
23480        // Widen the wall deadline and the upper duration bound against a
23481        // measured reference (dh-ravrz): time one real spawn+sleep on
23482        // this host; a loaded host that takes twice as long gets twice
23483        // the margin, so the start-up allowance scales with the host
23484        // instead of being consumed by it. The property is unchanged.
23485        let reference_started = std::time::Instant::now();
23486        let reference = std::process::Command::new("/bin/sh")
23487            .args(["-c", "sleep 0.7"])
23488            .status()
23489            .expect("reference sleep");
23490        assert!(reference.success());
23491        let host_factor = (reference_started.elapsed().as_secs_f64() / 0.7).clamp(1.0, 4.0);
23492        let phase_deadline_seconds = (10.0 * host_factor).ceil() as u64;
23493
23494        // The property under test: three attempts that each sleep 0.7 s spend
23495        // at least 2.1 s of wall time but almost no CPU, so the cell must
23496        // pass under a 1 s aggregate CPU budget. That needs only total wall
23497        // time > cpu_timeout_seconds; the wall deadline is the backstop for a
23498        // wedged process, not part of the property. A 3 s deadline left
23499        // about 0.9 s for three shell start-ups and timed out at 3.048 s on a
23500        // heavily loaded host, and a fixed 10 s bound timed out at 10.319 s
23501        // at load 210-250 (dh-ravrz-c8ce8eb264a): the deadline and the upper
23502        // duration bound now scale with the measured host factor above. The
23503        // lower bound of 2_000 ms still proves that wall time exceeded the
23504        // CPU budget.
23505        let cell = SelectedCell {
23506            image: None,
23507            category: "fixture".into(),
23508            id: CellId {
23509                test: test.id.clone(),
23510                mode: "naked".into(),
23511                backend: None,
23512            },
23513            test,
23514            enabled: true,
23515            timeout_seconds: phase_deadline_seconds,
23516            cpu_timeout_seconds: 1,
23517            host_level: HostLevel::default(),
23518        };
23519        let context = RunContext {
23520            command_bindings: BTreeMap::new(),
23521            root: root.clone(),
23522            hermit_bin: root.join("missing-hermit"),
23523            result_root: root.join("results"),
23524            build_root: root.join("build"),
23525            run_id: "fixture".into(),
23526            machine_shortname: "fixture-host".into(),
23527            kernel_version: "7.1.3-fixture".into(),
23528            host_capabilities: fixture_host_capabilities(),
23529            attempt: 1,
23530            run_index: None,
23531            epoch: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z".into(),
23532            source_sha: "0".repeat(40),
23533            binary_build_sha: None,
23534            source_dirty: false,
23535            prebuilt: false,
23536            keep_logs: false,
23537            capture_custom_runs: false,
23538            parity_retained: BTreeSet::new(),
23539            parity_compared: BTreeSet::new(),
23540            run_verify_strict: false,
23541            record_verify_strict: false,
23542            timeout_multipliers: TimeoutMultipliers::default(),
23543            scheduled_worker_capacity: ScheduledWorkerCapacity::new(1),
23544            isolated_workdir: None,
23545            shares_ld_so_cache: false,
23546            exact_branch_counter: None,
23547            v2_retry_oci_dir: None,
23548        };
23549
23550        let result = run_cell(&context, &cell).unwrap();
23551        assert_eq!(result.attempts.len(), 3);
23552        let observations = result
23553            .cpu_observations
23554            .as_ref()
23555            .expect("real cell invocations must retain their CPU observations");
23556        assert_eq!(observations.invocations.len(), 3);
23557        result.require_cpu_observations().unwrap();
23558        assert!(result.attempts.iter().all(|attempt| !attempt.timed_out));
23559        assert_eq!(result.result, Some(ObservedResult::Pass));
23560        assert_eq!(result.failure_class, None);
23561        let duration_ms = result
23562            .duration_ms
23563            .expect("a cell that executed must report measured wall time");
23564        assert!(
23565            (2_000u128..(phase_deadline_seconds as u128) * 1_000).contains(&duration_ms),
23566            "three sleeping attempts should pass despite exceeding the old one-second wall cap: {duration_ms}ms"
23567        );
23568        let attempt_cpu_usage_usec = result.attempts.iter().try_fold(0u64, |total, attempt| {
23569            checked_add_cpu_usage(Some(total), attempt.cpu_usage_usec)
23570        });
23571        assert_eq!(
23572            result.cpu_usage_usec, attempt_cpu_usage_usec,
23573            "the cell CPU figure must sum every process-owned attempt measurement"
23574        );
23575        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
23576    }

23782        // A validate retry starts a fresh harness process and prepares the same
23783        // path again. This call is the negative-control boundary: replacing it
23784        // with the former fs::write(path, b"") drops the first observation.
23785        prepare_result_path(&path).unwrap();
23786        context.attempt = 2;
23787        let mut second = infrastructure_error_result(&context, &cell, "forced retry".into());
23788        second.outcome = "PASS".into();
23789        second.result = Some(ObservedResult::Pass);
23790        second.failure_class = None;
23791        second.error_kind = None;
23792        second.duration_ms = Some(222);
23793        append_result(&path, &second).unwrap();
23794
23795        let rows = fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap();
23796        let rows = rows
23797            .lines()
23798            .map(|line| serde_json::from_str::<JsonValue>(line).unwrap())
23799            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
23800        assert_eq!(rows.len(), 2);
23801        assert_eq!(rows[0]["attempt"], 1);
23802        assert_eq!(rows[0]["duration_ms"], 111);
23803        assert_eq!(rows[0]["timeout_seconds"], 80);
23804        assert_eq!(rows[0]["outcome"], "FAIL");
23805        assert_eq!(rows[0]["result"], "determinism-failure");
23806        assert_eq!(rows[0]["failure_class"], "product_failure");
23807        assert_eq!(rows[0]["first_divergent_record"], 93);
23808        assert_eq!(rows[0]["first_divergent_syscall"], 37);
23809        assert_eq!(rows[0]["first_divergent_scheduler_turn"], 68);
23810        assert_eq!(rows[0]["first_divergent_virtual_nanoseconds"], 7);
23811        assert_eq!(
23812            rows[0]["first_divergent_left_message"],
23813            "INFO detcore: left event"
23814        );
23815        assert_eq!(
23816            rows[0]["first_divergent_right_message"],
23817            "INFO detcore: right event"
23818        );
23819        assert_eq!(rows[1]["attempt"], 2);
23820        assert_eq!(rows[1]["duration_ms"], 222);
23821        assert_eq!(rows[1]["timeout_seconds"], 80);
23822        assert_eq!(rows[1]["outcome"], "PASS");
23823        assert_eq!(rows[1]["result"], "pass");
23824        assert_eq!(rows[1]["failure_class"], JsonValue::Null);
23825        assert!(rows[1]["first_divergent_left_message"].is_null());
23826        assert!(rows[1]["first_divergent_right_message"].is_null());
23827        assert_ne!(rows[0]["artifact_dir"], rows[1]["artifact_dir"]);
23828        assert!(
23829            rows[1]["artifact_dir"]
23830                .as_str()
23831                .unwrap()
23832                .ends_with("-attempt-2")
23833        );
23834        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
23835    }

23837    #[test]
23838    fn retry_preserves_changed_product_result_and_attribution() {
23839        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
23840            "hermit-runner-retry-result-class-{}",
23841            std::process::id()
23842        ));
23843        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
23844        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
23845        let path = root.join("results.jsonl");
23846        prepare_result_path(&path).unwrap();
23847
23848        let mut first = cell_result_that_located_nothing();
23849        first.attempt = 1;
23850        first.outcome = "FAIL".into();
23851        first.result = Some(ObservedResult::DeterminismFailure);
23852        first.failure_class = Some(FailureClass::ProductFailure);
23853        first.error_kind = None;
23854        first.artifact_dir = "/repo/artifacts-attempt-1".into();
23855        append_result(&path, &first).unwrap();
23856
23857        let mut second = first.clone();
23858        second.attempt = 2;
23859        second.result = Some(ObservedResult::CrashError);
23860        second.artifact_dir = "/repo/artifacts-attempt-2".into();
23861        append_result(&path, &second).unwrap();
23862
23863        let rows = fs::read_to_string(&path)
23864            .unwrap()
23865            .lines()
23866            .map(|line| serde_json::from_str::<CellResult>(line).unwrap())
23867            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
23868        assert_eq!(rows.len(), 2);
23869        assert_eq!(rows[0].result, Some(ObservedResult::DeterminismFailure));
23870        assert_eq!(rows[1].result, Some(ObservedResult::CrashError));
23871        assert_eq!(rows[0].failure_class, Some(FailureClass::ProductFailure));
23872        assert_eq!(rows[1].failure_class, Some(FailureClass::ProductFailure));
23873        assert_eq!(rows[0].error_kind, None);
23874        assert_eq!(rows[1].error_kind, None);
23875        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
23876    }

23883        mode.backends_disabled.remove("liteinst");

23891                result: CiDisabledResult::DeterminismFailure,

23895        )])));

23898            documents: Vec::new(),

23903        };
23904        let required = set

23920            enabled
23921                .iter()

23997    /// `--backend` is a global Hermit option: `hermit run --backend X` is refused
23998    /// with a usage error. Every hermit invocation the runner builds must
23999    /// therefore carry the backend before the `run` subcommand, and never after.
24000    #[test]
24001    fn hermit_backend_is_passed_before_the_run_subcommand() {
24002        for (mode, seed) in [("verify", None), ("chaos", Some(7)), ("custom", None)] {
24003            let mut test = recipe(true);
24004            let recipe_mode = test.modes["verify"].clone();
24005            test.modes = BTreeMap::from([(mode.to_string(), recipe_mode)]);
24006            let cell = SelectedCell {
24007                image: None,
24008                category: "fixture".into(),
24009                id: CellId {
24010                    test: test.id.clone(),
24011                    mode: mode.into(),
24012                    backend: Some("ptrace".into()),
24013                },
24014                test,
24015                enabled: true,
24016                timeout_seconds: 15,
24017                cpu_timeout_seconds: 10,
24018                host_level: HostLevel::default(),
24019            };
24020            let context = RunContext {
24021                command_bindings: BTreeMap::new(),
24022                root: PathBuf::from("/repo"),
24023                hermit_bin: PathBuf::from("/repo/hermit"),
24024                result_root: PathBuf::from("/repo/results"),
24025                build_root: PathBuf::from("/repo/build"),
24026                run_id: "fixture".into(),
24027                machine_shortname: "fixture-host".into(),
24028                kernel_version: "7.1.3-fixture".into(),
24029                host_capabilities: fixture_host_capabilities(),
24030                attempt: 1,
24031                run_index: None,
24032                epoch: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z".into(),
24033                source_sha: "0".repeat(40),
24034                binary_build_sha: None,
24035                source_dirty: false,
24036                prebuilt: false,
24037                keep_logs: false,
24038                capture_custom_runs: false,
24039                parity_retained: BTreeSet::new(),
24040                parity_compared: BTreeSet::new(),
24041                run_verify_strict: true,
24042                record_verify_strict: true,
24043                timeout_multipliers: TimeoutMultipliers::default(),
24044                scheduled_worker_capacity: ScheduledWorkerCapacity::new(1),
24045                isolated_workdir: None,
24046                shares_ld_so_cache: false,
24047                exact_branch_counter: None,
24048                v2_retry_oci_dir: None,
24049            };
24050            let spec = build_spec(
24051                &context,
24052                &cell,
24053                PathBuf::from("/repo/results/cell"),
24054                vec!["/bin/true".into()],
24055                "1",
24056                seed,
24057                cell.timeout_seconds,
24058            )
24059            .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{mode}: {error}"));
24060            let run = spec
24061                .argv
24062                .iter()
24063                .position(|arg| arg == "run")
24064                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{mode}: no run subcommand in {:?}", spec.argv));
24065            let backend = spec
24066                .argv
24067                .iter()
24068                .position(|arg| arg == "--backend")
24069                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{mode}: no --backend in {:?}", spec.argv));
24070            assert!(
24071                backend < run,
24072                "{mode}: --backend after run: {:?}",
24073                spec.argv
24074            );
24075            assert_eq!(spec.argv[backend + 1], "ptrace", "{mode}: {:?}", spec.argv);
24076            assert!(
24077                !spec.argv[run..]
24078                    .iter()
24079                    .any(|arg| arg == "--backend" || arg.starts_with("--backend=")),
24080                "{mode}: a subcommand-level --backend in {:?}",
24081                spec.argv
24082            );
24083        }
24084    }

24341    #[test]
24342    fn hermetic_guest_arguments_resolve_repo_inputs_but_keep_dot_local() {
24343        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
24344            "hermit-runner-repo-args-bracket-{}",
24345            std::process::id()
24346        ));
24347        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
24348        fs::create_dir_all(root.join("tests/e2e")).unwrap();
24349        fs::write(root.join("README.md"), b"fixture").unwrap();
24350        let mut argv = vec![
24351            "tool".into(),
24352            "tests/e2e".into(),
24353            "README.md".into(),
24354            ".".into(),
24355            "missing/path".into(),
24356            "./README.md".into(),
24357            "./tests/./e2e".into(),
24358        ];
24359        resolve_repo_guest_args(&root, &mut argv);
24360        assert_eq!(argv[0], "tool");
24361        assert_eq!(argv[1], root.join("tests/e2e").to_string_lossy());
24362        assert_eq!(argv[2], root.join("README.md").to_string_lossy());
24363        assert_eq!(argv[3], ".");
24364        assert_eq!(argv[4], "missing/path");
24365        // The manifests spell six repo paths `./examples/...`; the resolved
24366        // path must carry no `.` component after the root.
24367        assert_eq!(argv[5], root.join("README.md").to_string_lossy());
24368        assert_eq!(argv[6], root.join("tests/e2e").to_string_lossy());
24369        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
24370    }

24374    #[test]
24375    fn dbt_repo_arguments_resolve_before_the_guest_changes_directory() {
24376        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
24377            "hermit-runner-dbt-literal-args-{}",
24378            std::process::id()
24379        ));
24380        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
24381        fs::write(root.as_path().join("literal.txt"), b"fixture").unwrap();
24382        let mut cell = ptrace_cell("verify");
24383        cell.id.backend = Some("dbt".into());
24384        cell.test.program = None;
24385        let original = vec![
24386            "/bin/echo".to_owned(),
24387            "literal.txt".to_owned(),
24388            "./literal.txt".to_owned(),
24389            ".".to_owned(),
24390            "missing/path".to_owned(),
24391        ];
24392        cell.test.direct = Some(DirectCommand::Argv(original.clone()));
24393        let mut context = run_context(root.as_path());
24394        let dir = root.as_path().join("results/cell");
24395        let resolved = vec![
24396            original[0].clone(),
24397            root.as_path()
24398                .join("literal.txt")
24399                .to_string_lossy()
24400                .into_owned(),
24401            // `./literal.txt` resolves without its `.` component.
24402            root.as_path()
24403                .join("literal.txt")
24404                .to_string_lossy()
24405                .into_owned(),
24406            original[3].clone(),
24407            original[4].clone(),
24408        ];
24409        assert_eq!(prepare_test(&context, &cell, &dir).unwrap(), resolved);
24410
24411        context.isolated_workdir = Some(PathBuf::from("/test"));
24412        assert_eq!(prepare_test(&context, &cell, &dir).unwrap(), resolved);
24413        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
24414    }

24416    /// The compat corpus hands its guests fixtures below the run state and
24417    /// files below the checkout. A verify guest names both at fixed guest
24418    /// paths, so the reference and each candidate cell, which have their own
24419    /// run state and bundle checkout under Buck, pass the same arguments
24420    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4337). The harness's own
24421    /// per-cell trees are not rebased onto the checkout.
24422    #[test]
24423    fn verify_guests_name_fixtures_and_checkout_files_at_fixed_guest_paths() {
24424        let mut context = run_context(Path::new("/repo"));
24425        context.result_root = PathBuf::from("/repo/target/results");
24426        context.build_root = PathBuf::from("/repo/target/build");
24427        let cell_dir = Path::new("/repo/target/results/cell");
24428        let argv_for = |run_state: &str| {
24429            let roots = equalized_roots(&context, Some(OsStr::new(run_state)));
24430            let fixtures = format!("{run_state}/strict-compat/real-compat-fixtures");
24431            equalized_guest_argv(
24432                cell_dir,
24433                &roots,
24434                vec![
24435                    "env".into(),
24436                    format!("REAL_COMPAT_FIXTURES={fixtures}"),
24437                    "bash".into(),
24438                    "/repo/tests/compat/real_compat_workload.sh".into(),
24439                    format!("{fixtures}/README.md"),
24440                    "/repo/target/results/cell/tmp/out".into(),
24441                    format!("{run_state}/strict-compat/shell-build"),
24442                    "--tab-file=/repo/ci/compat/findmnt.fixture".into(),
24443                ],
24444            )
24445        };
24446        let (reference, reference_roots) = argv_for("/repo/target/validation/run-a/state");
24447        let (candidate, candidate_roots) = argv_for("/repo/target/validation/run-b/state");
24448        assert_eq!(
24449            reference[..5],
24450            [
24451                "env".to_string(),
24452                format!("REAL_COMPAT_FIXTURES={COMPAT_FIXTURES_GUEST_PATH}"),
24453                "bash".into(),
24454                format!("{REPOSITORY_GUEST_PATH}/tests/compat/real_compat_workload.sh"),
24455                format!("{COMPAT_FIXTURES_GUEST_PATH}/README.md"),
24456            ]
24457        );
24458        assert_eq!(reference[..5], candidate[..5]);
24459        // Per-run harness paths stay host paths, and so does a path embedded
24460        // in an option.
24461        assert_eq!(reference[5], "/repo/target/results/cell/tmp/out");
24462        assert_eq!(
24463            reference[6],
24464            "/repo/target/validation/run-a/state/strict-compat/shell-build"
24465        );
24466        assert_eq!(reference[7], "--tab-file=/repo/ci/compat/findmnt.fixture");
24467        // Each named root is bound from that cell's own directory.
24468        let binds = |roots: &[EqualizedRoot]| {
24469            let mut argv = Vec::new();
24470            append_equalized_input_binds(&mut argv, cell_dir, roots);
24471            argv.split_off(EQUALIZED_INPUTS.len())
24472        };
24473        assert_eq!(
24474            binds(&reference_roots),
24475            [
24476                format!(
24477                    "--bind=/repo/target/validation/run-a/state/strict-compat/real-compat-fixtures:{COMPAT_FIXTURES_GUEST_PATH}"
24478                ),
24479                format!("--bind=/repo:{REPOSITORY_GUEST_PATH}"),
24480            ]
24481        );
24482        assert_eq!(
24483            binds(&candidate_roots)[0],
24484            format!(
24485                "--bind=/repo/target/validation/run-b/state/strict-compat/real-compat-fixtures:{COMPAT_FIXTURES_GUEST_PATH}"
24486            )
24487        );
24488        // An argv that names neither root binds neither.
24489        let (_, none) = equalized_guest_argv(
24490            cell_dir,
24491            &equalized_roots(&context, None),
24492            vec!["/usr/bin/true".into()],
24493        );
24494        assert!(none.is_empty());
24495    }

24497    #[test]
24498    fn ordinary_fixed_workdir_resolves_repo_inputs_before_chdir() {
24499        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
24500            "hermit-runner-ordinary-repo-args-bracket-{}",
24501            std::process::id()
24502        ));
24503        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
24504        fs::create_dir_all(root.join("fixtures")).unwrap();
24505        fs::write(root.join("fixtures/input.txt"), b"fixture").unwrap();
24506
24507        let mut cell = ptrace_cell("verify");
24508        cell.test.direct = Some(DirectCommand::Argv(vec![
24509            "/bin/true".into(),
24510            "fixtures/input.txt".into(),
24511            ".".into(),
24512        ]));
24513        let context = run_context(&root);
24514        let cell_dir = root.join("results/cell");
24515        let guest = prepare_test(&context, &cell, &cell_dir).unwrap();
24516        assert_eq!(guest[1], root.join("fixtures/input.txt").to_string_lossy());
24517        assert_eq!(guest[2], ".");
24518
24519        let spec = build_spec(
24520            &context,
24521            &cell,
24522            cell_dir.clone(),
24523            guest,
24524            "1",
24525            None,
24526            cell.timeout_seconds,
24527        )
24528        .unwrap();
24529        assert_eq!(
24530            bound_workdir_source(&spec),
24531            cell_dir.join("workdir/1"),
24532            "the ordinary supported path must retain hermit-132's per-attempt bind"
24533        );
24534        // Absolute before the guest changes to /tmp/test, and named at the
24535        // repository's guest path, bound from the checkout, so every backend's
24536        // run of the test names it alike
24537        // (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4337).
24538        assert_eq!(
24539            spec.guest_argv[1],
24540            format!("{REPOSITORY_GUEST_PATH}/fixtures/input.txt"),
24541            "repo input must be absolute before the guest changes to /tmp/test"
24542        );
24543        assert!(
24544            spec.argv.contains(&format!(
24545                "--bind={}:{REPOSITORY_GUEST_PATH}",
24546                root.display()
24547            )),
24548            "{:?}",
24549            spec.argv
24550        );
24551        assert_eq!(spec.guest_argv[2], ".");
24552        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
24553    }

24555    #[test]
24556    fn verify_relaxations_are_explicit_and_recorded() {
24557        let mut test = recipe(true);
24558        let mode = test.modes.get_mut("verify").unwrap();
24559        mode.rcb_time = Some(false);
24560        mode.rcb_time_disabled_reason =
24561            Some("data-dependent assertion work must not perturb virtual time".into());
24562        validate_mode("fixture/test", "verify", mode, 15).unwrap();
24563        // Without the I/O-buffer comparison Hermit never reports bitwise
24564        // parity, so validation refuses the relaxation whatever the reason.
24565        let io_reason =
24566            "guest assertions validate sanitizer-specific invariants while whole files may vary";
24567        for reason in [None, Some(io_reason)] {
24568            let mut io_off = mode.clone();
24569            io_off.compare_io_buffers = Some(false);
24570            io_off.compare_io_buffers_disabled_reason = reason.map(String::from);
24571            let error = validate_mode("fixture/test", "verify", &io_off, 15).unwrap_err();
24572            assert!(
24573                error.contains("compare_io_buffers=false is refused, with or without a reason"),
24574                "{reason:?}: {error}"
24575            );
24576        }
24577        // A recipe built without validation, as for a row recorded before the
24578        // refusal, still renders and records the relaxation.
24579        mode.compare_io_buffers = Some(false);
24580        mode.compare_io_buffers_disabled_reason = Some(io_reason.into());
24581        let cell = SelectedCell {
24582            image: None,
24583            category: "fixture".into(),
24584            id: CellId {
24585                test: test.id.clone(),
24586                mode: "verify".into(),
24587                backend: Some("ptrace".into()),
24588            },
24589            test,
24590            enabled: true,
24591            timeout_seconds: 15,
24592            cpu_timeout_seconds: 10,
24593            host_level: HostLevel::default(),
24594        };
24595        let context = RunContext {
24596            command_bindings: BTreeMap::new(),
24597            root: PathBuf::from("/repo"),
24598            hermit_bin: PathBuf::from("/repo/hermit"),
24599            result_root: PathBuf::from("/repo/results"),
24600            build_root: PathBuf::from("/repo/build"),
24601            run_id: "fixture".into(),
24602            machine_shortname: "fixture-host".into(),
24603            kernel_version: "7.1.3-fixture".into(),
24604            host_capabilities: fixture_host_capabilities(),
24605            attempt: 1,
24606            run_index: None,
24607            epoch: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z".into(),
24608            source_sha: "0".repeat(40),
24609            binary_build_sha: None,
24610            source_dirty: false,
24611            prebuilt: false,
24612            keep_logs: false,
24613            capture_custom_runs: false,
24614            parity_retained: BTreeSet::new(),
24615            parity_compared: BTreeSet::new(),
24616            run_verify_strict: true,
24617            record_verify_strict: true,
24618            timeout_multipliers: TimeoutMultipliers::default(),
24619            scheduled_worker_capacity: ScheduledWorkerCapacity::new(1),
24620            isolated_workdir: None,
24621            shares_ld_so_cache: false,
24622            exact_branch_counter: None,
24623            v2_retry_oci_dir: None,
24624        };
24625        let spec = build_spec(
24626            &context,
24627            &cell,
24628            PathBuf::from("/repo/results/cell"),
24629            vec!["/bin/true".into()],
24630            "1",
24631            None,
24632            cell.timeout_seconds,
24633        )
24634        .unwrap();
24635        let separator = spec.argv.iter().position(|arg| arg == "--").unwrap();
24636        let relaxation = spec
24637            .argv
24638            .iter()
24639            .position(|arg| arg == "--no-detlog-io-buffers")
24640            .unwrap();
24641        assert!(relaxation < separator);
24642        let no_rcb_time = spec
24643            .argv
24644            .iter()
24645            .position(|arg| arg == "--no-rcb-time")
24646            .unwrap();
24647        assert!(no_rcb_time < separator);
24648        assert_eq!(
24649            cell_relaxations(&cell),
24650            vec![
24651                String::from(
24652                    "--no-detlog-io-buffers: guest assertions validate sanitizer-specific invariants while whole files may vary",
24653                ),
24654                String::from(
24655                    "--no-rcb-time: data-dependent assertion work must not perturb virtual time",
24656                ),
24657            ]
24658        );
24659
24660        assert!(
24661            !spec
24662                .argv
24663                .iter()
24664                .any(|arg| arg.starts_with("--verify-allow"))
24665        );
24666        assert_eq!(spec.expected_guest_exit, None);
24667        let mut expecting = cell.clone();
24668        expecting
24669            .test
24670            .modes
24671            .get_mut("verify")
24672            .unwrap()
24673            .expected_guest_exit = Some(ExpectedGuestExit {
24674            code: Some(7),
24675            signal: None,
24676            reason: "the fixture guest fails on purpose".into(),
24677        });
24678        let expecting_spec = build_spec(
24679            &context,
24680            &expecting,
24681            PathBuf::from("/repo/results/cell"),
24682            vec!["/bin/true".into()],
24683            "1",
24684            None,
24685            expecting.timeout_seconds,
24686        )
24687        .unwrap();
24688        let separator = expecting_spec
24689            .argv
24690            .iter()
24691            .position(|arg| arg == "--")
24692            .unwrap();
24693        let allow = expecting_spec
24694            .argv
24695            .iter()
24696            .position(|arg| arg == "--verify-allow=failure")
24697            .unwrap();
24698        assert!(allow < separator);
24699        assert_eq!(
24700            expecting_spec
24701                .expected_guest_exit
24702                .as_ref()
24703                .and_then(|e| e.code),
24704            Some(7)
24705        );
24706
24707        let mut missing_rcb_reason = recipe(true).modes.remove("verify").unwrap();
24708        missing_rcb_reason.rcb_time = Some(false);
24709        assert!(
24710            validate_mode("fixture/test", "verify", &missing_rcb_reason, 15)
24711                .unwrap_err()
24712                .contains("requires rcb_time_disabled_reason")
24713        );
24714    }
