31524    /// A skid attempt's compared runs still answer to the cell's declared
31525    /// stdout assertions (<https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/1845>).
31526    /// Runs that agree on the wrong bytes, or omit the declared marker, and a
31527    /// capture that cannot decide the marker, each keep the skid
31528    /// infrastructure ERROR classification, the one shape every reader of a
31529    /// result row accepts beside an `infrastructure_error` report, with a
31530    /// reason that names both the overshoot and the assertion. None of them
31531    /// is a skid-only row, so none earns the skid retry or counts as a
31532    /// skid-recovered pass, even relabelled with the plain skid reason; the
31533    /// same attempt with its assertions met stays one.
31534    ///
31535    /// The predicate re-decides the row's recorded declaration from each
31536    /// attempt's own evidence, so a row an older producer classified without
31537    /// the assertions (an attempt labelled `infrastructure` whatever its
31538    /// stdout) qualifies only when its record shows no assertion it breaks,
31539    /// and never without the record.
31540    #[test]
31541    fn a_skid_attempt_that_breaks_a_declared_stdout_assertion_is_not_skid_only() {
31542        let skid_with = |first: &str, second: &str| {
31543            let mut report = skid_report_value(2);
31544            let outputs = report.compared_outputs.as_mut().unwrap();
31545            outputs.left.stdout_sha256 = hex_digest(first.as_bytes());
31546            outputs.left.stdout_bytes = first.len() as u64;
31547            outputs.right.stdout_sha256 = hex_digest(second.as_bytes());
31548            outputs.right.stdout_bytes = second.len() as u64;
31549            report
31550        };
31551        let ending = format!("{SKID_STDERR}; exit 122");
31552        let golden = "syscall-file-io-ok count=5\n";
31553        let unmarked = "syscall-file-io count=5\n";
31554        let marker = "-ok ";
31555        let skid_with_stderr = |stderr: &str| {
31556            let mut report = skid_with(golden, golden);
31557            let outputs = report.compared_outputs.as_mut().unwrap();
31558            for output in [&mut outputs.left, &mut outputs.right] {
31559                output.stderr_sha256 = hex_digest(stderr.as_bytes());
31560                output.stderr_bytes = stderr.len() as u64;
31561            }
31562            report
31563        };
31564        let skid = skid_overshoot_reason(2);
31565        // The row `run_cell_inner` publishes for a cell declaring `exact`
31566        // and/or `contains`.
31567        let declaring = |mut row: CellResult, exact: Option<&str>, contains: Option<&str>| {
31568            row.declared_stdout = Some(DeclaredStdout {
31569                exact: exact.map(str::to_string),
31570                contains: contains.map(str::to_string),
31571                stderr_exact: None,
31572            });
31573            row
31574        };
31575
31576        // A violating attempt is published in exactly the shape of a plain
31577        // skid attempt: only its reason differs. With the plain skid reason
31578        // restored, the row's recorded declaration alone still refuses it.
31579        let refused_whatever_its_reason = |label: &str, row: CellResult| {
31580            assert_eq!(
31581                (
31582                    row.outcome.as_str(),
31583                    row.result,
31584                    row.failure_class,
31585                    row.error_kind.as_deref()
31586                ),
31587                (
31588                    "ERROR",
31589                    None,
31590                    Some(FailureClass::UnderstoodInfrastructureFailure),
31591                    Some("infrastructure")
31592                ),
31593                "{label}: {row:?}"
31594            );
31595            let attempt = &row.attempts[0];
31596            let report = current_verification_report(
31597                attempt.verification_report.as_deref().unwrap().as_bytes(),
31598            )
31599            .unwrap();
31600            assert_eq!(
31601                (report.verdict, report.infrastructure_error),
31602                (
31603                    Verdict::InfrastructureError,
31604                    Some(InfrastructureError::SkidOvershoot { count: 2 })
31605                ),
31606                "{label}: {row:?}"
31607            );
31608            assert_eq!(
31609                skid_overshoot_only_reports(&row),
31610                None,
31611                "{label} must not be a skid-only row"
31612            );
31613            let mut relabelled = row;
31614            relabelled.reason = Some(skid.clone());
31615            relabelled.attempts[0].reason = Some(skid.clone());
31616            assert_eq!(
31617                skid_overshoot_only_reports(&relabelled),
31618                None,
31619                "{label} must not be a skid-only row with the plain skid reason"
31620            );
31621        };
31622
31623        // Controls: the same skid attempts with every declared assertion met.
31624        for (label, exact, contains) in [
31625            ("exact stdout met", Some(golden), None),
31626            ("marker met", None, Some(marker)),
31627            ("both met", Some(golden), Some(marker)),
31628        ] {
31629            let met = attempt_with_stdout_assertions(
31630                exact,
31631                contains,
31632                skid_with(golden, golden),
31633                golden,
31634                &ending,
31635            );
31636            assert_eq!(
31637                (met.outcome.as_str(), met.error_kind.as_deref()),
31638                ("ERROR", Some("infrastructure")),
31639                "{label}: {met:?}"
31640            );
31641            let row = declaring(verify_row_from_attempts(vec![met]), exact, contains);
31642            assert_eq!(
31643                (row.outcome.as_str(), row.result, row.failure_class),
31644                (
31645                    "ERROR",
31646                    None,
31647                    Some(FailureClass::UnderstoodInfrastructureFailure)
31648                ),
31649                "{label}: {row:?}"
31650            );
31651            assert_eq!(
31652                skid_overshoot_only_reports(&row),
31653                Some(2),
31654                "{label} must stay a skid-only row"
31655            );
31656        }
31657
31658        let empty_sha = hex_digest(b"");
31659        let golden_sha = hex_digest(golden.as_bytes());
31660        let unmarked_sha = hex_digest(unmarked.as_bytes());
31661        for (label, exact, contains, report, captured, reason) in [
31662            (
31663                "agreeing on the wrong bytes",
31664                Some(golden),
31665                None,
31666                skid_with("", ""),
31667                "",
31668                expected_stdout_mismatch_reason(
31669                    "first",
31670                    0,
31671                    &empty_sha,
31672                    golden.len() as u64,
31673                    &golden_sha,
31674                ),
31675            ),
31676            (
31677                "the second run printing the wrong bytes",
31678                Some(golden),
31679                None,
31680                skid_with(golden, unmarked),
31681                golden,
31682                expected_stdout_mismatch_reason(
31683                    "second",
31684                    unmarked.len() as u64,
31685                    &unmarked_sha,
31686                    golden.len() as u64,
31687                    &golden_sha,
31688                ),
31689            ),
31690            (
31691                "omitting the declared marker",
31692                None,
31693                Some(marker),
31694                skid_with(unmarked, unmarked),
31695                unmarked,
31696                expected_stdout_contains_mismatch_reason(
31697                    unmarked.len() as u64,
31698                    &unmarked_sha,
31699                    marker,
31700                ),
31701            ),
31702        ] {
31703            let failed = attempt_with_stdout_assertions(exact, contains, report, captured, &ending);
31704            let expected = format!(
31705                "{skid}, and its compared runs violate a declared stdout assertion: {reason}"
31706            );
31707            assert_eq!(
31708                (
31709                    failed.outcome.as_str(),
31710                    failed.error_kind.as_deref(),
31711                    failed.reason.as_deref(),
31712                ),
31713                ("ERROR", Some("infrastructure"), Some(expected.as_str())),
31714                "{label} beside an overshoot names both: {failed:?}"
31715            );
31716            let row = declaring(verify_row_from_attempts(vec![failed]), exact, contains);
31717            refused_whatever_its_reason(label, row);
31718        }
31719
31720        // A capture that is not the compared bytes cannot decide the marker.
31721        let foreign = attempt_with_stdout_assertions(
31722            None,
31723            Some(marker),
31724            skid_with(unmarked, unmarked),
31725            golden,
31726            &ending,
31727        );
31728        assert_eq!(
31729            (foreign.outcome.as_str(), foreign.error_kind.as_deref()),
31730            ("ERROR", Some("infrastructure")),
31731            "{foreign:?}"
31732        );
31733        let prefix = format!(
31734            "{skid}, and a declared stdout assertion cannot be checked: captured verify stdout ("
31735        );
31736        assert!(
31737            foreign
31738                .reason
31739                .as_deref()
31740                .is_some_and(|reason| reason.starts_with(&prefix)),
31741            "{foreign:?}"
31742        );
31743        let row = declaring(verify_row_from_attempts(vec![foreign]), None, Some(marker));
31744        refused_whatever_its_reason("a capture unlike the compared runs", row);
31745
31746        // Rows an older producer wrote: each attempt was classified without
31747        // the cell's assertions, so it carries the plain skid label whatever
31748        // its compared runs printed. Only the row's recorded declaration,
31749        // re-decided against the attempt's own evidence, can admit it.
31750        let imported = |first: &str, second: &str, captured: &str| {
31751            let attempt = attempt_with_stdout_assertions(
31752                None,
31753                None,
31754                skid_with(first, second),
31755                captured,
31756                &ending,
31757            );
31758            assert_eq!(
31759                (attempt.outcome.as_str(), attempt.error_kind.as_deref()),
31760                ("ERROR", Some("infrastructure")),
31761                "{attempt:?}"
31762            );
31763            verify_row_from_attempts(vec![attempt])
31764        };
31765        // The same imported row answers to the declared stderr too: the
31766        // compared runs print the declared diagnostic, while another
31767        // declared diagnostic refuses the row.
31768        let diag = "syscall-file-io-diag\n";
31769        let imported_with_stderr = |stderr: &str| {
31770            let attempt = attempt_with_stdout_assertions(
31771                None,
31772                None,
31773                skid_with_stderr(stderr),
31774                golden,
31775                &ending,
31776            );
31777            assert_eq!(
31778                (attempt.outcome.as_str(), attempt.error_kind.as_deref()),
31779                ("ERROR", Some("infrastructure")),
31780                "{attempt:?}"
31781            );
31782            verify_row_from_attempts(vec![attempt])
31783        };
31784        let mut stderr_met = declaring(imported_with_stderr(diag), Some(golden), None);
31785        stderr_met.declared_stdout.as_mut().unwrap().stderr_exact = Some(diag.to_string());
31786        assert_eq!(
31787            skid_overshoot_only_reports(&stderr_met),
31788            Some(2),
31789            "a recorded row whose evidence meets its declared stderr keeps its skid-only reading"
31790        );
31791        let mut stderr_wrong = declaring(imported_with_stderr(diag), Some(golden), None);
31792        stderr_wrong.declared_stdout.as_mut().unwrap().stderr_exact =
31793            Some("syscall-file-io-other-diag\n".to_string());
31794        refused_whatever_its_reason("a compared pair off the declared stderr", stderr_wrong);
31795        let mut unrecorded = imported("", "", "");
31796        unrecorded.declared_stdout = None;
31797        assert_eq!(
31798            skid_overshoot_only_reports(&unrecorded),
31799            None,
31800            "a row without the record never qualifies"
31801        );
31802        for (label, row) in [
31803            (
31804                "an empty pair under a declared golden",
31805                declaring(imported("", "", ""), Some(golden), None),
31806            ),
31807            (
31808                "a second run off the declared golden",
31809                declaring(imported(golden, unmarked, golden), Some(golden), None),
31810            ),
31811            (
31812                "an empty pair under a declared marker",
31813                declaring(imported("", "", ""), None, Some(marker)),
31814            ),
31815            (
31816                "an unmarked pair under a declared marker",
31817                declaring(imported(unmarked, unmarked, unmarked), None, Some(marker)),
31818            ),
31819            (
31820                "a capture unlike the compared runs under a declared marker",
31821                declaring(imported(unmarked, unmarked, golden), None, Some(marker)),
31822            ),
31823        ] {
31824            assert_eq!(
31825                skid_overshoot_only_reports(&row),
31826                None,
31827                "{label} must not be a skid-only row: {row:?}"
31828            );
31829        }
31830        assert_eq!(
31831            skid_overshoot_only_reports(&declaring(imported("", "", ""), None, None)),
31832            Some(2),
31833            "a recorded row declaring nothing keeps its skid-only reading"
31834        );
31835        assert_eq!(
31836            skid_overshoot_only_reports(&declaring(
31837                imported(golden, golden, golden),
31838                Some(golden),
31839                Some(marker)
31840            )),
31841            Some(2),
31842            "a recorded row whose evidence meets its declaration keeps it"
31843        );
31844    }

31906    /// A golden carrying the vDSO getrandom leg cannot be produced on a
31907    /// pre-6.11 kernel, so the manifest must declare that floor; the same
31908    /// golden with the token declared, and an unrelated golden without it,
31909    /// both load.
31910    #[test]
31911    fn a_vdso_getrandom_golden_must_declare_its_kernel_floor() {
31912        let golden = "getrandom[0]=aa\nvdso-getrandom[0]=bb\n".to_string();
31913        for key in ["expected_stdout", "expected_stdout_contains"] {
31914            let mut cell = ptrace_cell("verify");
31915            let recipe = cell.test.modes.get_mut("verify").unwrap();
31916            let table = BTreeMap::from([("ptrace".to_string(), golden.clone())]);
31917            if key == "expected_stdout" {
31918                recipe.expected_stdout = table;
31919            } else {
31920                recipe.expected_stdout_contains = table;
31921            }
31922            let undeclared = vec!["linux".to_string(), "cc".to_string()];
31923            assert_eq!(
31924                validate_golden_kernel_floor("b/t", &undeclared, &cell.test.modes),
31925                Err(format!(
31926                    "b/t: verify {key}.ptrace prints the vDSO getrandom leg, which only a \
31927                     Linux 6.11+ host exports; declare `vdso-getrandom` in requires"
31928                ))
31929            );
31930            let declared = vec!["linux".to_string(), "vdso-getrandom".to_string()];
31931            assert_eq!(
31932                validate_golden_kernel_floor("b/t", &declared, &cell.test.modes),
31933                Ok(())
31934            );
31935        }
31936        let mut cell = ptrace_cell("verify");
31937        cell.test.modes.get_mut("verify").unwrap().expected_stdout = BTreeMap::from([(
31938            "ptrace".to_string(),
31939            "vdso-getrandom unavailable\n".to_string(),
31940        )]);
31941        assert_eq!(
31942            validate_golden_kernel_floor("b/t", &[], &cell.test.modes),
31943            Ok(())
31944        );
31945        // The token is descriptive: it never withholds a cell.
31946        assert_eq!(requires_capability("vdso-getrandom"), Ok(None));
31947    }

32070    /// The shape of the fp-reduction chaos/ptrace red in the local validation
32071    /// of 84da7b816939 (2026-09-29): seed 30 exited 0 as the cell's cumulative
32072    /// 46 CPU s ran out, so it timed out, the loop stopped and seed 31 never
32073    /// ran. The cell reason said only `chaos distinct=7 passes=31 failures=0`,
32074    /// counting the timed-out seed as a pass and naming no timeout.
32075    #[test]
32076    fn a_chaos_timeout_leads_the_reason_and_is_not_counted_as_a_pass() {
32077        let attempt = |index: &str, status: i32, timed_out: bool| {
32078            let mut attempt = attempt_with_sabre_evidence("{}");
32079            attempt.index = index.into();
32080            attempt.status = Some(status);
32081            attempt.timed_out = timed_out;
32082            if timed_out {
32083                attempt.outcome = "FAIL".into();
32084                attempt.error_kind = Some("cpu-timeout".into());
32085                attempt.reason = Some("cell exceeded 46 CPU s".into());
32086            }
32087            attempt
32088        };
32089        let attempts = [
32090            attempt("seed-28", 0, false),
32091            attempt("seed-29", 1, false),
32092            attempt("seed-30", 0, true),
32093        ];
32094        assert_eq!(chaos_population_counts(&attempts), (1, 1, 1));
32095        // A killed seed (no exit status) is not a failure either.
32096        let mut killed = attempt("seed-30", 0, true);
32097        killed.status = None;
32098        assert_eq!(
32099            chaos_population_counts(&[attempt("seed-28", 1, false), killed]),
32100            (0, 1, 1)
32101        );
32102
32103        let incomplete = chaos_incomplete_reason(&attempts, 32);
32104        assert_eq!(
32105            incomplete.as_deref(),
32106            Some("cpu-timeout: cell exceeded 46 CPU s at seed-30; 3 of 32 seeds ran")
32107        );
32108        assert_eq!(chaos_incomplete_reason(&attempts[..2], 32), None);
32109
32110        let mut outcome = "FAIL".to_string();
32111        let mut reason = incomplete.clone();
32112        apply_failed_chaos_assertion(
32113            &mut outcome,
32114            &mut reason,
32115            incomplete.as_deref(),
32116            "chaos distinct=2 passes=1 failures=1 timed_out=1 normalized_entropy=1.0000".into(),
32117        );
32118        assert_eq!(outcome, "FAIL");
32119        assert_eq!(
32120            reason.as_deref(),
32121            Some(
32122                "cpu-timeout: cell exceeded 46 CPU s at seed-30; 3 of 32 seeds ran; \
32123                 chaos distinct=2 passes=1 failures=1 timed_out=1 normalized_entropy=1.0000"
32124            )
32125        );
32126    }

32128    /// A seed that failed for a product reason before the CPU budget ran out
32129    /// keeps its reason in the cell reason, after the timeout's, whether or
32130    /// not the population floors pass; an attempt-level ERROR keeps its own.
32131    #[test]
32132    fn a_chaos_timeout_keeps_an_earlier_seeds_failure_reason() {
32133        let mut attempts = [
32134            attempt_with_sabre_evidence("{}"),
32135            attempt_with_sabre_evidence("{}"),
32136            attempt_with_sabre_evidence("{}"),
32137        ];
32138        for (attempt, index) in attempts.iter_mut().zip(["seed-4", "seed-5", "seed-30"]) {
32139            attempt.index = index.into();
32140            attempt.status = Some(0);
32141            attempt.reason = None;
32142        }
32143        attempts[1].outcome = "FAIL".into();
32144        attempts[1].reason = Some("expected stdout mismatch".into());
32145        attempts[2].outcome = "FAIL".into();
32146        attempts[2].timed_out = true;
32147        attempts[2].error_kind = Some("cpu-timeout".into());
32148        attempts[2].reason = Some("cell exceeded 46 CPU s".into());
32149        let expected = "cpu-timeout: cell exceeded 46 CPU s at seed-30; 3 of 32 seeds ran; \
32150                        seed-5: expected stdout mismatch";
32151        let incomplete = chaos_incomplete_reason(&attempts, 32);
32152        assert_eq!(incomplete.as_deref(), Some(expected));
32153
32154        // Every floor passes: the cell reason is the timeout, then seed 5's.
32155        let first_reason = attempts.iter().find_map(|attempt| attempt.reason.clone());
32156        assert_eq!(first_reason.as_deref(), Some("expected stdout mismatch"));
32157        assert_eq!(
32158            chaos_cell_reason("FAIL", first_reason.clone(), incomplete.as_deref()).as_deref(),
32159            Some(expected)
32160        );
32161        // An attempt-level ERROR keeps its reason; no timeout keeps the first.
32162        assert_eq!(
32163            chaos_cell_reason("ERROR", first_reason.clone(), incomplete.as_deref()),
32164            first_reason
32165        );
32166        assert_eq!(
32167            chaos_cell_reason("FAIL", first_reason.clone(), None),
32168            first_reason
32169        );
32170
32171        // A floor fails too: the assertion follows both.
32172        let mut outcome = "FAIL".to_string();
32173        let mut reason = chaos_cell_reason("FAIL", first_reason, incomplete.as_deref());
32174        apply_failed_chaos_assertion(
32175            &mut outcome,
32176            &mut reason,
32177            incomplete.as_deref(),
32178            "chaos distinct=1 passes=1 failures=1 timed_out=1 normalized_entropy=0.0000".into(),
32179        );
32180        assert_eq!(
32181            reason.as_deref(),
32182            Some(
32183                "cpu-timeout: cell exceeded 46 CPU s at seed-30; 3 of 32 seeds ran; \
32184                 seed-5: expected stdout mismatch; \
32185                 chaos distinct=1 passes=1 failures=1 timed_out=1 normalized_entropy=0.0000"
32186            )
32187        );
32188    }

32190    fn no_result_with_exit_status(
32191        status: i32,
32192        reason: crate::canonical_verdict::NoResultReason,
32193    ) -> AttemptResult {
32194        static NEXT_DIRECTORY: std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize =
32195            std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0);
32196        let dir = loop {
32197            let sequence = NEXT_DIRECTORY.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
32198            let candidate = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
32199                "hermit-runner-no-result-bracket-{}-{status}-{sequence}",
32200                std::process::id()
32201            ));
32202            match fs::create_dir(&candidate) {
32203                Ok(()) => break candidate,
32204                Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
32205                Err(error) => panic!("creating no-result fixture directory: {error}"),
32206            }
32207        };
32208        let verdict = dir.join("verdict.json");
32209        let mut report = VerificationReport::no_result();
32210        report.no_result_reason = Some(reason);
32211        let report = serde_json::to_string(&report).unwrap();
32212        let spec = CellRunSpec {
32213            command_binding: None,
32214            id: CellId {
32215                test: "fixture/no-result".into(),
32216                mode: "verify".into(),
32217                backend: Some("ptrace".into()),
32218            },
32219            lane: "portable".into(),
32220            category: "fixture".into(),
32221            cwd: dir.clone(),
32222            env: BTreeMap::new(),
32223            argv: vec![
32224                "/bin/sh".into(),
32225                "-c".into(),
32226                r#"printf %s "$1" > "$2"; exit "$3""#.into(),
32227                "sh".into(),
32228                report,
32229                verdict.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
32230                status.to_string(),
32231            ],
32232            guest_argv: vec!["fixture".into()],
32233            timeout_seconds: 5,
32234            verdict_path: Some(verdict),
32235            verification_log_dir: None,
32236            verify_runs: None,
32237            single_run_capture: None,
32238            sabre_path_evidence: None,
32239            cell_dir: dir.clone(),
32240            expected_guest_exit: None,
32241            expected_stdout: None,
32242            expected_stdout_contains: None,
32243            expected_stderr: None,
32244            comparator: Comparator::Strict,
32245            attempt: "1".into(),
32246            fixed_workdir_source: dir.join("workdir/1"),
32247        };
32248        let result = execute_spec(&spec).unwrap();
32249        fs::remove_dir_all(dir).unwrap();
32250        result
32251    }

32253    #[test]
32254    fn container_failure_is_a_product_crash_without_comparison_credit() {
32255        use crate::canonical_verdict::ContainerDisposition;
32256        use crate::canonical_verdict::ContainerFailure;
32257        use crate::canonical_verdict::NoResultReason;
32258        use crate::canonical_verdict::VerificationRun;
32259        for run in [VerificationRun::Run1, VerificationRun::Run2] {
32260            for disposition in [
32261                ContainerDisposition::Exited { code: 0 },
32262                ContainerDisposition::Signaled {
32263                    signal: 14,
32264                    core_dumped: false,
32265                },
32266            ] {
32267                let reason = NoResultReason::ContainerFailed(ContainerFailure { run, disposition });
32268                let failed = no_result_with_exit_status(125, reason.clone());
32269                assert_eq!(failed.outcome, "FAIL");
32270                assert_eq!(failed.error_kind, None);
32271                assert_eq!(failed.status, Some(125));
32272                assert_eq!(
32273                    observed_result(
32274                        "verify",
32275                        &failed.outcome,
32276                        std::slice::from_ref(&failed),
32277                        failed.error_kind.as_deref()
32278                    ),
32279                    Some(ObservedResult::CrashError)
32280                );
32281                assert_eq!(
32282                    failure_class(
32283                        &failed.outcome,
32284                        Some(ObservedResult::CrashError),
32285                        failed.error_kind.as_deref()
32286                    ),
32287                    Some(FailureClass::ProductFailure)
32288                );
32289                let report = VerificationReport::from_current_json_slice(
32290                    failed.verification_report.as_ref().unwrap().as_bytes(),
32291                )
32292                .unwrap();
32293                assert!(report.require_canonical_comparison().is_err());
32294                assert!(report.guest_exit_code.is_none() && report.guest_signal.is_none());
32295                let contradicted = no_result_with_exit_status(0, reason);
32296                assert_eq!(contradicted.outcome, "ERROR");
32297                assert_eq!(
32298                    contradicted.error_kind.as_deref(),
32299                    Some("incomplete-verification-evidence")
32300                );
32301                assert!(
32302                    contradicted
32303                        .reason
32304                        .unwrap()
32305                        .contains("contradicts Hermit process")
32306                );
32307            }
32308        }
32309    }

32311    /// A run Hermit started and a typed failure stopped (`run_failed`) is a
32312    /// product crash with Hermit's reason, for each failure kind and either
32313    /// run; a zero Hermit exit contradicts it. Before the reason existed such
32314    /// a run left the `not_run` stamp and was counted as no result.
32315    #[test]
32316    fn a_typed_run_failure_is_a_product_crash_with_its_reason() {
32317        use crate::canonical_verdict::NoResultReason;
32318        use crate::canonical_verdict::RunFailure;
32319        use crate::canonical_verdict::VerificationRun;
32320        for (status, failure) in [
32321            (125, RunFailure::BackendFailure),
32322            (122, RunFailure::DeterminismLoss),
32323            (122, RunFailure::PolicyRefusal),
32324        ] {
32325            for run in [VerificationRun::Run1, VerificationRun::Run2] {
32326                let reason = NoResultReason::RunFailed {
32327                    run,
32328                    failure,
32329                    detail: "KVM guest execution failed: guest exception vector 14".into(),
32330                };
32331                let failed = no_result_with_exit_status(status, reason.clone());
32332                assert_eq!(failed.outcome, "FAIL");
32333                assert_eq!(failed.error_kind, None);
32334                let text = failed.reason.clone().unwrap();
32335                assert!(text.contains(failure.as_str()), "{text}");
32336                assert!(text.contains("guest exception vector 14"), "{text}");
32337                assert_eq!(
32338                    observed_result(
32339                        "verify",
32340                        &failed.outcome,
32341                        std::slice::from_ref(&failed),
32342                        failed.error_kind.as_deref()
32343                    ),
32344                    Some(ObservedResult::CrashError)
32345                );
32346                assert_eq!(
32347                    failure_class(
32348                        &failed.outcome,
32349                        Some(ObservedResult::CrashError),
32350                        failed.error_kind.as_deref()
32351                    ),
32352                    Some(FailureClass::ProductFailure)
32353                );
32354                let contradicted = no_result_with_exit_status(0, reason);
32355                assert_eq!(contradicted.outcome, "ERROR");
32356                assert_eq!(
32357                    contradicted.error_kind.as_deref(),
32358                    Some("incomplete-verification-evidence")
32359                );
32360            }
32361        }
32362    }

32364    /// A guest that prints a refused open in its own stderr, under a typed
32365    /// first-run rejection, stays a product crash: the environmental-block
32366    /// scan reads that line as a host toolchain denial only when no such
32367    /// report says the guest itself failed
32368    /// (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4029).
32369    #[test]
32370    fn a_guest_permission_denied_under_a_first_run_rejection_is_a_product_crash() {
32371        let guest_line = "lsirq: cannot open /proc/interrupts: Permission denied\n";
32372        let mut rejected = no_result_with_exit_status(
32373            1,
32374            crate::canonical_verdict::NoResultReason::FirstRunRejected {
32375                exit_code: Some(1),
32376                signal: None,
32377                stdout_bytes: 0,
32378                stderr_bytes: guest_line.len() as u64,
32379            },
32380        );
32381        assert_eq!(rejected.outcome, "FAIL");
32382        rejected.stderr = format!(
32383            "First run errored during --verify, not continuing to a second.\n\
32384             Exit status: exited with code 1\nStdout:\nStderr:\n{guest_line}"
32385        );
32386        let result = observed_result(
32387            "verify",
32388            &rejected.outcome,
32389            std::slice::from_ref(&rejected),
32390            rejected.error_kind.as_deref(),
32391        );
32392        assert_eq!(result, Some(ObservedResult::CrashError));
32393        assert_eq!(
32394            failure_class(&rejected.outcome, result, rejected.error_kind.as_deref()),
32395            Some(FailureClass::ProductFailure)
32396        );
32397        // Without the typed rejection, the same line is still scanned as an
32398        // environmental block, as before.
32399        let mut untyped = rejected.clone();
32400        untyped.verification_report = None;
32401        untyped.verification_report_sha256 = None;
32402        assert_eq!(
32403            observed_result(
32404                "verify",
32405                &untyped.outcome,
32406                std::slice::from_ref(&untyped),
32407                untyped.error_kind.as_deref(),
32408            ),
32409            Some(ObservedResult::InfrastructureError)
32410        );
32411    }

32642    #[test]
32643    fn preparation_does_not_consume_the_guest_execution_budget() {
32644        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
32645            "hermit-runner-separate-preparation-budget-{}",
32646            std::process::id()
32647        ));
32648        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
32649        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
32650        // The property under test: preparation and execution each get their
32651        // own wall deadline of timeout_seconds, so preparation time is not
32652        // charged against the execution budget. Each phase sleeps 2.1 s under
32653        // a 4 s deadline (widened against a measured host reference below),
32654        // so the two phases together (at least 4.2 s) exceed one deadline: a
32655        // shared deadline would time out the run, while separate deadlines
32656        // let both phases pass. Each phase keeps about 1.9 s for process
32657        // start-up on an idle host; the earlier 1.1 s sleeps under a 2 s
32658        // deadline left only 0.9 s per phase.
32659        let program = root.join("fixture.sh");
32660        crate::exec_safe_fs::write_executable(
32661            &program,
32662            "#!/bin/sh\ncase \"$1\" in\n  --prepare) sleep 2.1 ;;\n  --run) sleep 2.1; printf 'complete\\n' ;;\n  *) exit 64 ;;\nesac\n",
32663            0o755,
32664        )
32665        .unwrap();
32666
32667        // Widen the per-phase deadline against a measured reference
32668        // (dh-ravrz): time a real `sleep 0.5` spawn on this host; a loaded
32669        // host that takes twice as long gets twice the deadline, so the
32670        // 1.9 s startup margin scales with the host instead of being
32671        // consumed by it. The property is unchanged: each phase sleeps
32672        // 2.1 s, so together they exceed any single phase's deadline.
32673        let reference_started = std::time::Instant::now();
32674        let reference = std::process::Command::new("/bin/sh")
32675            .args(["-c", "sleep 0.5"])
32676            .status()
32677            .expect("reference sleep");
32678        assert!(reference.success());
32679        let host_factor = (reference_started.elapsed().as_secs_f64() / 0.5).clamp(1.0, 4.0);
32680        let phase_deadline_seconds = (4.0 * host_factor).ceil() as u64;
32681
32682        let mut test = recipe(true);
32683        test.id = "fixture/separate-preparation-budget".into();
32684        test.program = Some("fixture.sh".into());
32685        test.direct = None;
32686        let mut mode = test.modes.remove("verify").unwrap();
32687        mode.runs = Some(1);
32688        mode.assert = Some(Assertions {
32689            min_distinct: Some(1),
32690            ..Assertions::default()
32691        });
32692        test.modes.insert("naked".into(), mode);
32693        let cell = SelectedCell {
32694            image: None,
32695            category: "fixture".into(),
32696            id: CellId {
32697                test: test.id.clone(),
32698                mode: "naked".into(),
32699                backend: None,
32700            },
32701            test,
32702            enabled: true,
32703            timeout_seconds: phase_deadline_seconds,
32704            cpu_timeout_seconds: 1,
32705            host_level: HostLevel::default(),
32706        };
32707        let context = run_context(&root);
32708
32709        let result = run_cell(&context, &cell).unwrap();
32710        assert_eq!(result.outcome, "PASS", "unexpected result: {result:?}");
32711        assert_eq!(result.result, Some(ObservedResult::Pass));
32712        assert_eq!(result.attempts.len(), 1);
32713        let observations = &result.cpu_observations.as_ref().unwrap().invocations;
32714        assert_eq!(observations.len(), 2);
32715        assert_eq!(observations[0].role, InvocationRole::Preparation);
32716        assert_eq!(observations[0].live, LiveCpuObservation::Disabled);
32717        assert_eq!(observations[1].ordinal, 2);
32718        assert_eq!(
32719            result.cpu_usage_usec,
32720            Some(measured_final_cpu(&observations[0]) + measured_final_cpu(&observations[1]))
32721        );
32722        assert_cpu_source_roundtrip(&result);
32723        assert!(!result.attempts[0].timed_out);
32724        assert_eq!(result.attempts[0].stdout, "complete\n");
32725        assert!(
32726            result.duration_ms.is_some_and(|duration| duration >= 4_000),
32727            "the fixture did not exercise separate preparation and execution time: {result:?}"
32728        );
32729        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
32730    }

32826    /// The harness takes `exact_branch_counter` only from a complete, current
32827    /// report; an old binary's schema-1 report, which has no such verdict, is
32828    /// refused rather than read as one.
32829    #[test]
32830    fn exact_branch_counter_is_read_from_the_typed_host_report() {
32831        let absent = CapabilityVerdict {
32832            present: false,
32833            evidence: "CPU fixture: Reverie performance-counter validation failed".into(),
32834        };
32835        let report = serde_json::to_vec(&HostCapabilitiesReport::probe(absent.clone())).unwrap();
32836        assert_eq!(parse_exact_branch_counter(&report).unwrap(), absent);
32837
32838        let mut old: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&report).unwrap();
32839        old["schema"] = 1.into();
32840        old.as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("exact_branch_counter");
32841        let error = parse_exact_branch_counter(&serde_json::to_vec(&old).unwrap()).unwrap_err();
32842        assert!(error.contains("exact_branch_counter"), "{error}");
32843
32844        let mut unevidenced: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&report).unwrap();
32845        unevidenced["exact_branch_counter"]["evidence"] = "".into();
32846        let error =
32847            parse_exact_branch_counter(&serde_json::to_vec(&unevidenced).unwrap()).unwrap_err();
32848        assert!(error.contains("evidence must be nonempty"), "{error}");
32849    }

32851    /// The binary's own revision is read from its typed record, including the

32867            parse_binary_build_info(&build_info_json("351cd3603f7e537297067e07a20c5ccf7a23c0e0"))

32869            Some("351cd3603f7e537297067e07a20c5ccf7a23c0e0")

32915    /// The two fields answer different questions and must be independently

32935    /// REGRESSION CHECK FOR THE ORDINARY-HOST FALLBACK.
32936    ///
32937    /// Without the default the guest inherits the HOST's cwd verbatim. Measured on
32938    /// 2026-08-26 at main f4de43461a, 200 runs rotating across four checkouts:
32939    ///   default off -> 4 distinct guest `pwd` values
32940    ///   default on  -> 1, `/tmp/test`, and the directory empty on all 200
32941    /// The explicit hermetic path below supersedes this with a tmpfs at `/test`.
32942    /// This fallback remains for direct non-hermetic harness runs.
32943    #[test]
32944    fn fixed_workdir_is_bound_by_default_and_withheld_where_it_would_lie() {
32945        let source = Path::new("/cells/x/workdir/attempt-7");
32946        let mut argv: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
32947        append_execution_root_args(&mut argv, "ptrace", None, None, Some(source));
32948        assert_eq!(
32949            argv,
32950            vec![
32951                "--bind=/cells/x/workdir/attempt-7:/tmp/test".to_string(),
32952                "--workdir".to_string(),
32953                "/tmp/test".to_string(),
32954            ],
32955            "the fallback must bind a fresh per-attempt directory AND chdir into it"
32956        );
32957
32958        let mut argv: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
32959        append_execution_root_args(&mut argv, "ptrace", None, Some("/tmp"), Some(source));
32960        assert_eq!(argv, vec!["--workdir".to_string(), "/tmp".to_string()]);
32961
32962        let mut argv: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
32963        append_execution_root_args(&mut argv, "ptrace", None, None, None);
32964        assert!(
32965            argv.is_empty(),
32966            "a cell that cannot honour a workdir must be given none, got {argv:?}"
32967        );
32968    }

33048            serde_json::from_slice(&fs::read(root.join("ci/expected-e2e-plan.json")).unwrap())
33049                .unwrap();
33050        let unsupported = expected["cells"]
33051            .as_array()
33052            .unwrap()
33053            .iter()
33054            .filter_map(|cell| {
33055                let mode = cell["mode"].as_str().unwrap();
33056                let backend = cell["backend"].as_str().unwrap();
33057                (!supports_test_workdir(mode, backend))
33058                    .then(|| format!("{}/{mode}/{backend}", cell["test"].as_str().unwrap()))
33059            })
33060            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
33061        assert!(
33062            unsupported.is_empty(),
33063            "selected cells that cannot honour the hermetic /test gate: {unsupported:?}"
33064        );
33065    }

33067    #[test]
33068    fn attempt_labels_must_be_one_normal_path_component() {
33069        for attempt in [
33070            "",
33071            ".",
33072            "..",
33073            "/absolute",
33074            "../parent",
33075            "parent/child",
33076            "normal/",
33077        ] {
33078            assert_eq!(
33079                fixed_workdir_source_for_attempt(Path::new("/cell"), attempt),
33080                Err(format!(
33081                    "invalid attempt label {attempt:?}: expected exactly one normal path component"
33082                ))
33083            );
33084        }
33085        for attempt in ["1", "attempt-7", "seed--42"] {
33086            assert_eq!(
33087                fixed_workdir_source_for_attempt(Path::new("/cell"), attempt),
33088                Ok(PathBuf::from(format!("/cell/workdir/{attempt}")))
33089            );
33090        }
33091    }
33092
33093    /// The label is rejected BEFORE anything is created on disk.
33094    ///
33095    /// `attempt_labels_must_be_one_normal_path_component` covers the return value
33096    /// against a path that is never touched, so it cannot see an ordering defect.
33097    /// If the guard ever moves below the first `create_dir_all`, a traversal label
33098    /// gets to create a directory outside the cell before being refused, and the
33099    /// return value alone still looks correct.
33100    #[test]
33101    fn an_invalid_attempt_label_is_refused_before_any_filesystem_side_effect() {
33102        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
33103            "hermit-runner-attempt-label-ordering-{}",
33104            std::process::id()
33105        ));
33106        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
33107        let cell = ptrace_cell("verify");
33108        let context = run_context(&root);
33109        let cell_dir = root.join("cell");
33110
33111        for attempt in ["..", "/absolute", "parent/child"] {
33112            let error = build_spec(
33113                &context,
33114                &cell,
33115                cell_dir.clone(),
33116                vec!["/bin/true".into()],
33117                attempt,
33118                None,
33119                cell.timeout_seconds,
33120            )
33121            .unwrap_err();
33122            assert_eq!(
33123                error,
33124                format!(
33125                    "invalid attempt label {attempt:?}: expected exactly one normal path component"
33126                )
33127            );
33128            assert!(
33129                !cell_dir.exists(),
33130                "an invalid attempt label must be rejected before filesystem operations"
33131            );
33132        }
33133        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
33134    }

33136    #[test]
33137    fn fixed_workdir_bind_is_distinct_for_concurrent_attempts() {
33138        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
33139            "hermit-runner-concurrent-workdir-bracket-{}",
33140            std::process::id()
33141        ));
33142        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
33143        let cell_dir = root.join("cell");
33144        fs::create_dir_all(&cell_dir).unwrap();
33145        let cell = ptrace_cell("verify");
33146        let context = run_context(&root);
33147        let source_for = |attempt: &str| {
33148            let spec = build_spec(
33149                &context,
33150                &cell,
33151                cell_dir.clone(),
33152                vec!["/bin/true".into()],
33153                attempt,
33154                None,
33155                cell.timeout_seconds,
33156            )
33157            .unwrap();
33158            bound_workdir_source(&spec)
33159        };
33160        let sources = [source_for("1"), source_for("2")];
33161        assert_eq!(sources[0], cell_dir.join("workdir/1"));
33162        assert_eq!(sources[1], cell_dir.join("workdir/2"));
33163        assert_ne!(sources[0], sources[1]);
33164        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
33165    }

33167    #[test]
33168    fn execute_spec_resets_the_exact_bound_workdir() {
33169        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
33170            "hermit-runner-workdir-reset-bracket-{}",
33171            std::process::id()
33172        ));
33173        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&root);
33174        fs::create_dir_all(&root).unwrap();
33175        let cell_dir = root.join("cell");
33176        let cell = ptrace_cell("custom");
33177        let context = run_context(&root);
33178        let mut spec = build_spec(
33179            &context,
33180            &cell,
33181            cell_dir.clone(),
33182            vec!["/bin/true".into()],
33183            "attempt-7",
33184            None,
33185            cell.timeout_seconds,
33186        )
33187        .unwrap();
33188        let bound = bound_workdir_source(&spec);
33189        assert_eq!(bound, cell_dir.join("workdir/attempt-7"));
33190        assert_eq!(bound, spec.fixed_workdir_source);
33191
33192        fs::create_dir_all(&bound).unwrap();
33193        fs::write(bound.join("stale"), b"left by an earlier run").unwrap();
33194        spec.argv = vec![
33195            "/bin/sh".into(),
33196            "-c".into(),
33197            r#"test -d "$1" && test ! -e "$1/stale" && : > "$1/myfile.txt""#.into(),
33198            "sh".into(),
33199            bound.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
33200        ];
33201
33202        let result = execute_spec(&spec).unwrap();
33203        assert_eq!(result.index, "attempt-7");
33204        assert_eq!(result.outcome, "PASS", "{}", result.stderr);
33205        assert!(bound.join("myfile.txt").is_file());
33206        assert!(!bound.join("stale").exists());
33207        fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();
33208    }
